parentEnglish: ---- This is the discussion page for an anonymous user who has not created an account yet, or who does not use it. We therefore have to use the numerical IP address to identify them. Such an IP address can be shared by several users. If you are an anonymous user and feel that irrelevant comments have been directed at you, please [[Special:CreateAccount|create an account]] or [[Special:UserLogin|log in]] to avoid future confusion with other anonymous users.
parentKashmiri: ---- یہِ چھُ أکِس گُمنام صٲرفہٕ سٕنٛدِ خٲطرٕ بَحَژ ہُنٛد صَفہٕ ییٚمؠ نہٕ وُنیُک تام کانٛہہ خاتہٕ بنوومُت چھُ، یا یُس نہٕ یہِ اِستِمال چھُ کَران۔ تَمہِ کِنؠ چھُ اسہِ یِمن ہِنٛز پہچان کرنہٕ خٲطرٕ عددی IP ایڈریس اِستِمال کرُن۔ یُتھ IP ایڈریس ہیٚکو واریاہ صٲرفینن ہُنٛد ذریعہٕ شیئر کٔرتھ۔ اگر تُہؠ اکھ گُمنام صٲرِف چھِو تہٕ محسوٗس کران چھِو زِ غٲر متعلقہٕ تبصِرٕ چھِ تۄہہِ کُن ہدایت کرنہٕ آمٕتؠ، مہربٲنی کٔرِتھ کٔرِو [[Special:CreateAccount|create a account]] یا [[Special:UserLogin|log in]] باقی گُمنام صٲرفینن سۭتؠ مستقبلٕچ اُلجھَن نِش بچنہٕ خٲطرٕ۔
usageCondition: Preserve original license, attribution and applicable share-alike obligations.

english: If you see an inexplicable spike in pageviews, especially if it is only on specific days, it may be false traffic from an automated program.
kashmiri: اگر تۄہہِ صَفہٕ ویوَن مَنٛز اکھ ناقابلِ وضاحت اِضافہٕ وُچھِو، خاص کر اگر یہِ صِرِف مخصوٗص دۄہَن پؠٹھ آسہِ، یہِ ہیکہِ أکِس خۄدکار پروگرامہٕ نِش غلط ٹریفک ٲسِتھ۔
parentEnglish: If you see an inexplicable spike in pageviews, especially if it is only on specific days, it may be false traffic from an automated program. One tactic to identify bot-inflated traffic is to compare desktop views with mobile views. First see which agents are most popular on your project for all articles, and use that as a basis for comparison. For instance on the English Wikipedia mobile web views should be comparable if not higher than desktop, so if mobile web views are very low, it might be false traffic.
parentKashmiri: اگر تۄہہِ صَفہٕ ویوَن مَنٛز اکھ ناقابلِ وضاحت اِضافہٕ وُچھِو، خاص کر اگر یہِ صِرِف مخصوٗص دۄہَن پؠٹھ آسہِ، یہِ ہیکہِ أکِس خۄدکار پروگرامہٕ نِش غلط ٹریفک ٲسِتھ۔ بوٹ بڑاونہٕ آمٕتؠ ٹریفکٕچ پہچان کرنُک اکھ طریقہٕ چھُ ڈیسک ٹاپ ویوَن ہُنٛد موازنہٕ موبایِل ویوَن سٕتؠ کرُن۔ گۄڈٕ وُچھِو زِ تمام مضموٗنن خٲطرٕ کٔم ایجنٛٹ چھِ تُہنٛدِس پروجیکٹس منٛز ساروٕے کھۄتہٕ زیٛادٕ مشہوٗر، تہٕ یہِ کٔرِو موازنہٕ خٲطرٕ بُنیاد پٲٹھؠ اِستِمال۔ مِثالَن اَنٛگریٖزی وِکیٖپیٖڈیاہَس پؠٹھ گَژھِ موبایِل وؠب وِیَن ہُنٛد موازنہٕ آسُن اگر نہٕ ڈیسک ٹاپ کھۄتہٕ زیادٕ آسہِ، تَمہِ مۄکھٕ اگر موبایِل وؠب وِیَن واریاہ کم چھِ، تَمہِ مۄکھٕ ہیکہِ یہِ غلط ٹریفِک ٲسِتھ۔
usageCondition: Preserve original license, attribution and applicable share-alike obligations.

english: One tactic to identify bot-inflated traffic is to compare desktop views with mobile views.
kashmiri: بوٹ بڑاونہٕ آمٕتؠ ٹریفکٕچ پہچان کرنُک اکھ طریقہٕ چھُ ڈیسک ٹاپ ویوَن ہُنٛد موازنہٕ موبایِل ویوَن سٕتؠ کرُن۔
parentEnglish: If you see an inexplicable spike in pageviews, especially if it is only on specific days, it may be false traffic from an automated program. One tactic to identify bot-inflated traffic is to compare desktop views with mobile views. First see which agents are most popular on your project for all articles, and use that as a basis for comparison. For instance on the English Wikipedia mobile web views should be comparable if not higher than desktop, so if mobile web views are very low, it might be false traffic.

parentEnglish: If you see an inexplicable spike in pageviews, especially if it is only on specific days, it may be false traffic from an automated program. One tactic to identify bot-inflated traffic is to compare desktop views with mobile views. First see which agents are most popular on your project for all articles, and use that as a basis for comparison. For instance on the English Wikipedia mobile web views should be comparable if not higher than desktop, so if mobile web views are very low, it might be false traffic.
parentKashmiri: اگر تۄہہِ صَفہٕ ویوَن مَنٛز اکھ ناقابلِ وضاحت اِضافہٕ وُچھِو، خاص کر اگر یہِ صِرِف مخصوٗص دۄہَن پؠٹھ آسہِ، یہِ ہیکہِ أکِس خۄدکار پروگرامہٕ نِش غلط ٹریفک ٲسِتھ۔ بوٹ بڑاونہٕ آمٕتؠ ٹریفکٕچ پہچان کرنُک اکھ طریقہٕ چھُ ڈیسک ٹاپ ویوَن ہُنٛد موازنہٕ موبایِل ویوَن سٕتؠ کرُن۔ گۄڈٕ وُچھِو زِ تمام مضموٗنن خٲطرٕ کٔم ایجنٛٹ چھِ تُہنٛدِس پروجیکٹس منٛز ساروٕے کھۄتہٕ زیٛادٕ مشہوٗر، تہٕ یہِ کٔرِو موازنہٕ خٲطرٕ بُنیاد پٲٹھؠ اِستِمال۔ مِثالَن اَنٛگریٖزی وِکیٖپیٖڈیاہَس پؠٹھ گَژھِ موبایِل وؠب وِیَن ہُنٛد موازنہٕ آسُن اگر نہٕ ڈیسک ٹاپ کھۄتہٕ زیادٕ آسہِ، تَمہِ مۄکھٕ اگر موبایِل وؠب وِیَن واریاہ کم چھِ، تَمہِ مۄکھٕ ہیکہِ یہِ غلط ٹریفِک ٲسِتھ۔

parentEnglish: If you see an inexplicable spike in pageviews, especially if it is only on specific days, it may be false traffic from an automated program. One tactic to identify bot-inflated traffic is to compare desktop views with mobile views. First see which agents are most popular on your project for all articles, and use that as a basis for comparison. For instance on the English Wikipedia mobile web views should be comparable if not higher than desktop, so if mobile web views are very low, it might be false traffic.

english: Positron emission tomography (PET)[1] is a functional imaging technique that uses radioactive substances known as radiotracers to visualize and measure changes in metabolic processes, and in other physiological activities including blood flow, regional chemical composition, and absorption.
kashmiri: پاذِٹرٛان اِمِشَن ٹوموگرافی چھُ اَکھ تَحقیٖقی تَکنیٖکی تیسٹ یَتھ مَنٛز ریڑیو ایکٹِو مَواد چھُ استِمال گَژھان اندرونی عَلہ وُچھنہٕ خٲطرٕ.
parentEnglish: Positron emission tomography (PET)[1] is a functional imaging technique that uses radioactive substances known as radiotracers to visualize and measure changes in metabolic processes, and in other physiological activities including blood flow, regional chemical composition, and absorption. Different tracers are used for various imaging purposes, depending on the target process within the body. For example, 18 F -FDG is commonly used to detect cancer, NaF18 F is widely used for detecting bone formation, and oxygen-15 is sometimes used to measure blood flow.
parentKashmiri: پاذِٹرٛان اِمِشَن ٹوموگرافی چھُ اَکھ تَحقیٖقی تَکنیٖکی تیسٹ یَتھ مَنٛز ریڑیو ایکٹِو مَواد چھُ استِمال گَژھان اندرونی عَلہ وُچھنہٕ خٲطرٕ. اَتھ مَنٛز چھُ خۄٗنُک بَہاو، جِسمٕچ بَناوَٹھ تہِ یِوان وُچھنہٕ. اتھ مَنٛز چھُ ایف ڈی جی مَواد استِمال گَژھان.

parentEnglish: Vastly undersampled Isotropic Projection Reconstruction (VIPR) of a Phase Contrast (PC) MRI sequence of a 56-year-old male with dissections of the celiac artery (upper) and the superior mesenteric artery (lower). A notable non-enhanced method for flow-independent angiography is balanced steady-state free precession (bSSFP) imaging which naturally produces high signal from arteries and veins.

kashmiri: 4D متحرک MR انجیوگرافی (4D-MRA): گوڑنچ تصاویر، بڑاونہٕ برونٹھ، ینہٕ والن امیجن منٛز ویسکولر کلۍ کڑنہٕ خٲطرٕ چھ گھٹاؤ ماسک پٲنٹھ کٲم کران۔
parentEnglish: 4D dynamic MR angiography (4D-MRA): The first images, before enhancement, serve as a subtraction mask to extract the vascular tree in the succeeding images. Allows the operator to divide arterial and venous phases of a blood-groove with visualisation of its dynamics. Much less time has been spent researching this method so far in comparison with other methods of MRA.

english: Magnetic resonance angiography (MRA) is a group of techniques based on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) to image blood vessels.
kashmiri: ایم آر اینجِیوگرافِی چھُ اَکھ طِبی ٹیسٹ یُس ایم آر اے مَشیٖن پؠٹھ کَرنہٕ چھُ یِوان تاکِہ اِنسان سٕنز خوٗن رَگہٕ یِیَن وُچھنہٕ.
parentEnglish: Magnetic resonance angiography (MRA) is a group of techniques based on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) to image blood vessels. Magnetic resonance angiography is used to generate images of arteries (and less commonly veins) in order to evaluate them for stenosis (abnormal narrowing), occlusions, aneurysms (vessel wall dilatations, at risk of rupture) or other abnormalities. MRA is often used to evaluate the arteries of the neck and brain, the thoracic and abdominal aorta, the renal arteries, and the legs (the latter exam is often referred to as a "run-off").
parentKashmiri: ایم آر اینجِیوگرافِی چھُ اَکھ طِبی ٹیسٹ یُس ایم آر اے مَشیٖن پؠٹھ کَرنہٕ چھُ یِوان تاکِہ اِنسان سٕنز خوٗن رَگہٕ یِیَن وُچھنہٕ. ایم آر اینجِیوگرافِی مَنٛز چھِ آرٹری یِوان وُچھنہٕ تاکہِ تِمَن مَنٛز ما چھِ کانٛہہ بؠمٲر. ایم آر اینجِیوگرافِی چھِ دؠماغ، گَردن، سیینہ اَیوٹا تہٕ باقؠن تانَن تہٕ یِوان کَرنہٕ.

english: The aorta (/eɪˈɔːrtə/ ay-OR-tə) is the main and largest artery in the human body, originating from the left ventricle of the heart and extending down to the abdomen, where it splits into two smaller arteries (the common iliac arteries).
kashmiri: اَیوٹا چھِ اَکھ اَہَم تہٕ ساروے کھوتہٕ بٕڈ آرٹری اِنسان سٔندِس بَدنَس مَنٛز، یۄس کھووٕرؠ وؠنٹرِکٔل پؠٹھ یَڈ تام چھُ آسان، تَتِہٕ چھُ اَتھ زٕ لۄکچِہ آرٹریَن بَنَن.
parentEnglish: The aorta (/eɪˈɔːrtə/ ay-OR-tə) is the main and largest artery in the human body, originating from the left ventricle of the heart and extending down to the abdomen, where it splits into two smaller arteries (the common iliac arteries). The aorta distributes oxygenated blood to all parts of the body through the systemic circulation.[1]

english: The aorta distributes oxygenated blood to all parts of the body through the systemic circulation.[1]
kashmiri: اَیوٹا چھُ آکسیجَن دار خوٗن بَدنَس پَکناوَن.
parentEnglish: The aorta (/eɪˈɔːrtə/ ay-OR-tə) is the main and largest artery in the human body, originating from the left ventricle of the heart and extending down to the abdomen, where it splits into two smaller arteries (the common iliac arteries). The aorta distributes oxygenated blood to all parts of the body through the systemic circulation.[1]
parentKashmiri: اَیوٹا چھِ اَکھ اَہَم تہٕ ساروے کھوتہٕ بٕڈ آرٹری اِنسان سٔندِس بَدنَس مَنٛز، یۄس کھووٕرؠ وؠنٹرِکٔل پؠٹھ یَڈ تام چھُ آسان، تَتِہٕ چھُ اَتھ زٕ لۄکچِہ آرٹریَن بَنَن. اَیوٹا چھُ آکسیجَن دار خوٗن بَدنَس پَکناوَن.
usageCondition: Preserve original license, attribution and applicable share-alike obligations.

english: It ends in a bifurcation into the left and right common iliac arteries.
kashmiri: اَمہِ پؠٹھ چھِ لَمبَر، رینَل، سیلیک ٹرنک، سُپیرِیَر میذنٹرک آرٹری، اِنفیرِیَر میذنٹرک آرٹری تہٕ باقی آرٹری وَتھان.
parentEnglish: The abdominal aorta begins at the aortic hiatus of the diaphragm at the level of the twelfth thoracic vertebra.[10] It gives rise to lumbar and musculophrenic arteries, renal and middle suprarenal arteries, and visceral arteries (the celiac trunk, the superior mesenteric artery and the inferior mesenteric artery). It ends in a bifurcation into the left and right common iliac arteries. At the point of the bifurcation, there also springs a smaller branch, the median sacral artery.[2]: 331
parentKashmiri: ایبڈامنَل اَیوٹا چھِ ڈایافرام پؠٹھ شُروٗع گَژھان. اَمہِ پؠٹھ چھِ لَمبَر، رینَل، سیلیک ٹرنک، سُپیرِیَر میذنٹرک آرٹری، اِنفیرِیَر میذنٹرک آرٹری تہٕ باقی آرٹری وَتھان. آخرس پؠٹھ چھِ یہِ دۄن کامَن ایلیک آرٹریَن مَنٛز تَخصیٖم گَژھان.

english: Radiocontrast agents are substances used to enhance the visibility of internal structures in X-ray-based imaging techniques such as computed tomography (contrast CT), projectional radiography, and fluoroscopy.
kashmiri: ریڈیوکَنٹراسٹ اَجَنٹ چھِ تِم مَواد یِم اؠکسرے مَنٛز اندرونی تانَن ۂنز ظٲہِرِیتھ بَڈاونَس خٲطرٕ اِستِمال چھِ گَژھان.
parentEnglish: Radiocontrast agents are substances used to enhance the visibility of internal structures in X-ray-based imaging techniques such as computed tomography (contrast CT), projectional radiography, and fluoroscopy. Radiocontrast agents are typically iodine, or more rarely barium sulfate. The contrast agents absorb external X-rays, resulting in decreased exposure on the X-ray detector.
parentKashmiri: ریڈیوکَنٹراسٹ اَجَنٹ چھِ تِم مَواد یِم اؠکسرے مَنٛز اندرونی تانَن ۂنز ظٲہِرِیتھ بَڈاونَس خٲطرٕ اِستِمال چھِ گَژھان. ریڈیوکَنٹراسٹ اَجَنٹ چھِ عام طور ایوڑین یس بیرِیَم سَلفیٹ آسَن. کَنٹراسٹ اَجَنٹ چھِ اؠکسرے جَزٕب کَران، یَمہٕ سٲتؠ کَم اؠکسپوجَر چھُ اؠکسرے ڈِٹیکڑٓرس واتان.

english: Barium sulfate is mainly used in the imaging of the digestive system.
kashmiri: بیرِیَم سَلفیٹ چھُ عام طور نِظامِ ہَضٕم تَصویٖر تُلنہٕ خٲطرٕ اِستِمال گَژھان.
parentEnglish: Barium sulfate is mainly used in the imaging of the digestive system. The substance exists as a water-insoluble white powder that is made into a slurry with water and administered directly into the gastrointestinal tract.
parentKashmiri: بیرِیَم سَلفیٹ چھُ عام طور نِظامِ ہَضٕم تَصویٖر تُلنہٕ خٲطرٕ اِستِمال گَژھان. یہِ مَواد چھُنہٕ آبَس مَنٛز گَلَن، یہِ چھُ آبَس سٲتؠ مِلاونہٕ یِوان تہٕ چھُ مٔریٖذس دِینہٕ یِوان.

english: Medical imaging is the technique and process of imaging the interior of a body for clinical analysis and medical intervention, as well as visual representation of the function of some organs or tissues (physiology).
kashmiri: طِبی تَصویٖر سٲزی چھِ اَکھ تَکنیٖک تہٕ عَمل أندرونی تانَن ۂنز تَصویٖر کیٖمیٲیی تہٕ باقی جیٖز وُچھنہٕ خٲطرٕ یا تانَن ۂنز کٲم کَرنٕچ صَلٲہِیتھ وُچھنہٕ خٲطرٕ.
parentEnglish: Medical imaging is the technique and process of imaging the interior of a body for clinical analysis and medical intervention, as well as visual representation of the function of some organs or tissues (physiology). Medical imaging seeks to reveal internal structures hidden by the skin and bones, as well as to diagnose and treat disease. Medical imaging also establishes a database of normal anatomy and physiology to make it possible to identify abnormalities.
parentKashmiri: طِبی تَصویٖر سٲزی چھِ اَکھ تَکنیٖک تہٕ عَمل أندرونی تانَن ۂنز تَصویٖر کیٖمیٲیی تہٕ باقی جیٖز وُچھنہٕ خٲطرٕ یا تانَن ۂنز کٲم کَرنٕچ صَلٲہِیتھ وُچھنہٕ خٲطرٕ. اَمہ سٲتؠ چھِ تِم تان اَتھہٕ یِوان یِم مٕسلَس تَل یا أڈِجو سٲتی ظٲیِر چھِ نہٕ آسان تہٕ امہ ڈٲتؠ چھِ بؠمارؠَن ہُند تَشخیٖص تہِ عیلاج تہِ کَرنہٕ یِوان. اَمہ ڈٲتی چھِ پرٛانین بؠمارَن ۂنز ڈیٹا مَحفوٗظ روزان یَمہ سٲتی بؠمارؠ آسٲنی سان پرزناونہٕ چھِ یِوان.

english: While neutral terms are generally preferable, this must be balanced against clarity.
kashmiri: کیٚنٛہہ حالتَن مَنٛز ہیکہٕ مَضموٗنَن ہُند ناو غٲر جٲنِبدارانہٕ بٲسِتھ.
parentEnglish: While neutral terms are generally preferable, this must be balanced against clarity. If a name is widely used in reliable sources (particularly those written in English) and is therefore likely to be well recognized by readers, it may be used even though some may regard it as biased. For example, the widely used names "Boston Massacre", "Teapot Dome scandal", and "Jack the Ripper" are legitimate ways of referring to the subjects in question, even though they may appear to pass judgment.
parentKashmiri: کیٚنٛہہ حالتَن مَنٛز ہیکہٕ مَضموٗنَن ہُند ناو غٲر جٲنِبدارانہٕ بٲسِتھ. تَتھ ناوس گَژھہِ تَرجی دِینہٕ یِنؠ یُس غٲر جٲنِبدارانہٕ آسہِ، مَگر سُہ ناو گَژھہِ واضَہ تہِ آسُن. اَگر ناو آسہِ بَروسہٕ مَنٛد ذٔریعہ مَنٛز اِستِمال کَرنہٕ آمُت، تیٚلہِ ہیٚیہِ سُہ ناو اِستِمال کَرنہٕ اَگر چہٕ باقی ایؠڈِٹر اَتھ خٕلاف آسَن.

english: NPOV is a fundamental principle of Wikipedia and of other Wikimedia projects.
kashmiri: غٲر جٲنِبدارانہٕ مَواد آسُن چھُ َکھ بُنیٲدی پالسی وِکیٖپیٖڈیا تہٕ بقی مَنصوبَن پؠٹھ.
parentEnglish: NPOV is a fundamental principle of Wikipedia and of other Wikimedia projects. It is also one of Wikipedia's three core content policies; the other two are "Verifiability" and "No original research". These policies jointly determine the type and quality of material acceptable in Wikipedia articles, and because they work in harmony, they should not be interpreted in isolation from one another.

english: Only the left common carotid artery has a substantial presence in the thorax.
kashmiri: خٲلی کھورِ کامَن کیروٹِڑ آرٹری چھُ اصل حِصہٕ سیٖنَس مَنٛز آسان.
parentEnglish: Only the left common carotid artery has a substantial presence in the thorax. It originates directly from the aortic arch, and travels upward through the superior mediastinum to the level of the left sternoclavicular joint.

english: The azygos vein is a vein running up the right side of the thoracic vertebral column draining itself towards the superior vena cava.
kashmiri: ایزایگَس ویٖن چھِ اَکھ ویٖن یوس دۄچھنہٕ طَرفہٕ ہیوٚر کُن پَکان چھِ تہٕ سُپیرِیَر وینا کاوا سٲتی رَتان چھِ.
parentEnglish: The azygos vein is a vein running up the right side of the thoracic vertebral column draining itself towards the superior vena cava. It connects the systems of superior vena cava and inferior vena cava and can provide an alternative path for blood to the right atrium when either of the venae cavae is blocked.[2][3]
parentKashmiri: ایزایگَس ویٖن چھِ اَکھ ویٖن یوس دۄچھنہٕ طَرفہٕ ہیوٚر کُن پَکان چھِ تہٕ سُپیرِیَر وینا کاوا سٲتی رَتان چھِ. یہِ چھِ سُپیرِیَر وینا کاوا تہٕ اِنفیرِیَر وینا کاوا رَلاوَن تہِ چھِ اَکھ اِضٲفی وَتھ بَناون اَگر کانٛہہ وینا کاوا آسہِ بَند.

english: The renal arteries are paired arteries that supply the kidneys with blood.
kashmiri: رینَل آرٹری چھِ آرٹریَن ہُند جوڈٕ یِم بۄکہٕ وَچَن خوٗن واتناوان چھِ.
parentEnglish: The renal arteries are paired arteries that supply the kidneys with blood. Each is directed across the crus of the diaphragm, so as to form nearly a right angle.

english: The common iliac artery is a large artery of the abdomen paired on each side.
kashmiri: کامَن ایلیک آرٹری چھِ یٕڈ مَنٛز آرٹریَن ہُند جوڈٕ یِم چھِ اَیوٹا پؠٹھ وَتھان ژورمِس لَمبَر أڈجہٕ نِش.
parentEnglish: The common iliac artery is a large artery of the abdomen paired on each side. It originates from the aortic bifurcation at the level of the 4th lumbar vertebra. It ends in front of the sacroiliac joint, one on either side, and each bifurcates into the external and internal iliac arteries.

english: The external carotid artery is a major artery of the head and neck.
kashmiri: ایکسٹرنَل کیروٹِڑ آرٹری چھِ کامَن کیروٹِڑ آرٹری ۂنز اَکھ شاخ یۄس گَردَن نیبرِم طَرفہٕ آسان چھِ.
parentEnglish: The external carotid artery is a major artery of the head and neck. It arises from the common carotid artery when it splits into the external and internal carotid artery. External carotid artery supplies blood to the face and neck.[1]
parentKashmiri: ایکسٹرنَل کیروٹِڑ آرٹری چھِ کامَن کیروٹِڑ آرٹری ۂنز اَکھ شاخ یۄس گَردَن نیبرِم طَرفہٕ آسان چھِ. اِنسانَن مَنز چھِ یِم کامَن کیروٹِڑ آرٹری ۂنز اَکھ شاخ تہٕ بیٛاکھ شاخ چھِ اِنٹرنَل کیروٹِڑ آرٹری. ایکسٹرنَل کیروٹِڑ آرٹری چھِ کَلہٕ کین باقی حِصَن خوٗن واتناوان یِمَن مَنٛز بۄتھ، تال مینَنجی یِوان چھِ.

english: The abdominal aorta is the largest artery in the abdominal cavity.
kashmiri: ایبڈامنَل اَیوٹا چھِ ساروے کھوتہٕ بٔڈ آرٹری ایبڈامنَل کیوٹی مَنٛز.
parentEnglish: The abdominal aorta is the largest artery in the abdominal cavity. As part of the aorta, it is a direct continuation of the descending aorta (of the thorax).[1]

english: The popliteal artery is a deeply placed continuation of the femoral artery opening in the distal portion of the adductor magnus muscle.
kashmiri: پاپلِٹییَل آرٹری چھِ کوٹھیِس مَنٛز اکھ آرٹری.
parentEnglish: The popliteal artery is a deeply placed continuation of the femoral artery opening in the distal portion of the adductor magnus muscle. It courses through the popliteal fossa and ends at the lower border of the popliteus muscle, where it branches into the anterior and posterior tibial arteries.
parentKashmiri: پاپلِٹییَل آرٹری چھِ کوٹھیِس مَنٛز اکھ آرٹری. یہِ چھِ فِمورَل آرٹری پؠٹھ وَتھان.

english: The ductus arteriosus connects to the junction between the pulmonary artery and the descending aorta in foetal life.
kashmiri: ڈَکٹَس آرٹِیوسَس چھُ پَلمونیری آرٹری تہٕ ڈِسینڈنگ اَیوٹا رَلاوَن بَچَن یِم بَچہٕ دانہٕ مَنز آسان چھِ.
parentEnglish: The ductus arteriosus connects to the junction between the pulmonary artery and the descending aorta in foetal life. This artery later regresses as the ligamentum arteriosum.[1][2]

english: There is no brachiocephalic artery for the left side of the body.
kashmiri: کھووُرِ طَرفہٕ چھِ نہٕ برینکیوسِپھیلک آرٹری آسان.
parentEnglish: There is no brachiocephalic artery for the left side of the body. The left common carotid, and the left subclavian artery, come directly off the aortic arch. However, there are two brachiocephalic veins.

english: Computed tomography angiography (also called CT angiography or CTA) is a computed tomography technique used for angiography—the visualization of arteries and veins—throughout the human body.
kashmiri: کَمپیوٗٹِڑ ٹوموٗگرٛافی اینجِیوگرٛافِی چھِ اَکھ کَمپیوٗٹِڑ ٹوموٗگرٛافی تہٕ اینجِیوگرٛافی ہُنٛد اَکھ قسٕم یُس سی ٹی سِکینَر مَشیٖن پؠٹھ کَرنہٕ چھُ یِوان تاکِہ اِنسان سٕنز خوٗن رَگہٕ یِیَن وُچھنہٕ۔
parentEnglish: Computed tomography angiography (also called CT angiography or CTA) is a computed tomography technique used for angiography—the visualization of arteries and veins—throughout the human body. Using contrast injected into the blood vessels, images are created to look for blockages, aneurysms (dilations of walls), dissections (tearing of walls), and stenosis (narrowing of vessel). CTA can be used to visualize the vessels of the heart, the aorta and other large blood vessels, the lungs, the kidneys, the head and neck, and the arms and legs.
parentKashmiri: کَمپیوٗٹِڑ ٹوموٗگرٛافی اینجِیوگرٛافِی چھِ اَکھ کَمپیوٗٹِڑ ٹوموٗگرٛافی تہٕ اینجِیوگرٛافی ہُنٛد اَکھ قسٕم یُس سی ٹی سِکینَر مَشیٖن پؠٹھ کَرنہٕ چھُ یِوان تاکِہ اِنسان سٕنز خوٗن رَگہٕ یِیَن وُچھنہٕ۔ سی ٹی اینجِیوگرافِی مَنٛز چھِ آرٹری تہٕ ویٖنہٕ یِوان وُچھنہٕ تاکہِ تِمَن مَنٛز ما چھِ کانٛہہ بیمأرؠ۔ سی ٹی اے چھِ تَمام رَگہٕ وُچھِنہٕ خٲطرٕ اِستِمال گَژھان.

english: Coronary CT angiography (CTA or CCTA) is the use of computed tomography (CT) angiography to assess the coronary arteries of the heart.
kashmiri: کورونَری کَمپیوٗٹِڑ ٹوموٗگرٛافی اینجِیوگرٛافی چھِ سی ٹی اینجِیوگرٛافی ہُنٛد قسٕم یُس دِلچہٕ آرٹری وُچھہٕ خٲطرٕ اِستِمال گَژھان چھِ.
parentEnglish: Coronary CT angiography (CTA or CCTA) is the use of computed tomography (CT) angiography to assess the coronary arteries of the heart. The patient receives an intravenous injection of radiocontrast and then the heart is scanned using a high speed CT scanner, allowing physicians to assess the extent of occlusion in the coronary arteries, usually in order to diagnose coronary artery disease.
parentKashmiri: کورونَری کَمپیوٗٹِڑ ٹوموٗگرٛافی اینجِیوگرٛافی چھِ سی ٹی اینجِیوگرٛافی ہُنٛد قسٕم یُس دِلچہٕ آرٹری وُچھہٕ خٲطرٕ اِستِمال گَژھان چھِ. مٔریزَس چھُ رَگَن مَنٛز اِنجَکشَن سٲتی کَنٹراسٹ اَجَنٹ بَرنہٕ یِوان تہٕ امَہِ پَتہٕ چھِ دِلس طِبی تَصویٖر تُلنہٕ یِوان سی ٹی سکینر سٲتی.

english: The coronary arteries are the arterial blood vessels of coronary circulation, which transport oxygenated blood to the heart muscle.
kashmiri: کورونَری آرٹری چھِ تِم آرٹری یِم آکسیٖجَن دار خوٗن دِلچہٕ مَژٕ واتناوان چھِ.
parentEnglish: The coronary arteries are the arterial blood vessels of coronary circulation, which transport oxygenated blood to the heart muscle. The heart requires a continuous supply of oxygen to function and survive, much like any other tissue or organ of the body.[1]
parentKashmiri: کورونَری آرٹری چھِ تِم آرٹری یِم آکسیٖجَن دار خوٗن دِلچہٕ مَژٕ واتناوان چھِ. دِلس چھُ آکسیجن باقیَن تانَن ۂند پٲٹھؠ لَگاتار ضۆروٗرتھ آسان تاکہِ سُہٕ ہیکہِ خوٗن باقیَن تانَن تام واتنٲوِتھ.

english: An upper gastrointestinal series, also called a barium swallow, barium study, or barium meal, is a series of radiographs used to examine the gastrointestinal tract for abnormalities.
kashmiri: ہیرِم نِظامِ ہَضمٕچ تَصویٖر سٲزی یَتھ بیرِیَم سُویلو، بیرِیَم میٖل، یا بیرِیَم ٹیسٹ چھُ ریڈیوگرٛافَن ہُند اَکھ سِلسِلہٕ یِم نِظامِ ہَضٕم حالتھ وُچھنہٕ خٲطرٕ اِستِمال گَژھان چھِ.
parentEnglish: An upper gastrointestinal series, also called a barium swallow, barium study, or barium meal, is a series of radiographs used to examine the gastrointestinal tract for abnormalities. A contrast medium, usually a radiocontrast agent such as barium sulfate mixed with water, is ingested or instilled into the gastrointestinal tract, and X-rays are used to create radiographs of the regions of interest. The barium enhances the visibility of the relevant parts of the gastrointestinal tract by coating the inside wall of the tract and appearing white on the film.

english: Mammography (also called mastography) is the process of using low-energy X-rays (usually around 30 kVp) to examine the human breast for diagnosis and screening.
kashmiri: میموٗگرٛافی چھِ اَکھ طِبی تَکنیٖک یَتھ مَنٛز کَم طاقَتھ وٲلؠ اؠکسرے (عام طور 30 kVp) بَبہٕ مَنٛز بؠمٲرؠ وُچھنہٕ خٲطرٕ اِستِمال گَژھان چھِ.
parentEnglish: Mammography (also called mastography) is the process of using low-energy X-rays (usually around 30 kVp) to examine the human breast for diagnosis and screening. The goal of mammography is the early detection of breast cancer, typically through detection of characteristic masses or microcalcifications.
parentKashmiri: میموٗگرٛافی چھِ اَکھ طِبی تَکنیٖک یَتھ مَنٛز کَم طاقَتھ وٲلؠ اؠکسرے (عام طور 30 kVp) بَبہٕ مَنٛز بؠمٲرؠ وُچھنہٕ خٲطرٕ اِستِمال گَژھان چھِ. اَمِیُک مَقصد چھُ کینسرُک بَتا زانُن.

english: It is usual to employ lower-energy X-rays, typically Mo (K-shell X-ray energies of 17.5 and 19.6 keV) and Rh (20.2 and 22.7 keV) than those used for radiography of bones.
kashmiri: اَتھ مَنٛز چھِ ایونایِز کَرن واجنہٕ ریڈیشنَن اِستِمال گَژھان.
parentEnglish: It is usual to employ lower-energy X-rays, typically Mo (K-shell X-ray energies of 17.5 and 19.6 keV) and Rh (20.2 and 22.7 keV) than those used for radiography of bones. Ultrasound, ductography, positron emission mammography (PEM), and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) are adjuncts to mammography. Ultrasound is typically used for further evaluation of masses found on mammography or palpable masses not seen on mammograms.
parentKashmiri: اَتھ مَنٛز چھِ ایونایِز کَرن واجنہٕ ریڈیشنَن اِستِمال گَژھان. اَمہِ پَتہٕ چھُ یِمَن تَصویٖرَن مُعٲیِنہٕ کَرنہٕ یِوان کانٛہہ بؠمٲرؠ وُچھنہٕ خٲطرٕ.اَتھ مَنٛز چھِ عام طور باقی تانَن مَنٛز اِستِمال گَژھن واجنہٕ اؠکسرے کھۄتہٕ کَم طاقَتھ واجنہٕ اؠکسرے زٕژٕ اِستِمال گَژھان. یِم چھِ مولِبِڈنَم تہٕ روڈِیَم اینوڈ پؠٹھ بَناونہٕ یِوان.

english: The esophagus is a fibromuscular tube, about 25 cm (10 in) long in adults, that travels behind the trachea and heart, passes through the diaphragm, and empties into the uppermost region of the stomach.
kashmiri: بَتہٕ نٲلؠ چھِ اِنسانَن تہٕ وٕٹیبریٹَن مَنٛز اَکھ جِسمُک اندورنی تان یَمہٕ کِنہٕ بَتہٕ تہٕ باقی کھۄراکھ چھُ میٚادٕ تام واتان.
parentEnglish: The esophagus is a fibromuscular tube, about 25 cm (10 in) long in adults, that travels behind the trachea and heart, passes through the diaphragm, and empties into the uppermost region of the stomach. During swallowing, the epiglottis tilts backwards to prevent food from going down the larynx and lungs. The word oesophagus is from Ancient Greek οἰσοφάγος (oisophágos), from οἴσω (oísō), future form of φέρω (phérō, “I carry”) + ἔφαγον (éphagon, “I ate”).
parentKashmiri: بَتہٕ نٲلؠ چھِ اِنسانَن تہٕ وٕٹیبریٹَن مَنٛز اَکھ جِسمُک اندورنی تان یَمہٕ کِنہٕ بَتہٕ تہٕ باقی کھۄراکھ چھُ میٚادٕ تام واتان. یہِ چھِ اَکھ فایبرومَسکیورَل نٲلؠ یۄس 25 سینٹی میٖٹَر آسان چھِ. یہِ چھِ شاہ نالہٕ پَتہٕ کَن آسان تہٕ چھِ ڈایافرام مٔنز نیران تہٕ میٚادٕ کِس ہیرمِس حَصَس سٲتؠ رَلان.

english: In human anatomy, the common iliac veins are formed by the external iliac veins and internal iliac veins.

parentEnglish: In human anatomy, the common iliac veins are formed by the external iliac veins and internal iliac veins. The left and right common iliac veins come together in the abdomen at the level of the fifth lumbar vertebra,[1] forming the inferior vena cava. They drain blood from the pelvis and lower limbs.

english: They drain blood from the pelvis and lower limbs.
kashmiri: یِم رَگہٕ چھِ خوٗن زَنٛگو پؠٹھ دِلس کُن واپَس نِوان.
parentEnglish: In human anatomy, the common iliac veins are formed by the external iliac veins and internal iliac veins. The left and right common iliac veins come together in the abdomen at the level of the fifth lumbar vertebra,[1] forming the inferior vena cava. They drain blood from the pelvis and lower limbs.

english: The skull is a bone structure that forms the head in vertebrates.
kashmiri: کَلہٕ کھۄپٕر چھُ اَکھ أڈجو سٲتی بَنیومُت جِسمُک حِصہٕ یَتھ مَنٛز دؠماغ چھُ آسان.
parentEnglish: The skull is a bone structure that forms the head in vertebrates. It supports the structures of the face and provides a protective cavity for the brain.[1] The skull is composed of two parts: the cranium and the mandible.[2] In humans, these two parts are the neurocranium and the viscerocranium (facial skeleton) that includes the mandible as its largest bone. The skull forms the anterior-most portion of the skeleton and is a product of cephalisation—housing the brain, and several sensory structures such as the eyes, ears, nose, and mouth.[3] In humans these sensory structures are part of the facial skeleton.
parentKashmiri: کَلہٕ کھۄپٕر چھُ اَکھ أڈجو سٲتی بَنیومُت جِسمُک حِصہٕ یَتھ مَنٛز دؠماغ چھُ آسان. یہِ چھُ دؠماغَس حیفاضَتھ کَران. اَتھ چھِ زٕ حِصہٕ آسان.

english: The femoral artery is a large artery in the thigh and the main arterial supply to the thigh and leg.
kashmiri: فِمورَل آرٹری چھِ اَکھ آرٹری یۄس مَندلَن منز آسان چھِ.
parentEnglish: The femoral artery is a large artery in the thigh and the main arterial supply to the thigh and leg. The femoral artery gives off the deep femoral artery or profunda femoris artery and descends along the anteromedial part of the thigh in the femoral triangle. It enters and passes through the adductor canal, and becomes the popliteal artery as it passes through the adductor hiatus in the adductor magnus near the junction of the middle and distal thirds of the thigh.[1]

parentEnglish: Wikipedia does not publish original research. Its content is determined by previously published information rather than the beliefs or experiences of editors. Even if you are sure something is true, it must be verifiable before you can add it.[1] If reliable sources disagree, then maintain a neutral point of view and present what the various sources say, giving each side its due weight.

english: Blocking is the method by which administrators technically prevent users from editing Wikipedia.

parentEnglish: Blocking is the method by which administrators technically prevent users from editing Wikipedia. Blocks may be applied to user accounts, to IP addresses, and to ranges of IP addresses, for either a definite or an indefinite time, to all or a subset of pages. Blocked users can continue to access Wikipedia, but cannot edit any page they are blocked from (including, if appropriate, their own user pages).

Blocks may be applied to user accounts, to IP addresses, and to ranges of IP addresses, for either a definite or an indefinite time, to all or a subset of pages. Blocked users can continue to access Wikipedia, but cannot edit any page they are blocked from (including, if appropriate, their own user pages).
parentKashmiri: وِکیٖپیٖڈیاہَس پؠٹھ چھُ بُلاک مطلب اؠڑِٹ کَرنَس مَنٛز ٹھوٚر اَنُن۔‌ بُلاک کَرُن چھُ اَکھ طٔریٖقہٕ یم سٲتؠ اِنتِظٲمؠ چھِ آیہ پی پَتاہَن تہٕ صٲرفَن اؠڑِٹ تہٕ باقی کامہِ کَرنہٕ نِیش رُکاوَن۔ بُلاک کَرنہٕ آمُت صٲرِف ہیٚکہِ وِکیٖپیٖڈیا اِستِمال کٔرِتھ مَگر سہ ہیٚکہِ نہٕ وِکیٖپیٖڈیاہَس پؠٹھ تِم صَفہٕ اؠڈِٹ کٔرِتھ یِمَن پؠٹھ سہ بُلاک کَرنہٕ آسہ آمُت. زیادٕ تَت مُکَمَل بُلاکَن مَنٛز چھُنہٕ صٲرِف ہیٚکَن پَنُن کَتھ صَفہٕ تہِ اؠڈِٹ کٔرِتھ.

english: MRI is used industrially mainly for routine analysis of chemicals.
kashmiri: ایم آر آی چھُ صَنتی طور کیٖمیٲیی عُنصَر تہٕ مُرَکَبن پؠٹھ تَحقیٖق کَرنس مَنٛز اِستِمال کَرنہٕ یِوان.
parentEnglish: MRI is used industrially mainly for routine analysis of chemicals. The nuclear magnetic resonance technique is also used, for example, to measure the ratio between water and fat in foods, monitoring of flow of corrosive fluids in pipes, or to study molecular structures such as catalysts.[127]

english: The major components of an MRI scanner are the main magnet, which polarizes the sample, the shim coils for correcting shifts in the homogeneity of the main magnetic field, the gradient system which is used to localize the region to be scanned and the RF system, which excites the sample and detects the resulting NMR signal.
kashmiri: ایم آر آی سِکینَرُک اَہَم حِصہٕ چھُ میگنِٹ، اَکھ چھُ بۆڈ یا تھۄد میگنِٹِک فیلڈ بَناوَن تہٕ بیٚاکھ چھُ لۄکٕٹؠ میگنِٹِک فیلڈ بَناوَن، لۄکٕٹؠ میگنِٹِک فیلڈ چھِ گریڈیَنٹ کۄیلہٕ بَناوَن.
parentEnglish: The major components of an MRI scanner are the main magnet, which polarizes the sample, the shim coils for correcting shifts in the homogeneity of the main magnetic field, the gradient system which is used to localize the region to be scanned and the RF system, which excites the sample and detects the resulting NMR signal. The whole system is controlled by one or more computers.

english: Compared to CT, MRI provides better contrast in images of soft-tissues, e.g.
kashmiri: ایم آے ای چھُ ہَسپتالَن تہٕ کِلنِکَن مَنٛز طِبی تَشخیٖص، دَرٕجہٕ بَندی تہٕ بؠماریَن پؠٹھ نَظر تھاونَس مَنٛز اَہَم رول اَدا کَرن.
parentEnglish: Compared to CT, MRI provides better contrast in images of soft-tissues, e.g. in the brain or abdomen. However, it may be perceived as less comfortable by patients, due to the usually longer and louder measurements with the subject in a long, confining tube. Additionally, implants and other non-removable metal in the body can pose a risk and may exclude some patients from undergoing an MRI examination safely.

english: Magnetic resonance angiography (MRA) generates pictures of the arteries to evaluate them for stenosis (abnormal narrowing) or aneurysms (vessel wall dilatations, at risk of rupture).
kashmiri: ایم آر اینجِیوگرٛافی چھِ آرٹری تہٕ ویٖنَن ہٕنٛز تَصویٖر بَناون تاکہِ تِمَن مَنٛز یِیَن بؠمارِ وُچھنہٕ.
parentEnglish: Magnetic resonance angiography (MRA) generates pictures of the arteries to evaluate them for stenosis (abnormal narrowing) or aneurysms (vessel wall dilatations, at risk of rupture). MRA is often used to evaluate the arteries of the neck and brain, the thoracic and abdominal aorta, the renal arteries, and the legs (called a "run-off"). A variety of techniques can be used to generate the pictures, such as administration of a paramagnetic contrast agent (gadolinium) or using a technique known as "flow-related enhancement" (e.g., 2D and 3D time-of-flight sequences), where most of the signal on an image is due to blood that recently moved into that plane (see also FLASH MRI).[39]
parentKashmiri: ایم آر اینجِیوگرٛافی چھِ آرٹری تہٕ ویٖنَن ہٕنٛز تَصویٖر بَناون تاکہِ تِمَن مَنٛز یِیَن بؠمارِ وُچھنہٕ. ایم آر اینجِیوگرٛافی چھِ عام طور گَردَن، تھوریسِک اَیوٹا، اَیوٹِک آرٕچ، رینَل آرٹری، کَلچہٕ آرٹری تہٕ باقی وُچھنہٕ خٲطرٕ اِستِمال گَژھان. اَتھ مَنٛز چھِ واریاہ تَکنیٖک یِمو سٲتؠ تَصویٖر چھِ بَناونہٕ یِوان، اَکھ چھِ یَتھ مَنٛز گیڈولینِیَم کَنٹراسٹ اَجَنٹ دِینہٕ چھُ یِوان تَصویٖر سٲزی برٛونٛہہ بیٚاکھ چھِ بَہاوس سٲتؠ دارمدار تھاوَن، اَتھ مَنٛز چھِ سِگنَل خوٗن کِس بَہابَہاوس سٲتؠ کَم تہٕ زیادٕ گَژھان.

english: Positron emission, beta plus decay, or β+ decay is a subtype of radioactive decay called beta decay, in which a proton inside a radionuclide nucleus is converted into a neutron while releasing a positron and an electron neutrino (νe).[1] Positron emission is mediated by the weak force.
kashmiri: پازِٹرٛان اِمِشَن، بیٹا پٕلَس ڈِکے چھُ اَکھ ریڈیو ایکٹِو ڈِکے یَتھ مَنٛز ریڈیو ایکٹِو اؠٹمٕکِس نیوکِلیسَس مَنٛز پرٛوٹان چھُ نیوٹرٛانَس مَنٛز تَبدیٖل گَژھان تہٕ پازِٹران چھُ نؠبَر نیران.
parentEnglish: Positron emission, beta plus decay, or β+ decay is a subtype of radioactive decay called beta decay, in which a proton inside a radionuclide nucleus is converted into a neutron while releasing a positron and an electron neutrino (νe).[1] Positron emission is mediated by the weak force. The positron is a type of beta particle (β+), the other beta particle being the electron (β−) emitted from the β− decay of a nucleus.
parentKashmiri: پازِٹرٛان اِمِشَن، بیٹا پٕلَس ڈِکے چھُ اَکھ ریڈیو ایکٹِو ڈِکے یَتھ مَنٛز ریڈیو ایکٹِو اؠٹمٕکِس نیوکِلیسَس مَنٛز پرٛوٹان چھُ نیوٹرٛانَس مَنٛز تَبدیٖل گَژھان تہٕ پازِٹران چھُ نؠبَر نیران. پازِٹران چھُ بیٹا ڈِکے ہُنٛد اَکھ قسٕم

english: World Oceans Day is an international day that takes place annually on 8 June.
kashmiri: عالمی سۆدُر دۄہ چھُ اَکھ بَین الاقوٲمی دۄہ یُس پرٛتھ ؤری 8 جوٗن مَناونہٕ چھُ یِوان.
parentEnglish: World Oceans Day is an international day that takes place annually on 8 June. The concept was originally proposed in 1992 by Canada's International Centre for Ocean Development (ICOD) and the Ocean Institute of Canada (OIC) at the Earth Summit – UN Conference on Environment and Development (UNCED) in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.[1] "World Oceans Day" was officially recognised by the United Nations in 2008. The international day supports the implementation of worldwide Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and fosters public interest in the protection of the ocean and the sustainable management of its resources.[2]
parentKashmiri: عالمی سۆدُر دۄہ چھُ اَکھ بَین الاقوٲمی دۄہ یُس پرٛتھ ؤری 8 جوٗن مَناونہٕ چھُ یِوان. اَمیٕچ بُنیاد آت 1992 مَنٛز تَراونہٕ. یہِ آو 2008 مَنٛز اقوامِ مُتحدہ دٕس نِشادِہی کَرنہٕ

english: An atom is the smallest unit of ordinary matter that forms a chemical element.[1] Every solid, liquid, gas, and plasma is composed of neutral or ionized atoms.
kashmiri: اَکھ اؠٹَم چھُ مَوادٕچ لۄکُٹ حِصہٕ یُس کیٖمیٲیی عُنصَر بَناوَن چھُ.
parentEnglish: An atom is the smallest unit of ordinary matter that forms a chemical element.[1] Every solid, liquid, gas, and plasma is composed of neutral or ionized atoms. Atoms are extremely small, typically around 100 picometers across. They are so small that accurately predicting their behavior using classical physics—as if they were tennis balls, for example—is not possible due to quantum effects.
parentKashmiri: اَکھ اؠٹَم چھُ مَوادٕچ لۄکُٹ حِصہٕ یُس کیٖمیٲیی عُنصَر بَناوَن چھُ. کانٛہہ تہِ ٹھوس چیٖز، پٲنیُل چیٖز یا گیس چھُ اؠٹمَن ہُند بَنیومُت آسان. اؠٹَم چھِ واریاہ لۄکٕٹؠ آسان، عام طور 100 پیٖکو میٖٹَر.

english: A proton is a stable subatomic particle, symbol p , H+, or 1H+ with a positive electric charge of +1 e elementary charge.
kashmiri: پرٛوٹان چھُ اَکھ اؠٹمی مَواد یَتھ p چھُ نِشان تہٕ اَتھ چھُ اَکھ پازِٹِو چارٕج آسَن.
parentEnglish: A proton is a stable subatomic particle, symbol p , H+, or 1H+ with a positive electric charge of +1 e elementary charge. Its mass is slightly less than that of a neutron and 1836 times the mass of an electron (the proton–electron mass ratio). Protons and neutrons, each with masses of approximately one atomic mass unit, are jointly referred to as "nucleons" (particles present in atomic nuclei).

english: Compton scattering, discovered by Arthur Holly Compton, is the scattering of a high frequency photon after an interaction with a charged particle, usually an electron.
kashmiri: کامٹَن سِکیٹِرِنگ یۄس آرتھر ہولی کامٹَنَن دٕریافَت کٔرؠ چھُ سِکیٹِرِنگ ہُند اکھ قسم یَتھ مَنٛز زیادہ فرٛوکینسی دار فوٹان چھُ سِکیٹَر گَژھان ییٚلہِ یہِ چارٕج دار شے سٲتؠ عام طور اِلؠکٹرانَس سٲتؠ ٹَکراوَن چھُ.
parentEnglish: Compton scattering, discovered by Arthur Holly Compton, is the scattering of a high frequency photon after an interaction with a charged particle, usually an electron. If it results in a decrease in energy (increase in wavelength) of the photon (which may be an X-ray or gamma ray photon), it is called the Compton effect. Part of the energy of the photon is transferred to the recoiling electron.
parentKashmiri: کامٹَن سِکیٹِرِنگ یۄس آرتھر ہولی کامٹَنَن دٕریافَت کٔرؠ چھُ سِکیٹِرِنگ ہُند اکھ قسم یَتھ مَنٛز زیادہ فرٛوکینسی دار فوٹان چھُ سِکیٹَر گَژھان ییٚلہِ یہِ چارٕج دار شے سٲتؠ عام طور اِلؠکٹرانَس سٲتؠ ٹَکراوَن چھُ. اَگر اَمہِ سٲتؠ گَژھہِ اؠنَرجی کَم تیٚلہِ چھِ اتھ کامٹَن اَثر وَنان. اَمہِ پھوٹانُک طاقَتھ چھُ کیٚنٛہہ اِلؠکٹرانَس مَنز تَبدیٖلی گَژھان.

parentEnglish: Compton scattering, discovered by Arthur Holly Compton, is the scattering of a high frequency photon after an interaction with a charged particle, usually an electron. english: The first and only European Day of Radiology (EDoR) was held on February 10, 2011, to commemorate the anniversary of Röntgen's death and was organised by the European Society of Radiology(ESR).
kashmiri: یہِ دۄہ آو ریڈیالجی ہٕنٛدِ ایوروپِیَن دۄہ پَتہٕ یُس 2011 مَنز آیاو بارسَس اَنہٕ.
parentEnglish: The first and only European Day of Radiology (EDoR) was held on February 10, 2011, to commemorate the anniversary of Röntgen's death and was organised by the European Society of Radiology(ESR). Due to the success of the EDoR, the ESR entered into cooperation with the RSNA and the ACR to establish the International Day of Radiology. It was also decided that the date of the celebration should be moved from the anniversary of Röntgen's death to that of his discovery of the x-ray.

english: Cardiomegaly (sometimes megacardia or megalocardia) is a medical condition in which the heart is enlarged.
kashmiri: کاڑیومیگالی چھِ اکھ طِبی حالَتھ یَتھ مَنز دِل چھُ بۆڈ گَژھان.
parentEnglish: Cardiomegaly (sometimes megacardia or megalocardia) is a medical condition in which the heart is enlarged. As such, it is more commonly referred to simply as "having an enlarged heart". It is usually the result of underlying conditions that make the heart work harder, such as obesity, heart valve disease, high blood pressure (hypertension), and coronary artery disease.

parentEnglish: Vitamin D provides a hormone-like function, regulating mineral metabolism for bones and other organs. parentEnglish: The pudendal nerve is the main nerve of the perineum.[1]: 274 It carries sensation from the external genitalia of both sexes and the skin around the anus and perineum, as well as the motor supply to various pelvic muscles, including the male or female external urethral sphincter and the external anal sphincter. english: Abdur Rehman Rahi (6 May 1925 – 9 January 2023) was an Kashmiri poet, translator and critic.
kashmiri: رَحمان راہی اوس اکھ کٲشُر شٲیِر تہٕ تَرجَمہٕ کار.
parentEnglish: Abdur Rehman Rahi (6 May 1925 – 9 January 2023) was an Kashmiri poet, translator and critic. He was awarded the Indian Sahitya Akademi Award in 1961 for his poetry collection Nawroz-i-Saba, the Padma Shri in 2000,[1] and India's highest literary award, the Jnanpith Award (for the year 2004) in 2007. He is the first Kashmiri writer to be awarded the Jnanpith, India's highest literary award for his poetic collection Siyah Rood Jaeren Manz (In Black Drizzle ).
parentKashmiri: رَحمان راہی اوس اکھ کٲشُر شٲیِر تہٕ تَرجَمہٕ کار. اَمِس اوس ہِندوستان ساہِتیاایکاڈمی یَنام میلومُت 1961 مَنز نَوزوزِ صُبَح شٲیِری خٲطرٕ. تہٕ پَدَم شِری 2000 مَنٛز.

parentEnglish: Marwah is a valley and sub-division in the Kishtwar district of Jammu and Kashmir in India.[2] Marwah is surrounded by the Warwan valley to the southwest, Ladakh and Zanskar to the east, Chatroo and Kishtwar to the south, and Anantnag in the west. english: Jammu and Kashmir, officially known as the Princely State of Kashmir and Jammu,[2] was a princely state during the Company rule in India from 1757 to 1858 as well as the British Raj in India from 1846 to 1952.
kashmiri: جۆم تہٕ کٔشیٖر، سَرکٲرؠ طور ٲسؠ اکھ شاہزٲدؠ رِیاسَتھ 1757 پؠٹھ 1858 تام.
parentEnglish: Jammu and Kashmir, officially known as the Princely State of Kashmir and Jammu,[2] was a princely state during the Company rule in India from 1757 to 1858 as well as the British Raj in India from 1846 to 1952. The princely state was created after the First Anglo-Sikh War, from the territories that had earlier been in the Sikh Empire.

english: Lal Ded Memorial School is one of the oldest high schools in Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir, India.
kashmiri: لَل دؠد میموریَل سۆکوٗل چھُ اکھ ساروٕے کھوتہٕ پرٛون ہایی سۆکوٗل سیرینگر جۆم تہٕ کٔشیٖر مَنٛز.
parentEnglish: Lal Ded Memorial School is one of the oldest high schools in Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir, India. It is located on the bank of the Jhelum River near 2nd Bridge Habba Kadal. The school is named after the saint-poet Lalleshwari, commonly known as Lal Ded, and was built in the colonial style with the use of local techniques, especially Kashmir wooden crafts.

english: Government of Andhra Pradesh allotted 66 acres of land to IIIT Hyderabad in 1998 located on the main Gachibowli road, also known as the old Bombay highway.
kashmiri: آندھرا پردیشک حکومتن کوٚر 1998 منٛز آئی آئی ٹی حیدرآبادس 66 ایکڑ زمین مختص، یُس گوڑنک گیچیبولی روڈس پیٹھ واقع چُھ، یُس پران بمبئی ہائی وے کہ ناو سۭتۍ تہٕ زانٛو۔
parentEnglish: Government of Andhra Pradesh allotted 66 acres of land to IIIT Hyderabad in 1998 located on the main Gachibowli road, also known as the old Bombay highway. english: Bai was a contemporary of Bhartendu Harishchandra, and corresponded with him and took his advice and opinion on poetic expression.
kashmiri: بائی أس اَکھ بھارتینڈو ہریچندرا سٕنٛز ہَم عصر، تہٕ روز تٕمی سٕے سٕتی تہٕ تِہٕنٛز نصیحت رٕٹٕکھ تہٕ رجوع کرُکھ شٲعری حالس کُن.
parentEnglish: Bai was a contemporary of Bhartendu Harishchandra, and corresponded with him and took his advice and opinion on poetic expression. Her thumri and other subgenres of thumri were published as Madhu Tarang (Sharma, 2012). Harishchandra also got her to compose Geet Govind by Jaidev.
parentKashmiri: بائی أس اَکھ بھارتینڈو ہریچندرا سٕنٛز ہَم عصر، تہٕ روز تٕمی سٕے سٕتی تہٕ تِہٕنٛز نصیحت رٕٹٕکھ تہٕ رجوع کرُکھ شٲعری حالس کُن. یِہِنٛز تُھمری تہٕ باقٕی تُمھری ہِنٛدی چیٖز آیہِ شایعہ کرنہٕ مدہو تَرَنٛگ (شرما، ۲۰۱۲). ہَریٖچندراہن کٕری یِمہٕ منتخب گیٖت گووِنٛد خٲطرٕ تہِ.

english: As with Malik ibn Anas (who was a teacher of Imam al-Shafi'i,[1][2]: 121 who in turn was a teacher of Sunni Imam Ahmad ibn Hanbal), Imam Abu Hanifa was a student of Ja'far al-Sadiq, who was a descendant of the Islamic Nabi (Prophet) Muhammad.
kashmiri: حالانکہ مالک ابن انس (امام ال-شافی سٕنٛدی وۄستاد,[1][2]: 121 یِمہٕ پانہٕ ٲسی امام احمد بن حنبل سٕنٛدی ووستاد)، امام ابو حنیفہ ٲسی اکھ طٲلب حضرت جعفر ال-صادق سٕنٛدی، یِمہٕ اِسلٲمی نبی (رسول) حضرت محمد مصطفیﷺ سٕنٛدی زُرؠیات مٕنٛز ٲسی.
parentEnglish: As with Malik ibn Anas (who was a teacher of Imam al-Shafi'i,[1][2]: 121 who in turn was a teacher of Sunni Imam Ahmad ibn Hanbal), Imam Abu Hanifa was a student of Ja'far al-Sadiq, who was a descendant of the Islamic Nabi (Prophet) Muhammad. Thus all of the four great Imams of Sunni Fiqh are connected to Ja'far from the Bayt (Household) of Muhammad, whether directly or indirectly.[3]

english: Under conditions of long sunny days, such as those found at high northern latitudes in summer, cabbages can grow quite large.
kashmiri: اکھ بَنٛدگوٗپی چھُ عام طور 500 پؠٹھ 1000 گرٛام وَزنہٕ آسان.نَرٕم ؤتھٕر دار، سَبٕز بَنٛدگوٗپی چھِ زیإ مشہور.
parentEnglish: Under conditions of long sunny days, such as those found at high northern latitudes in summer, cabbages can grow quite large. As of 2012[update], the heaviest cabbage was 62.71 kilograms (138 lb 4 oz). Cabbage heads are generally picked during the first year of the plant's life cycle, but plants intended for seed are allowed to grow a second year and must be kept separate from other cole crops to prevent cross-pollination.
parentKashmiri: اکھ بَنٛدگوٗپی چھُ عام طور 500 پؠٹھ 1000 گرٛام وَزنہٕ آسان.نَرٕم ؤتھٕر دار، سَبٕز بَنٛدگوٗپی چھِ زیإ مشہور. باقٕے زَنٛگہٕ دار بَنٛدگوٗپی چھِ نایاب تہٕ کَم لَبنہٕ یِوان.یَتھ جاے زیٖٹھ تاپہٕ دۄہَن آسان چھِ تَتہِ چھِ بَنٛدگوٗپی ہٕنٛز پٲداوار زیاد آسان. یہِ چھُ عام طور شُمٲلؠ طَرفہٕ بُلند جاؠن پؠٹھ وُچھنہٕ یِوان.َ2012 تام، ساروی کھوتہٕ بۆڈ بَنٛدگوٗپی اوس 62.71 کِلوگرٛام (138 پونڈ 4 اوز) وَزنہٕ.بَنٛدگوٗپی کَلہٕ چھِ عام طور کُلؠ کہِ زِندگی ہٕنٛدِ گۄڈٕنیک ؤریہِ تُلنہٕ یِوان، مَگر یِم بَنٛدگوٗپی بؠلہِ خٲطرٕ آسَن، تِم چھِ بیٚیِس ؤریَس خٲطرٕ تہِ تھاونہٕ یِوان تہٕ گَژھَن باقٕے فَصَلن نِش اَلگ تھاونہٕ یِن تاکہِ کراس پالنیشَن ییٚہِ رُکاونہٕ.بَنٛدگوٗپیَن چھُ غزٲیی کمی ، تہٕ بیکٹیریل تہٕ فَنٛگل بؠمارین ہُنٛد خَدشہٕ روزان۔

parentEnglish: Under conditions of long sunny days, such as those found at high northern latitudes in summer, cabbages can grow quite large. As of 2012[update], the heaviest cabbage was 62.71 kilograms (138 lb 4 oz). Cabbage heads are generally picked during the first year of the plant's life cycle, but plants intended for seed are allowed to grow a second year and must be kept separate from other cole crops to prevent cross-pollination.

english: The purpose of personal protective equipment is to reduce employee exposure to hazards when engineering controls and administrative controls are not feasible or effective to reduce these risks to acceptable levels.
kashmiri: ذٲتی حؠفاظتی سامانن ہنٛد مقصد چُھ امہٕ خطرٕ سٟتؠ مُلٲزَِم بَچاونؠ۔
parentEnglish: The purpose of personal protective equipment is to reduce employee exposure to hazards when engineering controls and administrative controls are not feasible or effective to reduce these risks to acceptable levels. PPE is needed when there are hazards present. PPE has the serious limitation that it does not eliminate the hazard at the source and may result in employees being exposed to the hazard if the equipment fails.[1]

english: Khagen Mahanta has been decorated numerous times nationally and internationally for his contributions.
kashmiri: کھاگیٚن مہَانتا ہَن آو واریاہ لٹہِ ینعام دِنہٕ ریستی طور پٲٹھی تہِ تہٕ بینُ الاقوٲمی طور پٲٹھی تہِ، تِہنٛدِ شِرکژو خٲطرٕ.
parentEnglish: Khagen Mahanta has been decorated numerous times nationally and internationally for his contributions. He was also awarded the Sangeet Natak Academy award for folk and traditional music in 1992.[2]

english: Khagen Mahanta was born to Kalita caste Harendra Nath Mahanta and Laxmipriya Devi in Nagaon, Assam.
kashmiri: کھاگیٚن مہَانتا زایہِ کالِٹا زٲژ ہرنٛدراناتھ تہٕ مہَانتا تہٕ لکسمیپریا دیوی ہَس ناگاؤں، آسامس مٕنٛز.
parentEnglish: Khagen Mahanta was born to Kalita caste Harendra Nath Mahanta and Laxmipriya Devi in Nagaon, Assam. He showed his musical talent from his childhood. At the age of fifteen he started performing in concerts in Shillong, where he was well received.
parentKashmiri: کھاگیٚن مہَانتا زایہِ کالِٹا زٲژ ہرنٛدراناتھ تہٕ مہَانتا تہٕ لکسمیپریا دیوی ہَس ناگاؤں، آسامس مٕنٛز. یِمو ہٲو پنٕنی کارکردگی پنٔنہِ بچپنہٕ پؠٹھے. ییٚلہِ یِمہٕ پنٛدہ وُہُری ٲسی یِمو کۄٚر شروع پنٕنی کارکردگی شِلانگ کؠن اجلاسن مٕنٛز، ییتہِ یمن حوصلہٕ افزٲئ گٕی جان.

english: He was married to Archana Mahanta, also an Assamese folk singer.

parentEnglish: He was married to Archana Mahanta, also an Assamese folk singer. They performed together on many occasions, popularising Assamese folk music and earning a name as the most popular duet singers.[citation needed] Their son Angaraag Mahanta is also a singer like his parents and is popular in the genre of modern Assamese music; he lived in Mumbai. He has two grandchildren, Puhor and Parijaat.

parentEnglish: After Shah Jahan recovered from his illness in July 1658, Aurangzeb imprisoned his father in Agra Fort from July 1658 until his death in January 1666.[1] He was laid to rest next to his wife in the Taj Mahal. english: The flag was adopted on 24 September 1975 via the Azad Jammu and Kashmir State Flag Ordinance, passed by founding President Sardar Muhammad Ibrahim Khan.[1] It was designed in 1948 by Abdul Haq Mirza, a mujahid working at the Rawalpindi headquarters of the Azad Kashmir rebellion, as the "Kashmir Liberation Flag".

parentEnglish: The flag was adopted on 24 September 1975 via the Azad Jammu and Kashmir State Flag Ordinance, passed by founding President Sardar Muhammad Ibrahim Khan.[1] It was designed in 1948 by Abdul Haq Mirza, a mujahid working at the Rawalpindi headquarters of the Azad Kashmir rebellion, as the "Kashmir Liberation Flag". Mirza also created the formation signs of the Kashmir Liberation Force.[2][3]

english: Its border location gives it strategic significance.
kashmiri: اَکھنوٗر، چوکی چورہ تہٕ کھور۔
parentEnglish: Akhnoor is on the bank of the Chenab River, just before it enters the Pakistani Punjab. Its border location gives it strategic significance. The Akhnoor area is divided into three administrative sub-divisions - Akhnoor, Chowki Choura and Khour; Seven Tehsils - Akhnoor Khaas, Chowki Choura, Maira Mandrian, Jourian, Kharah Balli, Khour & Pargwal.
parentKashmiri: اَکھنوٗر چھُ ہِندوستان کِس جۆم تہٕ کٔشیٖر ہٕنٛدِس جۆم ضِلس مَنٛز جۆم شَہَر نَذدیٖکھ اَکھ شَہَر.یہِ چھُ جۆم شَہَر پؠٹھ 28 کِلومیٖٹَر دوٗر.اَکھنوٗر چھُ چِناب دٔرؠ یاو کِس بٕٹھِس پؠٹھ واقَع.سَرحَد نَذدیٖکھ آسنہٕ سٟتؠ چھِ اَکھ اَہَم اَہمِیَتھ اکھنوٗر علاقہٕ چُھ ترٛیٚو انتظٲمی ذیلی حِصَن منٛز تقسیم کرنہٕ آمت۔ اَکھنوٗر، چوکی چورہ تہٕ کھور۔ سَتھ تَحصیل - اَکھنوٗر خاص، چوکی چورہ، مایرا مندریان، جوورین، خارا بالی، کھور تہٕ پرگوال۔
usageCondition: Preserve original license, attribution and applicable share-alike obligations.

english: Paban Das Baul (born 1961) is a noted Baul singer and musician from India, who also plays a dubki, a small tambourine and sometimes an ektara as an accompaniment.
kashmiri: پَبن داس باعُل (زاے ۱۹۶۱) چھِ اکھ باعُل گلوٗکار تہٕ موٗسیٖکار ہندوستانٕکی، یمو بییہٚ اکھ دُبکی تہِ چھِ کار کۄٚرمُت، اکھ لۄٚکٕٹ تمبوریٖن تہٕ کُنہِ وقتہٕ اِکتارا بہ حیثیت سٲتھی.
parentEnglish: Paban Das Baul (born 1961) is a noted Baul singer and musician from India, who also plays a dubki, a small tambourine and sometimes an ektara as an accompaniment. He is known for pioneering traditional Baul music on the international music scene and for establishing a genre of folk-fusion music.[3]
parentKashmiri: پَبن داس باعُل (زاے ۱۹۶۱) چھِ اکھ باعُل گلوٗکار تہٕ موٗسیٖکار ہندوستانٕکی، یمو بییہٚ اکھ دُبکی تہِ چھِ کار کۄٚرمُت، اکھ لۄٚکٕٹ تمبوریٖن تہٕ کُنہِ وقتہٕ اِکتارا بہ حیثیت سٲتھی. یمہٕ چھِ یوان زانٔنہٕ روایتی باعل موٗسیقی سرخیل جرنس بین الاقوٲمی موٗسیقی سیٖن تہٕ بُنیاد تراوٕنی اکہِ لُکہٕ - واٹھ موٗسیقی ہِنٛز.

parentEnglish: He didn't earn much from his profession. His only source of income was his job at a broadcast network Radio Pakistan. The salary which was being offered to him, was inadequate to fulfill his medication requirements, and on May 23, 1980, he died in poverty at Peshawar, but died in a dignified manner.[1][2]

english: In 2005, he was nominated for his award on the Independence Day (Pakistan) (14 August 2005).

parentEnglish: In 2005, he was nominated for his award on the Independence Day (Pakistan) (14 August 2005). He was officially conferred his Tamgha-i-Imtiaz (Medal of Distinction) Award on the following Pakistan Day (23 March 2006).[5]

english: After completing her bachelors of medicine and surgery from Frontier Medical College, she released her first album Dhola in 2008 and received critical appraisal.
kashmiri: بیچلٲرٕس آف میڈسن تہٕ سٕرجٕری مکمل کٕرِتھ فراٹائر میٚڈکل کالیٚج پؠٹھہٕ، یمو تروو پنُن گۄٚڈٕ نیوٚک ایلبم ڈھولا ۲۰۰۸ مٕنٛز.
parentEnglish: After completing her bachelors of medicine and surgery from Frontier Medical College, she released her first album Dhola in 2008 and received critical appraisal. She completed her medical degree in 2011 and released three more albums including Nigah-e-Karam, Apna Mukaam Paida Kar and Kamli. Kamli added further recognition for her singing career and she received Best Emerging Talent – Music nomination at the 15th Lux Style Awards.[2]
parentKashmiri: بیچلٲرٕس آف میڈسن تہٕ سٕرجٕری مکمل کٕرِتھ فراٹائر میٚڈکل کالیٚج پؠٹھہٕ، یمو تروو پنُن گۄٚڈٕ نیوٚک ایلبم ڈھولا ۲۰۰۸ مٕنٛز. ۲۰۱۱ مٕنٛز کٕر یمو پنٕنی میٚڈکل ڈگری مکمل تہٕ ترےٚ ایٚلبم ترٲوِکھ بییہٚ نگاہِ کرم، اپنا مکام پیدا کر تہٕ کملی. کملی سٕتی ہُریاو امن بییہٚ زان اہنٛدس گلوٗکای مٕنٛز تہٕ کۄٚرُکھ حٲصل بہترین امٲرجِنٛگ ٹیلین – موٗسیقی مَنظوٗری ۱۵-لکٕس سٹائل وٕظیٖفہٕ.

english: Sanchita Bhattacharya (born 19 February 1992) is an Indian playback singer, composer and television personality.
kashmiri: سَنچیٖتا بھٹاچاریا (زاے ۱۹ فروٕری ۱۹۹۲) چھےٚ اکھ ہندوستٲنی ہمسٲتھی گلوٗکار، تریٖب دنہٕ واجٕنی تہٕ ٹیلیوجن شخصیت.
parentEnglish: Sanchita Bhattacharya (born 19 February 1992) is an Indian playback singer, composer and television personality. At the age of 14, this makes her the oldest winner in the Sa Re Ga Ma Pa L'il Champs history as well as the first female winner with public voting. She has recorded songs for films and albums in various Indian languages.[1][2][3][4]
parentKashmiri: سَنچیٖتا بھٹاچاریا (زاے ۱۹ فروٕری ۱۹۹۲) چھےٚ اکھ ہندوستٲنی ہمسٲتھی گلوٗکار، تریٖب دنہٕ واجٕنی تہٕ ٹیلیوجن شخصیت. ۱۴ وٲنٛژھ وٲتِتھ، یہِ بنے ساروٕے لۄٚکٕٹی وجیتا سا رے گا ما پا لال چیمپٕس اندر بییہٚ گۄٚڈٕ نِچ زنان یٕمی زیوٗن عوٲمی ووٹو سٕتی. اِمو چھِ کٕریمٕتی بٲتھ رکاڈ فلمن خٲطرٕ تہٕ ایٚلبم مُختلف ہندوستٲنی زبانن.

english: Pritam is best remembered for her poignant poem, Ajj aakhaan Waris Shah nu (Today I invoke Waris Shah – "Ode to Waris Shah"), an elegy to the 18th-century Punjabi poet, an expression of her anguish over massacres during the partition of India.
kashmiri: پریتم چِھ پننہِ دِلکش نظم، اج آکھان وارِس شاہ نو خٲطرٕ ساروی کھوتہٕ زیادٕ یاد یوان کرنہٕ، یۄس 18 مہِ صٔدی ہٕنٛز اَہَم نظم چھِ.
parentEnglish: Pritam is best remembered for her poignant poem, Ajj aakhaan Waris Shah nu (Today I invoke Waris Shah – "Ode to Waris Shah"), an elegy to the 18th-century Punjabi poet, an expression of her anguish over massacres during the partition of India. As a novelist, her most noted work was Pinjar ("The Skeleton", 1950), in which she created her memorable character, Puro, an epitome of violence against women, loss of humanity and ultimate surrender to existential fate; the novel was made into an award-winning film, Pinjar (2003).[1][2]
parentKashmiri: پریتم چِھ پننہِ دِلکش نظم، اج آکھان وارِس شاہ نو خٲطرٕ ساروی کھوتہٕ زیادٕ یاد یوان کرنہٕ، یۄس 18 مہِ صٔدی ہٕنٛز اَہَم نظم چھِ. اَتھ مَنٛز چھِ پریتم ہندوستان کَس تقسیمس دوران قتل عامن پیٹھ پننہِ پریشٲنی ہُنٛد اِظہار کَران۔

english: The ear may be affected by disease, including infection and traumatic damage.
kashmiri: کَنَن ہیٚکہِ بؠمٲرؠ تہٕ لٕگِتھ یِمَن مَنٛز اِنفیکشن تہٕ صدمٲتی نقصان شٲمِل چھِ۔
parentEnglish: The ear may be affected by disease, including infection and traumatic damage. Diseases of the ear may lead to hearing loss, tinnitus and balance disorders such as vertigo, although many of these conditions may also be affected by damage to the brain or neural pathways leading from the ear.
parentKashmiri: کَنَن ہیٚکہِ بؠمٲرؠ تہٕ لٕگِتھ یِمَن مَنٛز اِنفیکشن تہٕ صدمٲتی نقصان شٲمِل چھِ۔ کَنَن ہٕنٛز بؠماریہِ ہیٚکَن کَنَس نقصان، ٹیننٹس تہٕ توازنٕچ خرٲبی کٔرِتھ یتھکن ورٹیگو، حالانکہ یم حالتھ ہیٚکَن دؠماغَس تہٕ باقٕے نٲرَن تہِ نوقصان واتٕنٲوِتھ.

english: Founded in 1768 by Mian Ghulam Shah Kalhoro of the Kalhora Dynasty, Hyderabad served as a provincial capital until the British transferred the capital to Bombay presidency in 1840.
kashmiri: 1768 منٛز ترٛٲو کالھورا خاندانک میان غلام شاہ کالھورو اَتھ بُنیاد، حیدرآباد کٔرؠ صوبائی دارالحکومت پٲٹھۍ خدمت یوتتھ تام زِ برطانوی انِتِظٲمؠ کوٚر 1840 منٛز دارالحکومت بمبئی صدارتی ریاستس منٛز منتقل۔
parentEnglish: Founded in 1768 by Mian Ghulam Shah Kalhoro of the Kalhora Dynasty, Hyderabad served as a provincial capital until the British transferred the capital to Bombay presidency in 1840. It is about 150 kilometres (93 mi) inland of Karachi, the largest city of Pakistan, to which it is connected by a direct railway and M-9 motorway.

english: Jamiat Ulema-e-Hind established the Idara Mabahith-e-Fiqhiyyah (Institute of Juristic Discussions) in 1970 and Muhammad Miyan Deobandi was appointed its first director.[17][1] The institute organized its fifteenth juristic seminar in March 2019.[2] The seminar discussed whether Google AdSense, Paytm cash and other things related with mobile and internet were allowed under Islamic law.
kashmiri: جمعیت عُلما ہِندن کوٚر 1970 منٛز ادارا مباہیتھ-ای-فقیہ (انستیتوت آف جریسیٹک بحث) قائم تہٕ محمد مییان دیوبندی آو اَمِیُک گۄڑنیک ڈائریکٹر مقرر کَرنہٕ.[17][1] اِدارَن کوٚر مارچ 2019 منٛز پننہٕ پَندہٲیِم قونونی سیمینار مُنَقٕد.[2] سیمینارس منٛز آے یہِ کَتھ تُلنہٕ زِ گوٗگٕل ایڈسینس، پیے ٹی ایم کیش تہٕ موبٲیِل تہٕ انٹرنیٹس سۭتۍ متلق باقٕے چیزن چھا شٔریَتھ قونون مُطٲبِق صٔحیح.
parentEnglish: Jamiat Ulema-e-Hind established the Idara Mabahith-e-Fiqhiyyah (Institute of Juristic Discussions) in 1970 and Muhammad Miyan Deobandi was appointed its first director.[17][1] The institute organized its fifteenth juristic seminar in March 2019.[2] The seminar discussed whether Google AdSense, Paytm cash and other things related with mobile and internet were allowed under Islamic law. It was attended by Muslim jurists including Saeed Ahmad Palanpuri and Shabbir Ahmad Qasmi.[2]

english: The Jamiat Youth Club was established in July 2018.
kashmiri: جمیات یوتھ کٕلب آو جولائی 2018 منٛز قائم کَرنہٕ۔
parentEnglish: The Jamiat Youth Club was established in July 2018. It aims to provide youth with training in different self-defense techniques to deal with community crises.[1] It was called a "pilot project" and it was reported that the Jamiat expects to train about 1.25 million youngsters every year and about 12.5 million youth in over a hundred Indian districts are expected to join the Jamiat Youth Club by 2028.[1][2] Mahmood Madani said that the club will train the youth like the Scouts and Guides, with an emphasis on physical training and different ways to strengthen their mental ability.[2]
parentKashmiri: جمیات یوتھ کٕلب آو جولائی 2018 منٛز قائم کَرنہٕ۔ امک مقصد چُھ نوجوانن کمیونٹی مَسلَن سۭتۍ نمٹنہٕ خٲطرٕ مُختلِف دِفٲعی تکنیکن منٛز تربیت فراہم کَرُن۔[1] یہٕ اوس اکھ "پایلاٹ پروجیکٹ" تہٕ یہٕ آو رَپورٹھ کرنہٕ زِ جامیات چُھ پرٛتھ ؤریہِ تقریباً 1.25 ملین نوجوانن ہنٛز تربیت کرنٕچ توقع تھاوان تہٕ تقریباً 12.5 ملین چھِ ہندوستانی ضٕلَن منٛز 2028 تام جامیات یوتھ کلبس منٛز شمولیتک توقع۔.[1][2] محمود مدنین وون زِ یِم کلب چھِ نوجوانن سکاؤٹس تہٕ گائیڈز ہیند تربیت کران، جِسمٲنی تربیت تہٕ یمن ہنٛز ذہنی صَلٲہِتَن مضبوط کرنہٕ خٲطرٕ مختلف طریٖقن پیٹھ زور دِوان.[2]

english: University has signed an MoU with La Verne, California for short term, and long-term programs along with Faculty and Student Exchange program.[10] A MoU has also been Signed with National Stock Exchange of India Academy to offer programs to students of Management.
kashmiri: یونیورسٹین کوٚر فیکلٹی تہٕ طالب علم تبادلہ پروگرامس سٟتؠ مل کر کیلیفورنیا کہِ لا ورنی سٟتؠ مختصر مدتس تہِ طویل مدتی پروگرامن خٲطرٕ اکھ ایم او یوس پؠٹھ دستخط۔[1] نیشنل اسٹاک ایکسچینج آف انڈیا اکیڈمی سٕتۍ چُھ مینیجمنٹ سِک طٲلبہِ عٔلمَن خٲطرٕ پروگرام پیش کرنہٕ خٲطرِ اکھ ایم او یو تہٕ دستخط کرنہِ آمُت۔
parentEnglish: University has signed an MoU with La Verne, California for short term, and long-term programs along with Faculty and Student Exchange program.[10] A MoU has also been Signed with National Stock Exchange of India Academy to offer programs to students of Management. LearnVern, An Online Learning portal also has signed MoU with GNA University.[11] This university also joined Oracle Workforce Development Program (WDP) which is governed by Oracle University, USA, to develop students for latest industry trends.[12]
parentKashmiri: یونیورسٹین کوٚر فیکلٹی تہٕ طالب علم تبادلہ پروگرامس سٟتؠ مل کر کیلیفورنیا کہِ لا ورنی سٟتؠ مختصر مدتس تہِ طویل مدتی پروگرامن خٲطرٕ اکھ ایم او یوس پؠٹھ دستخط۔[1] نیشنل اسٹاک ایکسچینج آف انڈیا اکیڈمی سٕتۍ چُھ مینیجمنٹ سِک طٲلبہِ عٔلمَن خٲطرٕ پروگرام پیش کرنہٕ خٲطرِ اکھ ایم او یو تہٕ دستخط کرنہِ آمُت۔ LearnVern، اکھ آن لایِن ہیٚچھنُک پورٹل تہٕ چُھ جی این اے یونیورسٹی سٟتؠ ایم او یوس پؠٹھ دستخط کرمُت۔[2] یہٕ یونیورسٹی گو اوراکل ورک فورس ڈویلپمنٹ پروگرامس (WDP) منز تہٕ شٲمل یم اورکل یونیورسٹی، امریکہ کہِ زیر انتظام چِھ، تاکہ صنعت کہٕ جدید ترین رجحانات خٲطرٕہ طلباء تیار کرنہٕ۔[3]

english: Char Chinar, also sometimes called Char Chinari, Ropa Lank, or Rupa Lank, is an island in Dal Lake, Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir.
kashmiri: چار چینار، یتھ کُنہِ ساتہٕ چار چناری، روپا لنک یا روپ لنکس تہٕ ونان چِھ، چھُ جۆم تہٕ کٔشیٖر، سری نگر، دل سَرس منٛز اکھ جزیرٕ۔
parentEnglish: Char Chinar, also sometimes called Char Chinari, Ropa Lank, or Rupa Lank, is an island in Dal Lake, Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir. Dal Lake includes 3 islands, 2 of which are marked with beautiful Chinar trees. The island located on the Lakut Dal (small Dal) is known as Roph Lank (Silver Island), is marked with the presence of majestic Chinar trees at the four corners, thus known as Char-Chinari (Four Chinars).[1][2] The second Chinar Island, known as Sone Lank (Gold Island), is located on the Bod Dal (Big Dal) and overlooks the holy shrine of Hazratbal.[2]
parentKashmiri: چار چینار، یتھ کُنہِ ساتہٕ چار چناری، روپا لنک یا روپ لنکس تہٕ ونان چِھ، چھُ جۆم تہٕ کٔشیٖر، سری نگر، دل سَرس منٛز اکھ جزیرٕ۔ ڈل سَرس منز چِھ 3 جزیرٕ شٲمل، یمن منٛز زٕ چھِ خوبصورت بۄنہِ کُلؠو سٟتؠ نشان زد۔ لۄکُٹ ڈَلس پیٹھ واقع جزیرٕ چُھ روف لنک (سلور جزیرہ) ناوٕ سٟتؠ تہِ زاننہٕ یوان، تہٕ ژور کوٗنَن پیٹھ چِھ شاندار بۄنہِ کُلؠن ہنز موجودگی سٟتؠ نشان زد، یتھ پٲٹھؠ چھِ اَتھ چار چِنار ونان۔[1][2] دوٚیم چِنار جزیرٕ یُس سون لینک (گولڈ جزیرٕ) کہ ناو سٟتؠ تہِ زاننہٕ چُھ یوان، چھُ بٕڈِس ڈَل (بگ ڈیل) مَنث واقع تہٕ چھہِ حَضرتبل مقامس پیٹھ نظر یوان۔[2]

kashmiri: لۄکُٹ ڈَلس پیٹھ واقع جزیرٕ چُھ روف لنک (سلور جزیرہ) ناوٕ سٟتؠ تہِ زاننہٕ یوان، تہٕ ژور کوٗنَن پیٹھ چِھ شاندار بۄنہِ کُلؠن ہنز موجودگی سٟتؠ نشان زد، یتھ پٲٹھؠ چھِ اَتھ چار چِنار ونان۔[1][2] دوٚیم چِنار جزیرٕ یُس سون لینک (گولڈ جزیرٕ) کہ ناو سٟتؠ تہِ زاننہٕ چُھ یوان، چھُ بٕڈِس ڈَل (بگ ڈیل) مَنث واقع تہٕ چھہِ حَضرتبل مقامس پیٹھ نظر یوان۔[2]
parentEnglish: Char Chinar, also sometimes called Char Chinari, Ropa Lank, or Rupa Lank, is an island in Dal Lake, Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir. Dal Lake includes 3 islands, 2 of which are marked with beautiful Chinar trees. The island located on the Lakut Dal (small Dal) is known as Roph Lank (Silver Island), is marked with the presence of majestic Chinar trees at the four corners, thus known as Char-Chinari (Four Chinars).[1][2] The second Chinar Island, known as Sone Lank (Gold Island), is located on the Bod Dal (Big Dal) and overlooks the holy shrine of Hazratbal.[2]
parentKashmiri: چار چینار، یتھ کُنہِ ساتہٕ چار چناری، روپا لنک یا روپ لنکس تہٕ ونان چِھ، چھُ جۆم تہٕ کٔشیٖر، سری نگر، دل سَرس منٛز اکھ جزیرٕ۔ ڈل سَرس منز چِھ 3 جزیرٕ شٲمل، یمن منٛز زٕ چھِ خوبصورت بۄنہِ کُلؠو سٟتؠ نشان زد۔ لۄکُٹ ڈَلس پیٹھ واقع جزیرٕ چُھ روف لنک (سلور جزیرہ) ناوٕ سٟتؠ تہِ زاننہٕ یوان، تہٕ ژور کوٗنَن پیٹھ چِھ شاندار بۄنہِ کُلؠن ہنز موجودگی سٟتؠ نشان زد، یتھ پٲٹھؠ چھِ اَتھ چار چِنار ونان۔[1][2] دوٚیم چِنار جزیرٕ یُس سون لینک (گولڈ جزیرٕ) کہ ناو سٟتؠ تہِ زاننہٕ چُھ یوان، چھُ بٕڈِس ڈَل (بگ ڈیل) مَنث واقع تہٕ چھہِ حَضرتبل مقامس پیٹھ نظر یوان۔[2]

parentEnglish: This deer lives in groups of two to 18 individuals in dense riverine forests, high valleys, and mountains of the Kashmir valley and northern Chamba in Himachal Pradesh. english: Patiala (Punjabi pronunciation: [pʌʈeɑ̈ːɭɑ]) is a city in southeastern Punjab, northwestern India.
kashmiri: پٹیالہ چھُ شُمٲلؠ مَغربی ہِندوستان کِس جنوٗب مَشرِقی پنجابس منز اکھ شَہَر۔
parentEnglish: Patiala (Punjabi pronunciation: [pʌʈeɑ̈ːɭɑ]) is a city in southeastern Punjab, northwestern India. It is the fourth largest city in the state and is the administrative capital of Patiala district. Patiala is located around the Qila Mubarak (the 'Fortunate Castle') constructed by the Sidhu Jat Sikh chieftain Ala Singh, who founded the royal dynasty of Patiala State in 1763, and after whom the city is named.
parentKashmiri: پٹیالہ چھُ شُمٲلؠ مَغربی ہِندوستان کِس جنوٗب مَشرِقی پنجابس منز اکھ شَہَر۔ یہٕ چُھ ریاستُک ژورِم نمبرُن ساروی کھوتہٕ بوٚڑ شَہَر تہٕ چھُ پٹیالہ ضِلُک اِنتظٲمؠ دارالحکومت۔ پٹیالہ چُھ قِلا مبارک ('فورتنٹ کیسل') کہِ آس پاس واقع، یمِ سِدھو جَت سکھ سربراہ علا سنگھ بناونہٕ آمُت، یُس 1763 منٛز پتیالَہٕ ریاستُک شاہی خاندانُکی بنیاد ڈٲی، تہٕ یمن پتہٕ چِھ شہرُن ناوٕ لگان۔

english: Venography (also called phlebography or ascending phlebography) is a procedure in which an X-ray of the veins, a venogram, is taken after a special dye is injected into the bone marrow or veins.
kashmiri: وینوگرافی (یتھ فھلبوگرافی یا اَسینڈینگ فھلبوگرافی تہٕ ونان چھِ) چھُ اکھ طریٖقہٕ کار یَےھ منٛز أڈجَن ہٕنٛز وَس نخس یا رگن منٛز اکھ خاص قٕسمُک کَنٹراسٹ انجکشن کرنہٕ پتہٕ رگَن ہُنٛد اؠکس رے (وینگرام) تُلنہٕ چھُ یِوان۔
parentEnglish: Venography (also called phlebography or ascending phlebography) is a procedure in which an X-ray of the veins, a venogram, is taken after a special dye is injected into the bone marrow or veins. The dye has to be injected constantly via a catheter, making it an invasive procedure. Normally the catheter is inserted by the groin and moved to the appropriate site by navigating through the vascular system.
parentKashmiri: وینوگرافی (یتھ فھلبوگرافی یا اَسینڈینگ فھلبوگرافی تہٕ ونان چھِ) چھُ اکھ طریٖقہٕ کار یَےھ منٛز أڈجَن ہٕنٛز وَس نخس یا رگن منٛز اکھ خاص قٕسمُک کَنٹراسٹ انجکشن کرنہٕ پتہٕ رگَن ہُنٛد اؠکس رے (وینگرام) تُلنہٕ چھُ یِوان۔ رنگ چُھ مسلسل اَکہِ کیٹھیٹر کہِ ذریعہِ انجکشن کرنہٕ یوان. عام طور چُھ کیتھیٹر دٲخل کرنہٕ یوان تہٕ رَگَن ہٕنٛدِس نظامس منٛز مُنٲسِب مُقامَس تام پَکناونہٕ یوان۔

english: South Asia is the southern subregion of Asia, which is defined in both geographical and ethnic-cultural terms.
kashmiri: جنوبی ایشیا چھ ایشیاءک جنوبی ذیلی علاقہٕ، یُس جغرافیائی تہٕ نسلی ثقافتی لحاظ بَیان چھُ کرنہٕ یوان۔
parentEnglish: South Asia is the southern subregion of Asia, which is defined in both geographical and ethnic-cultural terms. As commonly conceptualised, South Asia consists of the countries Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka,[1] with Afghanistan also often included.[2]
parentKashmiri: جنوبی ایشیا چھ ایشیاءک جنوبی ذیلی علاقہٕ، یُس جغرافیائی تہٕ نسلی ثقافتی لحاظ بَیان چھُ کرنہٕ یوان۔ عام طور چھُ خیال کرنہٕ آمت زِ جنوبی ایشیا چھُ بنگلہ دیش، بھوٹان، ہِندوستان، مالدیپ، نؠپال، پاکِستان، تہٕ سری لنکا، تہٕ اکثر افغانستان تہِ شٲمل چُھ۔[1][2]

english: Topographically, it is dominated by the Indian subcontinent and defined largely by the Indian Ocean in the south, and the Himalayas, Karakoram, and Pamir mountains in the north.
kashmiri: ٹوپوگرافک طورس پیٹھ چُھ یہٕ ہندوستانی سب کنٹیننٹ پیٹھ غلبہٕ تھاوان تہٕ جنوبس منٛز چھُ بھارتی سمندر تہِ شمالس منز چَھ ہِمالیَہ، کاراکورم تہ پامیر پہاڑ۔
parentEnglish: Topographically, it is dominated by the Indian subcontinent and defined largely by the Indian Ocean in the south, and the Himalayas, Karakoram, and Pamir mountains in the north. [citation needed] The Amu Darya, which rises north of the Hindu Kush, forms part of the northwestern border. [citation needed] On land (clockwise), South Asia is bounded by Western Asia, Central Asia, East Asia, and Southeast Asia.
parentKashmiri: ٹوپوگرافک طورس پیٹھ چُھ یہٕ ہندوستانی سب کنٹیننٹ پیٹھ غلبہٕ تھاوان تہٕ جنوبس منٛز چھُ بھارتی سمندر تہِ شمالس منز چَھ ہِمالیَہ، کاراکورم تہ پامیر پہاڑ۔ آمو ڈاریہ یُس ہِند کَش کہ شمال پیٹھ وَتھان چھُ، چھُ شُمٲلؠ مغربی سرحدُک حصہٕ بَنان ۔ زمینی طور چھُ جنوبی ایشیا مغرب ایشیا، وسطی ایشیا، مشرقی ایشا تہٕ جنوب مشرق ایشیا سٟتؠ سرحد تھاوان۔

english: Zakir Abdul Karim Naik (born 18 October 1965) is an Indian Islamic televangelist, public orator who focuses on comparative religion.[10] He is the founder and president of the Islamic Research Foundation (IRF) and the Peace TV Network.
kashmiri: زاکیر عبدالکریم نایک (جنم 18 اکتوبر 1965) چھُ اکھ بھارتی اسلامی ٹیلی انجیل کار، عوٲمی بولن وول یُس موازنہٕ دینس پیٹھ توجہ مرکوز چُھ۔[10] تم چِھ اسلامی ریسرچ فاؤنڈیشن (IRF) تہٕ پیس ٹی وی نیٹ ورکک بانی تہِ صدر۔
parentEnglish: Zakir Abdul Karim Naik (born 18 October 1965) is an Indian Islamic televangelist, public orator who focuses on comparative religion.[10] He is the founder and president of the Islamic Research Foundation (IRF) and the Peace TV Network. He is a well-known figure in the Islamic world, and while he does not claim to be a follower of any one school of thought in Islam, he is most closely associated with the Salafi school of thought.[11][12]
parentKashmiri: زاکیر عبدالکریم نایک (جنم 18 اکتوبر 1965) چھُ اکھ بھارتی اسلامی ٹیلی انجیل کار، عوٲمی بولن وول یُس موازنہٕ دینس پیٹھ توجہ مرکوز چُھ۔[10] تم چِھ اسلامی ریسرچ فاؤنڈیشن (IRF) تہٕ پیس ٹی وی نیٹ ورکک بانی تہِ صدر۔ تم چُھ اسلامی دنیاہس منٛز اکھ مشہور شخصیت، تہٕ اگرچہ تمن چھنہٕ اسلامس منز کنہہ تہِ مکتبٕچ پیروی کرنُک دعویٰ کران، مگر تم چھِ سلفی مکتبہٕ سۭتۍ زیادٕ قریب جڑان۔[11][12]

english: A copyright is a type of intellectual property that gives its owner the exclusive right to copy, distribute, adapt, display, and perform a creative work, usually for a limited time.[1][2][3][4][5] The creative work may be in a literary, artistic, educational, or musical form.
kashmiri: کاپی رائٹ چُھ اکھ قسمُک ملکیتھ یۄس امکِس مٲلکس تخلیقی کامہٕ نقٕل، تَقسیٖم، بَدلاو، نُمٲیِش تہٕ اتھ پؠٹھ کیٚنٛہہ کٲم انجام دینُک خصوٗصی حَق فراہم چھِ کران، عام طور کُنہِ محدوٗد وقتس تام۔[1][2][3][4][5] تَخلیٖقی کامہِ ہیٚکَن ادبی، فن کارانہٕ، تٲلیٖمی یا موٗسیٖقی ہٕنٛد شَکلہِ منٛز ٲسِتھ۔
parentEnglish: A copyright is a type of intellectual property that gives its owner the exclusive right to copy, distribute, adapt, display, and perform a creative work, usually for a limited time.[1][2][3][4][5] The creative work may be in a literary, artistic, educational, or musical form. Copyright is intended to protect the original expression of an idea in the form of a creative work, but not the idea itself.[6][7][8] A copyright is subject to limitations based on public interest considerations, such as the fair use doctrine in the United States.
parentKashmiri: کاپی رائٹ چُھ اکھ قسمُک ملکیتھ یۄس امکِس مٲلکس تخلیقی کامہٕ نقٕل، تَقسیٖم، بَدلاو، نُمٲیِش تہٕ اتھ پؠٹھ کیٚنٛہہ کٲم انجام دینُک خصوٗصی حَق فراہم چھِ کران، عام طور کُنہِ محدوٗد وقتس تام۔[1][2][3][4][5] تَخلیٖقی کامہِ ہیٚکَن ادبی، فن کارانہٕ، تٲلیٖمی یا موٗسیٖقی ہٕنٛد شَکلہِ منٛز ٲسِتھ۔ کاپی رایِٹُک مَقصَد چھُ تَخلیٖقی کامہِ کہِ خَیال کِس اَصٕلی اِظہارُک تَحَفُظ، مَگر خیالُک تَحَفُظ نہٕ کیٚنٛہہ۔[1][2][3]

english: The coordination of time and frequency transmissions around the world began on 1 January 1960.
kashmiri: دنیاہس منٛز وقت تہٕ فروکینسی ٹرانسمیشنن ہنٛز ہم آہنگی گٔیہٕ 1 جنؤری 1960 پؠٹھ شروع۔
parentEnglish: The coordination of time and frequency transmissions around the world began on 1 January 1960. UTC was first officially adopted as CCIR Recommendation 374, Standard-Frequency and Time-Signal Emissions, in 1963, but the official abbreviation of UTC and the official English name of Coordinated Universal Time (along with the French equivalent) were not adopted until 1967.[1]
parentKashmiri: دنیاہس منٛز وقت تہٕ فروکینسی ٹرانسمیشنن ہنٛز ہم آہنگی گٔیہٕ 1 جنؤری 1960 پؠٹھ شروع۔ UTC اوس گوڈٕنِیک لَٹہِ سَرکٲرؠ طور سی سی آیی آر کہِ سُفٲرش 374، سٹینڈرڈ فریکوینسی تہٕ ٹایِم-سیگنل ایمیشنز، 1963 منٛز مَنظوٗر کَرنہٕ آمُت کرنہٕ، مَگر UTC لَفظُک سرکٲری اِستِمال تہِ کوآرڈینیٹڈ یونیورسل ٹایِم ( تہٕ فرانسیٖسی تَرجَمہٕ) ہُنٛد سرکٲری انگریزؠ ناو ٲس نہٕ 1967 تام مَنظوٗ منظٕر کٔنؠہِ آمُت۔
usageCondition: Preserve original license, attribution and applicable share-alike obligations.

parentKashmiri: دنیاہس منٛز وقت تہٕ فروکینسی ٹرانسمیشنن ہنٛز ہم آہنگی گٔیہٕ 1 جنؤری 1960 پؠٹھ شروع۔ UTC اوس گوڈٕنِیک لَٹہِ سَرکٲرؠ طور سی سی آیی آر کہِ سُفٲرش 374، سٹینڈرڈ فریکوینسی تہٕ ٹایِم-سیگنل ایمیشنز، 1963 منٛز مَنظوٗر کَرنہٕ آمُت کرنہٕ، مَگر UTC لَفظُک سرکٲری اِستِمال تہِ کوآرڈینیٹڈ یونیورسل ٹایِم ( تہٕ فرانسیٖسی تَرجَمہٕ) ہُنٛد سرکٲری انگریزؠ ناو ٲس نہٕ 1967 تام مَنظوٗ منظٕر کٔنؠہِ آمُت۔

english: The system has been adjusted several times, including a brief period during which the time-coordination radio signals broadcast both UTC and "Stepped Atomic Time (SAT)" before a new UTC was adopted in 1970 and implemented in 1972.
kashmiri: یہِ نِظام آو واریاہ لَٹہِ صٔحیٖح کرنہٕ، یَتھ مَنٛز اَکھ مُختصر کال شٲمِل چھُ، یتھ دوران وقتس کاڈنیٹ ریڈیو سگنلو کٔرؠ دوشوٲے یو ٹی سی تہٕ سی اے ٹی نَشر۔
parentEnglish: The system has been adjusted several times, including a brief period during which the time-coordination radio signals broadcast both UTC and "Stepped Atomic Time (SAT)" before a new UTC was adopted in 1970 and implemented in 1972. This change also adopted leap seconds to simplify future adjustments. This CCIR Recommendation 460 "stated that (a) carrier frequencies and time intervals should be maintained constant and should correspond to the definition of the SI second; (b) step adjustments, when necessary, should be exactly 1 s to maintain approximate agreement with Universal Time (UT); and (c) standard signals should contain information on the difference between UTC and UT."[2]

english: Chaudhary Charan Singh University (CCS University), formerly Meerut University, is a public state university located in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, India.
kashmiri: چوہدری چرن سنگھ یونیورسٹی (سِی سِی ایِس یونیورسٹی) ، یتھ میرٹ یونیورسٹیتی تہ ونان چُھ یہ چہ اکھ سرکاری ریاستی یونیورسٹی یس اُتر پردیش، میرٹس منٛز واقع چِھ۔
parentEnglish: Chaudhary Charan Singh University (CCS University), formerly Meerut University, is a public state university located in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, India. The university was established in 1965.[1] It was later renamed to its current name after Chaudhary Charan Singh, former Prime minister of India.[1] The university celebrated its silver jubilee in 1991.

english: Leh was for centuries an important stopover on trade routes along the Indus Valley between Tibet, Kashmir, India and China.
kashmiri: لِیہ اوس صٔدین تام تبت، کشمیر، بھارت تہٕ چیٖنس درمیان سندس وٲدی سٟتؠ تجارتی وَتن پؠٹھ اَکھ اَہَم ٹھہراو۔
parentEnglish: Leh was for centuries an important stopover on trade routes along the Indus Valley between Tibet, Kashmir, India and China. The main goods carried were salt, grain, pashm or cashmere wool, charas or cannabis resin from the Tarim Basin, indigo, silk yarn and Banaras brocade.
parentKashmiri: لِیہ اوس صٔدین تام تبت، کشمیر، بھارت تہٕ چیٖنس درمیان سندس وٲدی سٟتؠ تجارتی وَتن پؠٹھ اَکھ اَہَم ٹھہراو۔ یمن منٛز اوس بُنیٲدی سامان نوٗن، اناج، پشم یا کشمیر ییر، تاریم بیسنن، چَرٕس، اندگو، تہٕ ریشٕم۔

english: Concepts similar to molecules have been discussed since ancient times, but modern investigation into the nature of molecules and their bonds began in the 17th century.
kashmiri: مالیکیولن ہیوے حَیالَن ہُنٛد تَصوُر اوس قدیٖم زمانہٕ پؠٹھ بحث مَنٛز، مگر مالیکیوٗلَن تہٕ یمن ہنٛد بانڈن متعلق جٔدیٖد تٔحقیٖق گے 17مہ صٔدی منٛز شروع۔
parentEnglish: Concepts similar to molecules have been discussed since ancient times, but modern investigation into the nature of molecules and their bonds began in the 17th century. Refined over time by scientists such as Robert Boyle, Amedeo Avogadro, Jean Perrin, and Linus Pauling, the study of molecules is today known as molecular physics or molecular chemistry.

english: Hematology (always spelled haematology in British English) is the branch of medicine concerned with the study of the cause, prognosis, treatment, and prevention of diseases related to blood.[1][2] It involves treating diseases that affect the production of blood and its components, such as blood cells, hemoglobin, blood proteins, bone marrow, platelets, blood vessels, spleen, and the mechanism of coagulation.
kashmiri: ہیماٹالجی چھِ طبچ اکھ شاخ یُس خونس سٟتؠ وابَستہٕ بؠمارؠن ہنز وجہ، تَشخیٖص، عیلاج تہٕ روک تھامس مُتلِق مُطالہٕ چھِ کَران۔[1][2] اتھ منٛز چھِ یِمَن بیمارین ہُنٛد عیلاج شٲمِل یم خوٗنٕچ پٲداوار تہٕ امک اَجزاہَن پؠٹھ اثر انداز چھ کران، یتھ کٔنۍ خونی خلیات، ہیموگلوبین، خونک پروٹین أڈجَن ہٕنٛز وَسہِ، پلاٹلیٹس، وین، خونٕچ کروڈ بَنُک طریٖقہٕ کار شٲمِل۔
parentEnglish: Hematology (always spelled haematology in British English) is the branch of medicine concerned with the study of the cause, prognosis, treatment, and prevention of diseases related to blood.[1][2] It involves treating diseases that affect the production of blood and its components, such as blood cells, hemoglobin, blood proteins, bone marrow, platelets, blood vessels, spleen, and the mechanism of coagulation. Such diseases might include hemophilia, sickle cell anemia, blood clots (thrombus), other bleeding disorders, and blood cancers such as leukemia, multiple myeloma, and lymphoma.[3] The laboratory analysis of blood is frequently performed by a medical technologist or medical laboratory scientist.
