kashmiri: صومالیہ جِبوٗتی اِتھوپیا تہٕ اِریترٛیا[1][2] اگرچہ عام چھنہٕ، وسیع تر تعریفن منٛز کینیا تہٕ سوڈان کنہہ یا ساری چھ شأمل۔[7][8][9] یہٕ چھ جزیرٕ نما عربس سۭتۍ تہٕ اکھ سمندری سرحدک اشتراک کران۔[10][11][12][13]
parentEnglish: The Horn of Africa (HoA), also known as the Somali Peninsula,[1][2][3] is a large peninsula and geopolitical region in East Africa.[4] Located on the easternmost part of the African mainland, it is the fourth largest peninsula in the world and is composed of the four countries Somalia, Djibouti, Ethiopia, and Eritrea.[5][6] Although not common, broader definitions include parts or all of Kenya and Sudan.[7][8][9] It has been described as a region of geopolitical and strategic importance since it is situated along the southern boundary of the Red Sea; extending hundreds of kilometres into the Gulf of Aden, Guardafui Channel, and Indian Ocean. It also shares a maritime border with the Arabian Peninsula.[10][11][12][13]
parentKashmiri: افریٖقہ ہُک ہؠنٛگ یا ہارن آف افریقہ (اَنٛگریٖزی :Horn of Africa )(HoA) یتھ صومالی جزیرہ نما تہٕ ونان چھ، چھ مشرقی افریقہ اکھ بۆڑ جزیرہ نما تہٕ جغرافیائی سیاسی علاقہٕ۔[1][2][3][4] افریقی سرزمینک مشرقی حصس پیٹھ واقع، یہٕ چھ دنیاہک ژورم ساروی کھوتہٕ بھڑ جزیرہ نما تہٕ ژور ملکن پیٹھ مشتمل۔ صومالیہ جِبوٗتی اِتھوپیا تہٕ اِریترٛیا[1][2] اگرچہ عام چھنہٕ، وسیع تر تعریفن منٛز کینیا تہٕ سوڈان کنہہ یا ساری چھ شأمل۔[7][8][9] یہٕ چھ جزیرٕ نما عربس سۭتۍ تہٕ اکھ سمندری سرحدک اشتراک کران۔[10][11][12][13]

english: Kimchi (/ˈkɪmtʃiː/; Korean: 김치; RR: gimchi, IPA: [kim.tɕʰi]) is a traditional Korean side dish (banchan) consisting of salted and fermented vegetables, most often napa cabbage or Korean radish.
kashmiri: (/ˈkɪmtʃiː/ کورین: ′ ′ ′′ RR: Gimchi، IPA: [kim.tɕʰi] چھ اکھ رؠوایتی کورین سائڈ ڈش (بنچن) یتھ منٛز نمکین تہٕ خمیر شدٕ سبزی چھ آسان، اکثر ناپا گوٗبی یا کورین مُج آسان چھِ۔
parentEnglish: Kimchi (/ˈkɪmtʃiː/; Korean: 김치; RR: gimchi, IPA: [kim.tɕʰi]) is a traditional Korean side dish (banchan) consisting of salted and fermented vegetables, most often napa cabbage or Korean radish. A wide selection of seasonings are used, including gochugaru (Korean chili powder), spring onions, garlic, ginger, and jeotgal (a salted seafood).[1][2] Kimchi is also used in a variety of soups and stews. Kimchi is a staple food in Korean cuisine and is eaten as a side dish with almost every Korean meal.[3]

english: Kareena Kapoor Khan ( pronounced [kəˈriːna kəˈpuːr xɑːn]; née Kapoor; born 21 September 1980) is an Indian actress.
kashmiri: کریٖنا کپوٗر خان ( واضح [kəˈriːna kəˈpuːr xɑːn] née کپوٗر 21 ستمبر 1980) منٛز پیدٲیش گژھن واجیٚنہ چھےٚ اکھ ہندوستٲنہ اداکٲر۔
parentEnglish: Kareena Kapoor Khan ( pronounced [kəˈriːna kəˈpuːr xɑːn]; née Kapoor; born 21 September 1980) is an Indian actress. A prolific leading lady of Hindi cinema since 2000, she is noted for her roles in a range of film genres—from romantic comedies to crime dramas. Kapoor is the recipient of several awards, including six Filmfare Awards, and as of 2024, is one of Hindi cinema's highest-paid actresses.[1]
parentKashmiri: کریٖنا کپوٗر خان ( واضح [kəˈriːna kəˈpuːr xɑːn] née کپوٗر 21 ستمبر 1980) منٛز پیدٲیش گژھن واجیٚنہ چھےٚ اکھ ہندوستٲنہ اداکٲر۔ 2000 پیٹھہٕ ہندی سنیما اکھ کامیاب سرکردٕ خاتون، سۄ چھ مختلف فلمی صنف منٛز پننین کردارن خٲطرٕ مشہوٗر-رومینٹِک کامیڈی پؠٹھہٕ کرائم ڈراماہن تام۔ کٔپوٗر چھ واریاہ ایوارڈ ہنٛد وصوٗل کنندگان، یمن منٛز شیٚیہ فلم فیر ایٚوارڈ تہٕ شٲمل چھ، تہٕ 2024 ہس تام چھےٚ سۄ ہنٛدی سیٚنماہس منٛز ساروٕے کھۄتہٕ زیٛادٕ پونٛسہٕ زینن واجیٚنۍ اداکارن منٛز اکھ۔[1]

parentEnglish: Yash Johar (6 September 1929 – 26 June 2004) was an Indian film producer and the founder of Dharma Productions. His films featured lavish sets, were often set in "exotic" locations, and incorporated Indian traditions and family values.[1] He is the father of Karan Johar, now a noted filmmaker himself.

parentKashmiri: یَش جوہَر (6 ستمبر 1929-26 جوٗن 2004) اوس اکھ ہندوستٲنی فلم پروڈیوسر تہٕ دھرما پروڈکشن بٲنؠ۔ تہنٛزٕ فلمن منٛز ٲس شاہانہٕ سیٹہٕ شٲمل، اکثر ٲس "غٲر ملکی" مقاماتن پیٹھ ترتیٖب دینہٕ یوان، تہٕ اتھ منٛز ٲس ہندوستٲنی رؠوایات تہٕ خاندانچ اقدار شٲمل۔[1] یہ چھ کَرَن جوہَر سنٛد مول، یس وۄنۍ پانہٕ اکھ مشہوٗر فلم ساز چھ۔

english: Gauri Shah Rukh Khan[1][2] (née Chhibber; born 8 October 1970) is an Indian film producer and fashion designer who works in Hindi films and the designing industry.

parentEnglish: Gauri Shah Rukh Khan[1][2] (née Chhibber; born 8 October 1970) is an Indian film producer and fashion designer who works in Hindi films and the designing industry. english: On 28 March 2025 at 12:50:54 MMT (06:20:54 UTC), a Mw 7.7 earthquake struck the Sagaing Region of Myanmar, with an epicenter close to Mandalay, the country's second-largest city.
kashmiri: 28 مارچ 2025 Mw" lایم ایم ٹی (′ آئی ڈی 1] یو ٹی سی یس پؠٹھ آو مَیانمر کس ساگاینگ علاقہ منٛز 7.7 میگاواٹک بُنیُل، ییٚمرکز مرکز ملکک دٔیم ساروی کھۄتہٕ بوٚڑ شہر منڈالے یس نزدیٖک اوس۔
parentEnglish: On 28 March 2025 at 12:50:54 MMT (06:20:54 UTC), a Mw 7.7 earthquake struck the Sagaing Region of Myanmar, with an epicenter close to Mandalay, the country's second-largest city. The strike-slip faulting shock achieved a maximum Modified Mercalli intensity of IX (Violent).[1] It was the most powerful earthquake to strike Myanmar since 1912.[2] The earthquake caused extensive damage in Myanmar and significant damage in neighboring Thailand. Hundreds of homes were also damaged in Yunnan, China.
parentKashmiri: 28 مارچ 2025 Mw" lایم ایم ٹی (′ آئی ڈی 1] یو ٹی سی یس پؠٹھ آو مَیانمر کس ساگاینگ علاقہ منٛز 7.7 میگاواٹک بُنیُل، ییٚمرکز مرکز ملکک دٔیم ساروی کھۄتہٕ بوٚڑ شہر منڈالے یس نزدیٖک اوس۔ سٹرائیک سلپ فالٹنگ شاکن کٔر IX (وائولینٹ) ہنٛز زیادٕ کھوتہٕ زیادٕ تبدیٖل شدٕ مرکیلی شدت حٲصل۔[1] یہ اوس 1912 پتہٕ میانمارس منٛز پیدٕ گژھن وول ساروٕے کھۄتہٕ طاقتور بٕنیُل۔[1] امؠ بُنلہِ سۭتہ گوٚو میانمارس منٛز بٔڑس پیمانس پؠٹھ نۄقصان تہٕ ہمسایہ ملک تھائی لینڈ منٛز کٲفی نۄقصان۔ چین کس یونانس منٛز تہٕ گوٚو ہتہٕ بٔدؠ گرن نۄقصان۔
usageCondition: Preserve original license, attribution and applicable share-alike obligations.

english: The earthquake resulted in more than 1,600 deaths in Myanmar and 10 in Thailand.[1][2] More than 3,400 people were injured.
kashmiri: امہ بُنلہِ کہ نٔتیٖجس منٛز گٔیہ میانمارس منٛز 1,600 کھۄتہٕ زیٛادٕ تہٕ تھائی لینڈس منٛز 10 ہلاک۔[1][2] 3, 400 کھۄتہٕ زیٛادٕ افراد گٔیہ زخمی۔
parentEnglish: The earthquake resulted in more than 1,600 deaths in Myanmar and 10 in Thailand.[1][2] More than 3,400 people were injured. Hundreds more were reported missing, including at a collapsed construction site in Bangkok, which, due to its shallow geology, is more vulnerable to seismic waves from far away, and lack of awareness, increasing the city's susceptibility to earthquake-related impacts.[3][4] As of 28 March, authorities declared an emergency, and expect the death toll to rise.[5][6] The ongoing civil war in Myanmar has exacerbated the difficulty of disaster relief.[7] It was the deadliest earthquake to affect the country since the 1930 Bago earthquake.[8]
parentKashmiri: امہ بُنلہِ کہ نٔتیٖجس منٛز گٔیہ میانمارس منٛز 1,600 کھۄتہٕ زیٛادٕ تہٕ تھائی لینڈس منٛز 10 ہلاک۔[1][2] 3, 400 کھۄتہٕ زیٛادٕ افراد گٔیہ زخمی۔ ہتہٕ بٔد مزید لاپتہ گژھنٕچ اطلاع آیہٕ دنہٕ، بشمول بینٛگ کوک منٛز اکھ منہدم تعمیراتی جایہٕ، یس پننہٕ کھوکھلی ارضیات کہ وجہ سۭتۍ، دور دراز پیٹھہٕ بُنیُل کہ لہرٕ سۭتۍ چھ زیادٕ کمزور، تہٕ بیداری ہنٛز کمی، یمہٕ سۭتۍ شہر چھ بُنیُل سۭتۍ متعلق اثراتک شِکار گژھان۔[1][2] 28 مارچ تام، حکامو کوٚر ایمرجنسی ہنٛد اعلان، تہٕ موتچ تعداد بڑنچ توقع۔[5][6] میانمارس منٛز جٲری خانہ جنگی چھ آفتن منٛز امدادچ مشکلات بڑھاومت۔[7] یہ اوس 1930 کس باگو کس بُنیُل پتہٕ ملکس متٲثر کرن وول ساروٕے کھۄتہٕ خطرناک بُنیُل۔[1]

english: Ibrahim Ali Khan Pataudi (born 5 March 2001) is an Indian actor who works in Hindi films.
kashmiri: اِبراہیٖم علی خان پٹودی (پیدٲیش 5 مارچ 2001) چھ اکھ ہندوستٲنی اداکار یس ہِنٛدی فلمن منٛز کٲم چھ کران۔
parentEnglish: Ibrahim Ali Khan Pataudi (born 5 March 2001) is an Indian actor who works in Hindi films. Born to actors Saif Ali Khan and Amrita Singh, he had his first acting role as a child as the younger version of his father's character in Tashan (2008). As an adult, he had his first leading role in the Netflix romantic comedy film Nadaaniyan (2025).
parentKashmiri: اِبراہیٖم علی خان پٹودی (پیدٲیش 5 مارچ 2001) چھ اکھ ہندوستٲنی اداکار یس ہِنٛدی فلمن منٛز کٲم چھ کران۔ اداکار سیف علی خان تہٕ امریٖتا سنٛگھ زامُت، تٔمس اوس بطور شُرۍ پننہ مٲلہ سٕنٛد کردارٕ کس لۄکٹس ورجنس منٛز ٹَشَن (2008) منٛز اداکٲری ہنٛد گۄڈنیوک کردار۔ بطور بالیغ، اوس أمہ نیٹ فلکس چہ رومانٹک کامیڈی فلم نادانیاہس (2025) منٛز پنُن گۄڈنیوک اہم کردار ادا کوٚرمت۔

parentEnglish: Mandalay (/ˌmændəˈleɪ/ or /ˈmændəleɪ/; Burmese: မန္တလေး; MLCTS: manta.le: [màndəlé]) is the second-largest city in Myanmar, after Yangon. english: Over the years, Kim built a reputation as one of South Korea's most promising young actresses.[1] However, in 2022, her career plateaued following a drunk driving incident, which led to public backlash and legal consequences.
kashmiri: ینہٕ والؠن ؤرین منٛز، کِم بنے جنوٗبی کوریاہس منٛز ساروٕے کھۄتہٕ زیادٕ پراُمید نوجوان اداکارن منٛز اکھ۔[1] وونہِ گۆ، 2022 ہس منٛز، شراب چیٚتھ ڈرائیونگ کس واقعہٕ پتہٕ گٔیہ أمہ سٕنٛز پیشورانہٕ زِندگی ہموار، ییٚمہ سٕتہ عوٲمی ردعمل تہٕ قونوٗنی نٔتیٖجہٕ سٕتؠ مُتٲثِر۔
parentEnglish: Over the years, Kim built a reputation as one of South Korea's most promising young actresses.[1] However, in 2022, her career plateaued following a drunk driving incident, which led to public backlash and legal consequences. english: Dangiwacha is a small town located in the Baramulla district of the Jammu and Kashmir, India.

parentEnglish: Dangiwacha is a small town located in the Baramulla district of the Jammu and Kashmir, India. It serves as an important administrative and commercial hub for the surrounding rural areas and is part of the Rafiabad tehsil.[1]

english: Horror Story is a 2013 Indian Hindi-language horror film written by Vikram Bhatt and directed by Ayush Raina.[1] The film stars Ravish Desai and Hasan Zaidi, and is the Bollywood debut of noted television actors Nishant Malkani and Karan Kundra.[2] The film was released on 13 September 2013.
kashmiri: ہورر سٕٹوری چھےٚ 2013 ہٕچ ہنٛدستٲنؠ ہندی زبٲنہ ہنٛز ہورر فلم یتھ وِکرم بھٹ لیکھمٕژ چھ تہٕ آیوش ریناہن چھےٚ ہدایت کٲری کٔرمٕژ۔[1] اتھ فلمہ منٛز چھ رویش دیسائی تہٕ حسن زیدی شٲمل، تہٕ یہ چھ مشہوٗر ٹیلی وِجَن اداکار نِشانٛت ملکانی تہٕ کَرَن کُنٛدرا سٕنٛز بالی وڈس منٛز شروٗعات۔[1] یہ فلم آیہ 13 ستمبر 2013 ریلیز کرنہٕ۔
parentEnglish: Horror Story is a 2013 Indian Hindi-language horror film written by Vikram Bhatt and directed by Ayush Raina.[1] The film stars Ravish Desai and Hasan Zaidi, and is the Bollywood debut of noted television actors Nishant Malkani and Karan Kundra.[2] The film was released on 13 September 2013. The plot revolves around a night spent by seven youngsters at a haunted hotel. The film received positive reviews but failed at the box office.[3]
parentKashmiri: ہورر سٕٹوری چھےٚ 2013 ہٕچ ہنٛدستٲنؠ ہندی زبٲنہ ہنٛز ہورر فلم یتھ وِکرم بھٹ لیکھمٕژ چھ تہٕ آیوش ریناہن چھےٚ ہدایت کٲری کٔرمٕژ۔[1] اتھ فلمہ منٛز چھ رویش دیسائی تہٕ حسن زیدی شٲمل، تہٕ یہ چھ مشہوٗر ٹیلی وِجَن اداکار نِشانٛت ملکانی تہٕ کَرَن کُنٛدرا سٕنٛز بالی وڈس منٛز شروٗعات۔[1] یہ فلم آیہ 13 ستمبر 2013 ریلیز کرنہٕ۔ یہ پلاٹ چھ ستن نوجوانن ہنٛد اکہ بھوت ہوٹلس منٛز گزٲرمتس راتس أنٛدۍ پٔکۍ۔ فلمہ ٲسۍ مجموعی طور ملہٕ جلہٕ جایزٕ میلیمٕتۍ مگر باکس آفسس پیٚٹھ گٔیہ ناکام۔[3]

english: The name of Dadasara is derived from the two words "Dadah", meaning deep, and "Sar" meaning lake.
kashmiri: دادا سرہُک ناو چھ دۆن لفظن "دادا" پیٹھہٕ ماخوذ، ییٚمیک مطلب سرٛۄن تہٕ "سَر" ییٚمیک معنی جھیٖل چھ۔
parentEnglish: The name of Dadasara is derived from the two words "Dadah", meaning deep, and "Sar" meaning lake. Dadasara is believed to have been once a deep lake. It is second largest village of Tral by area and population.

english: Indiana (/ˌɪndiˈænə/ ⓘ IN-dee-AN-ə)[1] is a state in the Midwestern region of the United States.
kashmiri: اِنٛڈیانا (/ˌɪndiˈænə/i IN-dee-AN-ə) چھ ریاست متحدہ امریکاک اکھ ریاست۔[1] ایمچ سرحد چھ شمال مغربس منٛز جھیل مشی گن شمال تہٕ شمال مشرق منٛز مشی گن، مشرق منٛز اوہایو جنوب تہٕ جنوب مشرق منٛز اوہیو دٔریاو تہٕ کینٹکی تہٕ مغرب منٛز دریائے وابش تہٕ الینوائے سۭتۍ متصل۔
parentEnglish: Indiana (/ˌɪndiˈænə/ ⓘ IN-dee-AN-ə)[1] is a state in the Midwestern region of the United States. It borders Lake Michigan to the northwest, Michigan to the north and northeast, Ohio to the east, the Ohio River and Kentucky to the south and southeast, and the Wabash River and Illinois to the west. Nicknamed "the Hoosier State",[2] Indiana is the 38th-largest by area and the 17th-most populous of the 50 states.
parentKashmiri: اِنٛڈیانا (/ˌɪndiˈænə/i IN-dee-AN-ə) چھ ریاست متحدہ امریکاک اکھ ریاست۔[1] ایمچ سرحد چھ شمال مغربس منٛز جھیل مشی گن شمال تہٕ شمال مشرق منٛز مشی گن، مشرق منٛز اوہایو جنوب تہٕ جنوب مشرق منٛز اوہیو دٔریاو تہٕ کینٹکی تہٕ مغرب منٛز دریائے وابش تہٕ الینوائے سۭتۍ متصل۔ ناو رؠژھ " ہوزیئر سٹیٹ " اِنٛڈیانا چھ رقبک لحاظٕ سۭتۍ 38 ہم ساروی کھوتہٕ بۆڑ تہٕ 50 رِیاستہٕ منٛز چھ 17 ہم ساروی کھوتہٕ زیادٕ آبادی وأل شہر۔[1] امک رازدٲنؠ چھ ساروی کھوتہٕ بٔڑ شہر اِنٛڈیاناپولِس ۔ انڈیانا آو 11 دسمبر 1816 ہس منز 19 ہم ریاست کہ طورس پیٹھ یونینس منز دٲخل کرنہٕ۔

english: Nicknamed "the Hoosier State",[2] Indiana is the 38th-largest by area and the 17th-most populous of the 50 states.

parentEnglish: Indiana (/ˌɪndiˈænə/ ⓘ IN-dee-AN-ə)[1] is a state in the Midwestern region of the United States. english: At the 2020 census, the balance population was 887,642.[1] Indianapolis is the 16th-most populous city in the U.S., the third-most populous city in the Midwest after Chicago and Columbus, Ohio, and the fourth-most populous state capital in the nation after Phoenix, Austin, and Columbus.
kashmiri: 2020 ہچ مردم شماری منٛز، باقی آبادی أس 887,642۔[1] اِنٛڈیاناپولِس چھ امریکہک 16 ہم ساروی کھوتہٕ زیادٕ آبادی وأل شہر، شکاگو تہٕ کولمبس، اوہائیو پتہٕ مڈویسٹک تریم ساری کھوتہٕ زیادٕ آبادی وول شہر، تہٕ فینکس اوسٹن تہٕ کولمبسن پتہٕ چھ قومک ژوٗرِم ساری کھوتہٕ زیادٕ آبٲدی وأل ریاستی رازدٲنؠ۔
parentEnglish: At the 2020 census, the balance population was 887,642.[1] Indianapolis is the 16th-most populous city in the U.S., the third-most populous city in the Midwest after Chicago and Columbus, Ohio, and the fourth-most populous state capital in the nation after Phoenix, Austin, and Columbus. The Indianapolis metropolitan area is the 33rd-most populous metropolitan statistical area in the U.S., home to 2.1 million residents.[2] With a population of more than 2.6 million, the combined statistical area ranks 28th.[3] Indianapolis proper covers 368 square miles (950 km2), making it the 18th-most extensive city by land area in the country.

english: Karan Singh (born 9 March 1931) is an Indian politician and philosopher.[1] He is the titular Maharaja of the princely state of Jammu and Kashmir.

parentEnglish: Karan Singh (born 9 March 1931) is an Indian politician and philosopher.[1] He is the titular Maharaja of the princely state of Jammu and Kashmir. english: Yuvraj Vikramaditya Singh, elder son and crown prince; married Chitrangada Scindia, the daughter of Madhavrao Scindia of Gwalior, in 1987.[1] Ajatshatru Singh, second son; took to politics, was elected to the state assembly from the Nagrota constituency and became a minister in the state government.
kashmiri: یوراج وکرمادتیہ سنگھ زٹھہ نیچو تہٕ تاج شہزادن کوٚر 1987 تھس منٛز گوالیار کس مادھوراؤ سندھیا سٕنٛز کور چترانگدا سندھیا سۭتہ خانٛدر۔[1] دوٚیم نیٚچو، اجات شترو سنگھ کٔر سیاستس منٛز قدم، آو ناگروٹا حلقہٕ پؠٹھ ریاستی اسمبلی خٲطرٕ منتخب کرنہٕ تہٕ بنیوو ریاستی حکوٗمتس منٛز وزیر۔
parentEnglish: Yuvraj Vikramaditya Singh, elder son and crown prince; married Chitrangada Scindia, the daughter of Madhavrao Scindia of Gwalior, in 1987.[1] Ajatshatru Singh, second son; took to politics, was elected to the state assembly from the Nagrota constituency and became a minister in the state government. His wife is the daughter of an army officer. Jyotsna Singh, only daughter, married to Dhirendra Singh Chauhan, belonging to Mainpuri in Uttar Pradesh.[2]

english: It is separated from Great Britain to its east by the North Channel, the Irish Sea, and St George's Channel.
kashmiri: آئرلینڈ چھ شمال مغربی یورپ کس شمٲلی اٹلانٹک سۆدرِس منٛز اکھ جزیرٕ۔
parentEnglish: It is separated from Great Britain to its east by the North Channel, the Irish Sea, and St George's Channel. Ireland is the second-largest island of the British Isles, the third-largest in Europe, and the twentieth-largest in the world.[1] Geopolitically, the island is divided between the Republic of Ireland (officially named Ireland), a sovereign state covering five-sixths of the island, and Northern Ireland, which is part of the United Kingdom. As of 2022, the population of the entire island is just over 7 million, with 5.1 million in the Republic of Ireland and 1.9 million in Northern Ireland, ranking it the second-most populous island in Europe after Great Britain.[2]
parentKashmiri: آئرلینڈ چھ شمال مغربی یورپ کس شمٲلی اٹلانٹک سۆدرِس منٛز اکھ جزیرٕ۔ یہٕ چھ برطانیہ پیٹھہٕ مشرق کہ طرفہٕ شمٲلی چینل آئرش سمندر تہٕ سینٹ جارج چینل کہ ذریعہٕ الگ کرنہٕ آمت۔ 2022 ہس تام، چھ پورٕ جزیرٕچ آبٲدی صرف 7 ملین کھوتہٕ زیادٕ، یتھ منز جمہوریہ آئرلینڈس منز 5.1 ملین تہٕ شمالی آئرلینڈس منٛز 1.9 ملین چھ، یمیوک درجہٕ برطانیہ پتہٕ یورپک دویم ساروی کھوتہٕ زیادٕ آبٲدی وول جزیرٕہ چھ۔[2]
usageCondition: Preserve original license, attribution and applicable share-alike obligations.

english: Vishal Veeru Devgan (born 2 April 1969), known professionally as Ajay Devgn, is an Indian actor, film director, and producer.
kashmiri: وِشال ویٖرو دیوگن (پیدٲیش 2 اپریل 1969) یس پیشورانہٕ طور اَجے دیوگن ناوٕ سٕتۍ زاننہٕ چھ یوان چھ اکھ ہِندوستٲنؠ اداکار، فلم ڈائریکٹر تہٕ پروڈیوسر۔
parentEnglish: Vishal Veeru Devgan (born 2 April 1969), known professionally as Ajay Devgn, is an Indian actor, film director, and producer. One of the most prolific actors of Hindi cinema, Devgn has appeared in over 100 films and has won numerous accolades, including four National Film Awards and four Filmfare Awards. In 2016, he was honoured by the Government of India with the Padma Shri, the country's fourth-highest civilian honour.[1]
parentKashmiri: وِشال ویٖرو دیوگن (پیدٲیش 2 اپریل 1969) یس پیشورانہٕ طور اَجے دیوگن ناوٕ سٕتۍ زاننہٕ چھ یوان چھ اکھ ہِندوستٲنؠ اداکار، فلم ڈائریکٹر تہٕ پروڈیوسر۔ ہندی سیٚنماہٕکۍ ساروٕے کھۄتہٕ زیادٕ کامیاب اداکارو منٛزٕ اکھ، دیوگن چھ 100 کھۄتہٕ زیادٕ فلمن منٛز وٕچھنہٕ آمت تہٕ أمۍ چھ واریاہ تعریفیں زیٖنمٕتۍ، یمن منٛز ژور نیشنل فلم ایوارڈز تہٕ ژور فلم فیئر ایوارڈز شٲمل چھ۔ 2016 ہس منٛز آو تس حکومت ہند طرفہٕ پَدَم شِرٛی اعزاز دنہٕ، یس ملکک ژوٗرم ساروٕیہ کھۄتہٕ بوٚڑ شہری اعزاز چھ۔[1]

english: Khrew is known as an industrial area in the valley and the state is getting very good revenue from this area.
kashmiri: کھرِو چھُ وادی منٛز اکھ صنعتی علاقہٕ پٲٹھؠ زاننہٕ یوان تہٕ ریاستس چھُ امہ علاقہٕ پؠٹھ واریاہ اصل ریونیو حٲصل کران۔
parentEnglish: Khrew is known as an industrial area in the valley and the state is getting very good revenue from this area. As per the RTI filed in 2020 about the taxes paid in J&K state: Khrew achieved third place after Srinagar and Jammu city where people are direct and indirect taxpayers.
parentKashmiri: کھرِو چھُ وادی منٛز اکھ صنعتی علاقہٕ پٲٹھؠ زاننہٕ یوان تہٕ ریاستس چھُ امہ علاقہٕ پؠٹھ واریاہ اصل ریونیو حٲصل کران۔ جموں و کشمیر ریاستس منٛز ادا کرنہٕ آمتین ٹیکسن متعلق 2020 ہس منٛز دَرٕج کرنہٕ آمتس آر ٹی آی یس مطٲبق: کھریوہن کٔر سری نگر تہٕ جموں شہر پتہٕ ترٛیٚیم مُقام حٲصل ییٚتہ لکھ براہ راست تہٕ بالواسطہٕ ٹیکس دہندگ چھ۔

english: Gboard is a virtual keyboard app developed by Google for Android and iOS devices.

english: Anayatpora, also known as Anayatpur or Anayat Pora, is a village located in Bandipora Tehsil of Bandipora district, Jammu and Kashmir.
kashmiri: انایت پوڑا یتھ انیات پور یا انیات پورہ تہِ ونان چھِ، چھُ اکھ گام یُس جموں و کشمیر کِس باندی پورہ ضِلہٕ کِس باندیپورہ تحصیلس منٛز واقعہٕ چھُ۔
parentEnglish: Anayatpora, also known as Anayatpur or Anayat Pora, is a village located in Bandipora Tehsil of Bandipora district, Jammu and Kashmir. There are 338 families residing in the village, of which 1085 are males while 1042 are females as per Population Census 2011.[1][2][3]

english: Born in Uch, Subah of Multan, Bulleh Shah belonged to a family of religious scholars.
kashmiri: ملتان کس صوبہ اچس منٛز زینمٕتہ بلے شاہ سنٛد تعلق اوس مذہبی علماہن ہنٛدس أکس خانٛدانس سۭتۍ۔
parentEnglish: Born in Uch, Subah of Multan, Bulleh Shah belonged to a family of religious scholars. In his juvenile years, his family moved to Malakwal, and later Pandoke, in the Subah of Lahore; where he got his early education from his father, while working as a herder, in the village. He received his higher religious education at Kasur from Hafiz Ghulam Murtaza; and later studied in Lahore under Shah Inayat Qadiri.
parentKashmiri: ملتان کس صوبہ اچس منٛز زینمٕتہ بلے شاہ سنٛد تعلق اوس مذہبی علماہن ہنٛدس أکس خانٛدانس سۭتۍ۔ پننہ نابالغ ورۍ ین منٛز گوٚو أمۍ سنٛد خاندان لاہور کس سباہس منٛز مالاکوال تہٕ پتہٕ پانڈوک ییٚتہ تٔمۍ گامس منٛز بطور چرواہ کٲم کران پننس مٲلس نش ابتدائی تعلیم حٲصل کٔر۔ تٔمہ کٔر اعلی مذہبی تعلیم قصور منٛز حافظ غلام مرتضاہس نش حٲصل تہٕ پتہٕ کٔرٕن شاہ انایت قادری تحت لاہور منٛز تعلیم حٲصل۔

english: He spent most of his life in Kasur, where he died at the age of 77.[1] He is revered as the 'Sheikh of Both Worlds' amongst Punjabi Muslims.[2] His poetry has been ingrained in Punjabi proverbs, qisse, and folk traditions; and has been recited at many cultural events, particularly his kafis, including one organized by UNESCO.
kashmiri: تٔمہ گزٲر پننہ زندگی ہنٛد زیٛادٕ تر حصہٕ کسورس منٛز، ییٚتہ سہ 77 ؤرش وٲنٛسہ منٛز گزریوٚو۔[1] سہ چھ پنجابی مسلمانن منٛز 'دۄشوٕنی دنیاہن ہنٛد شیخ' پٲٹھۍ احترام کرنہٕ یوان۔[2] أمہ سٕنٛز شاعری چھےٚ پنجابی کہاوت، قسی، تہٕ لوک رؠواجن منٛز جڑتھ تہٕ چھ واریاہن ثقافتی تقریبن منٛز، خاصکرتھ أمہ سٕنٛزن کافز منٛز، یتھ منٛز اکھ یونیسکو کہ زیر اہتمام چھ۔
parentEnglish: He spent most of his life in Kasur, where he died at the age of 77.[1] He is revered as the 'Sheikh of Both Worlds' amongst Punjabi Muslims.[2] His poetry has been ingrained in Punjabi proverbs, qisse, and folk traditions; and has been recited at many cultural events, particularly his kafis, including one organized by UNESCO. It has also brought fourth many modern renditions, particularly in the form of qawwali.[2]

english: People from all faiths and religions are welcomed in gurdwaras.
kashmiri: اکھ گردواراگُردٕوار یا گُرٛدوارہ چھِسِکھ مَت منٛز چھ اکھ اجتماع تہٕ عبادت گاہ، مگر امک عام معنی چھ "گروچ جاۓ" یا "گروک گر"۔
parentEnglish: People from all faiths and religions are welcomed in gurdwaras. Each gurdwara has a Darbar Sahib where the Guru Granth Sahib is placed on a takht (an elevated throne) in a prominent central position. Any congregant (sometimes with specialized training, in which case they are known by the term granthi) may recite, sing, and explain the verses from the Guru Granth Sahib, in the presence of the rest of the congregation.

parentEnglish: Annihilation) is a 2006 Indian Hindi-language romantic action thriller film directed by Kunal Kohli and produced by Aditya Chopra and Yash Chopra under their banner Yash Raj Films. It stars Aamir Khan and Kajol in the lead roles, with Rishi Kapoor, Kirron Kher, Tabu, and Sharat Saxena appearing in supporting roles. parentEnglish: Chung is a historical village in (Bhikhiwind), just 33 km from Tarn Taran Sahib in Patti tehsil of Tarn Taran district in the Indian state of Punjab. Before 1947, it was part of Kasur tehsil of Lahore district. Rice and wheat are the most cultivated crops.[1]

parentEnglish: Mallinson Girls School is located in the heart of Srinagar, in the Kashmir Valley of Jammu and Kashmir, India. The school was founded by Ms Fitze Mallinson in 1912 at Fateh Kadal and later shifted to Sheikh Bagh in the Lal Chowk area of Srinagar.

english: In cooking, a sauce is a liquid, cream, or semi-solid food, served on or used in preparing other foods.
kashmiri: کھؠن رَنس منٛز، ژؠٹِن چھ اکھ مائع کریمہ یا نیم ٹھوس کھیٚنہٕ، یس باقؠن خوراکن پیٚٹھ پیش کرنہٕ چھ یوان یا تیار کرنہٕ خٲطرٕ اِستعمال کرنہٕ چھ یوان۔
parentEnglish: In cooking, a sauce is a liquid, cream, or semi-solid food, served on or used in preparing other foods. Most sauces are not normally consumed by themselves; they add flavour, texture, and visual appeal to a dish. Sauce is a French word probably from the post-classical Latin salsa, derived from the classical salsus 'salted'.[1] [full citation needed] Possibly the oldest recorded European sauce is garum, the fish sauce used by the Ancient Romans, while doubanjiang, the Chinese soy bean paste is mentioned in Rites of Zhou 20.
parentKashmiri: کھؠن رَنس منٛز، ژؠٹِن چھ اکھ مائع کریمہ یا نیم ٹھوس کھیٚنہٕ، یس باقؠن خوراکن پیٚٹھ پیش کرنہٕ چھ یوان یا تیار کرنہٕ خٲطرٕ اِستعمال کرنہٕ چھ یوان۔ زیادٕ تر سوس چھنہٕ عام طور خٲلی یِوان کھیوان، تم چھ کھؠنس منٛز ذائقہ، بناوٹ تہٕ بصری بَڑاوان۔ سوس چھ اکھ فرانسیسی لفظ شاید پوسٹ کلاسیکل لاطینی سالسا پیٹھہٕ، یُس کلاسیکی سالسس 'نوٗن دَر' پیٹھہٕ ماخوذ چھ۔[1]

parentEnglish: A chutney ( pronounced [ˈʧəʈɳiː]) is a spread typically associated with cuisines of the Indian subcontinent. Chutneys are made in a wide variety of forms, such as a tomato relish, a ground peanut garnish, yogurt, or curd, cucumber, spicy coconut, spicy onion, or mint dipping sauce.

english: Ajay Singh Deol (born 19 October 1957), better known as Sunny Deol, is an Indian actor, film director, producer, and politician.
kashmiri: اجے سِنٛگھ دیٛول (پیدٲیش 19 اکتوبر 1957) یس سَنی دیٛول ناوٕ سۭتۍ زیادٕ زاننہٕ چھ یوان چھ اکھ ہندوستٲنی اداکار، فلم ڈائریکٹر، پروڈیوسر تہٕ سِیاسَتھ دان۔
parentEnglish: Ajay Singh Deol (born 19 October 1957), better known as Sunny Deol, is an Indian actor, film director, producer, and politician. One of the highest grossing actors of Indian cinema,[1] he has worked in more than 100 Hindi films in a career spanning over four decades and is particularly known for his angry action hero persona.[2][3] Deol has won several awards including two National Film Awards[4][5] and two Filmfare Awards.[6] He was the Member of Parliament in the Lok Sabha, the lower house of parliament from Gurdaspur constituency of Punjab as a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party from 2019 to 2024.[7]
parentKashmiri: اجے سِنٛگھ دیٛول (پیدٲیش 19 اکتوبر 1957) یس سَنی دیٛول ناوٕ سۭتۍ زیادٕ زاننہٕ چھ یوان چھ اکھ ہندوستٲنی اداکار، فلم ڈائریکٹر، پروڈیوسر تہٕ سِیاسَتھ دان۔ ہندوستٲنی سنیما کیو ساروی کھوتہٕ زیادٕ کماون والیو اداکارو منٛزٕ اکھ، أمۍ چھ ژۄن دہلو کھۄتہٕ زیادٕ عرصس پیٚٹھ محیط پیشورانہٕ زندگی منٛز 100 کھۄتہٕ زیادٕ ہندی فلمن منٛز کٲم کٔرمٕژ تہٕ چھ خاص طور پنٛنس ناراض ایکشن ہیرو سٕنٛد خٲطرٕ زاننہٕ یوان۔[1][2][3] دیولن چھ واریاہ ایوارڈ زیٖنمٕتؠ یمن منٛز زٕ نیشنل فلم ایوارڈز تہٕ زٕ فلم فیئر ایوارڈز شٲمل چھ۔[1][2][3] سُہ اوس 2019 پؠٹھٕ 2024 تام بھارتی جَنتا پارٹی ہنٛد رکن پٲٹھؠ پنجاب کس گورداسپور حلقہٕ پؠٹھ لوک سبھا منٛز رکن پارلیمان پٲٹھؠ کٲم ۔[1]

english: Jaipur (/ˈdʒaɪpʊər/ ⓘ; Hindi: [ˈdʒeəpʊɾ], also [ˈdʒəjpʊɾ]) is the capital and the largest city of the north-western Indian state of Rajasthan.
kashmiri: جیپور چھِ شمال مغربی ہندوستٲنی ریاست راجستھان راز دٲنؠ تہٕ ساروی کھوتہٕ بۆڑ شہر۔
parentEnglish: Jaipur (/ˈdʒaɪpʊər/ ⓘ; Hindi: [ˈdʒeəpʊɾ], also [ˈdʒəjpʊɾ]) is the capital and the largest city of the north-western Indian state of Rajasthan. As of 2011[update], the city has a population of 3.1 million, making it the tenth most populous city in the country. Located 268 km (167 miles) from the national capital New Delhi, Jaipur is also known as the Pink City due to the dominant color scheme of its buildings in old city.[1]
parentKashmiri: جیپور چھِ شمال مغربی ہندوستٲنی ریاست راجستھان راز دٲنؠ تہٕ ساروی کھوتہٕ بۆڑ شہر۔ 2011 ہس تام، چھ شہرچ آبادی 3.1 ملین، یمہٕ سۭتۍ یہٕ چھ ملکک دٔہِم ساروی کھوتہٕ زیادٕ آبادی وول شہر بنان۔ قومی رازدٲنی نیہ دلہ پیٚٹھٕ 268 دور واقع، جے پور چھ پرٛانہ شہرس منٛز امکیٚن عمارتن ہٕنٛدۍ غلبہٕ رنگہٕ کنہ گلابی شہر کہ ناوٕ تہ زاننہٕ یوان۔[1]

english: Awadh ( Hindi: [əˈʋədʱ] ⓘ), known in British Raj historical texts as Avadh or Oudh, is a historical region in northern India, now constituting the northeastern portion of Uttar Pradesh.

parentEnglish: Awadh ( Hindi: [əˈʋədʱ] ⓘ), known in British Raj historical texts as Avadh or Oudh, is a historical region in northern India, now constituting the northeastern portion of Uttar Pradesh. It is roughly synonymous with the ancient Kosala Region of Hindu, Buddhist, and Jain scriptures.[1]

english: Fantastic Beasts is a film series directed by David Yates and a spin-off prequel to the Harry Potter novel and film series.
kashmiri: زبردست حیوانات چھِ اکھ فلم سیریز یمچ ہدایت کٲری ڈیوڈ یٹس ٲس کٔرمٕژ تہٕ ہیری پوٹر ناول تہٕ فلمی سیریزک اکھ سپن آف پریکویل چھ۔یہ سیریز چھ وارنر بروس تقسیٖم کٔرمٕژ تہٕ چھ ترٛیٚن فینٹسی فلم پیٚٹھ مشتمل، ییٚمیک آغاز فنٹاسٹک بیسٹ اینڈ ویئر ٹو فائد دیم (2016) پیٚٹھٕ گٔیہ تہٕ امہ پتہٕ آیہ فینٹاسٹکس بیسٹس: دی کرائمز آف گرینڈیل والڈ (2018) تہٕ فینٹاسکٹک بیسٹس۔
parentEnglish: Fantastic Beasts is a film series directed by David Yates and a spin-off prequel to the Harry Potter novel and film series. The series is distributed by Warner Bros and consists of three fantasy films, beginning with Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them (2016), and following with Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald (2018) and Fantastic Beasts: The Secrets of Dumbledore (2022).[1][2] Following the 2001–11 film series directly adapting the Harry Potter books, Fantastic Beasts is the second film series in the Wizarding World shared universe media franchise.[3]
parentKashmiri: زبردست حیوانات چھِ اکھ فلم سیریز یمچ ہدایت کٲری ڈیوڈ یٹس ٲس کٔرمٕژ تہٕ ہیری پوٹر ناول تہٕ فلمی سیریزک اکھ سپن آف پریکویل چھ۔یہ سیریز چھ وارنر بروس تقسیٖم کٔرمٕژ تہٕ چھ ترٛیٚن فینٹسی فلم پیٚٹھ مشتمل، ییٚمیک آغاز فنٹاسٹک بیسٹ اینڈ ویئر ٹو فائد دیم (2016) پیٚٹھٕ گٔیہ تہٕ امہ پتہٕ آیہ فینٹاسٹکس بیسٹس: دی کرائمز آف گرینڈیل والڈ (2018) تہٕ فینٹاسکٹک بیسٹس۔ دی سیکرٹس آف ڈمبلڈور (2022) ۔[1][2] ہیری پوٹر کتابہٕ براہ راست اپناون وٲل 2001-11 فلم سیریزہٕ پتہٕ، فینٹاسٹک بیسٹس چھ وزارڈنگ ورلڈک دیم فلم سیریز یم کائناتک میڈیا فرنچائز اشتراک چھ کران۔[1]

kashmiri: زبردست حیوانات: ڈَمبَلڈور سٕنٛدؠ سِر Fantastic) Beasts: The Secrets of Dumbledore)چھےٚ 2022 ہٕچ اکھ فینٹاسی فلم یتھ ڈیوڈ یٹس جے کے رولِنٛگ تہٕ سٹیون کلوز سٕنٛد سکرین پلے پیٚٹھ ہدایت کٲری کٔرمٕژ چھ، یۄس رولِنٛگ سٕنٛد سکریٖن پٔلے پیٚٹھ مبنی چھےٚ۔
parentEnglish: The sequel to Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald (2018), it is the third and final instalment in the Fantastic Beasts film series and the eleventh overall in the Wizarding World franchise. The film features an ensemble cast that includes Eddie Redmayne, Jude Law, Ezra Miller, Dan Fogler, Alison Sudol, Callum Turner, Jessica Williams, Katherine Waterston, and Mads Mikkelsen. Set several years after the events of its predecessor, the film sees Albus Dumbledore tasking Newt Scamander and his allies with a mission that takes them into the heart of dark wizard Gellert Grindelwald's army.
parentKashmiri: زبردست حیوانات: ڈَمبَلڈور سٕنٛدؠ سِر Fantastic) Beasts: The Secrets of Dumbledore)چھےٚ 2022 ہٕچ اکھ فینٹاسی فلم یتھ ڈیوڈ یٹس جے کے رولِنٛگ تہٕ سٹیون کلوز سٕنٛد سکرین پلے پیٚٹھ ہدایت کٲری کٔرمٕژ چھ، یۄس رولِنٛگ سٕنٛد سکریٖن پٔلے پیٚٹھ مبنی چھےٚ۔ فینٹاسٹک بیسٹس: دی کرائمز آف گرینڈیل والڈک سیکوئل چھ فینٹاسٹ بیسٹس فلم سیریٖزک ترٛیم تہٕ آخری قٕسطہٕ تہٕ وزارڈنگ ورلڈ فرنچائزک مجموعی طور پٲٹھۍ کہِم حصہٕ۔ پننس پیشرو سندین واقعاتن ہنٛد کیانٛہہ وٕریو پتہٕ، اتھ فلمہ منٛز چھ وٗچھنہٕ آمت زِ البس ڈَمبَلڈور چھ نیٛوٹ سکیمینڈر تہٕ تہنٛدیو حلیفو سٕتۍ ایکس مشنس سٕتۍ کٲم کران یوس تمن سیاہ جادوگر گیلرٹ گرینڈیل والڈ سٕنٛز فوج کس دلس منٛز نوان چھ۔

One of the greatest Filipino actresses of all time, she was known as Philippine cinema's "superstar" and was conferred as a National Artist of the Philippines for Film and Broadcast Arts in 2022. The Hollywood Reporter called her "The Grand Dame of Philippine Cinema" for her performances in the films Taklub (Trap) and Hustisya (Justice), and for her contributions to the Philippine film industry.

english: Jennifer Coolidge (born August 28, 1961) is an American actress and comedian.
kashmiri: جینِفر کولِج (پیدائش 28 اگست 1961) چھےٚ اکھ امریکی اداکارہ تہٕ کامیڈین۔
parentEnglish: Jennifer Coolidge (born August 28, 1961) is an American actress and comedian. Known for her work in the comedy genre, Coolidge is the recipient of several accolades, including a Golden Globe Award and two Primetime Emmy Awards. In 2023, she was included in the annual Time 100 list of the most influential people in the world.[1]
parentKashmiri: جینِفر کولِج (پیدائش 28 اگست 1961) چھےٚ اکھ امریکی اداکارہ تہٕ کامیڈین۔ کامیڈی صنفس منٛز پننہِ کامہِ خٲطرٕ مشہوٗر، کولِج چھ واریاہ تعٲریٖفہٕ حٲصل کٔرمٕژ، یمن منٛز اکھ گولڈن گلوب ایوارڈ تہٕ زٕ پرائم ٹائم ایمی ایوارڈ شٲمل چِھ۔ 2023 منٛز، آیہٕ یہٕ دنیاہک ساروی کھۄتہٕ زیادٕ اثر انگیز لوٗکن ہنٛد سالانہ ٹائم 100 کس فہرستس منٛز شٲمل کرنہٕ۔[1]

english: The Hindu Gurjars are mostly found in Indian states of Rajasthan, Gujarat, Haryana, Madhya Pradesh, Punjab Plains and Maharashtra.
kashmiri: مسلمان گرجر چھ زیادٕ تر پاکستان کس صوبہٕ پنجاب۔
parentEnglish: The Hindu Gurjars are mostly found in Indian states of Rajasthan, Gujarat, Haryana, Madhya Pradesh, Punjab Plains and Maharashtra. Muslim Gurjars are mostly found in Pakistani province of Punjab, mainly concentrated in Lahore and northern cities of Gujranwala, Gujrat, Gujar Khan and Jhelum; Indian Himalayan regions such as Jammu & Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, and Garhwal and Kumaon divisions of Uttarakhand; and Afghanistan.
parentKashmiri: مسلمان گرجر چھ زیادٕ تر پاکستان کس صوبہٕ پنجاب۔ منٛز لبنہٕ یوان، یم بنیٲدی طور پٲٹھۍ لاہور تہٕ شمٲلی شہرن گجرانوالا گجرات گجر خان تہٕ جھلم ہنٛدستٲنہ ہمالیٲیی علاقن یتھ کٔنۍ جموں و کشمیر ہماچل پردیش تہٕ اتراکھنڈ تہٕ افغانستان گڑھوال تہٕ کماؤں ڈویجنن منٛز مرتکز چھ۔
usageCondition: Preserve original license, attribution and applicable share-alike obligations.

english: On 22 April 2025 at the Baisaran meadow near Pahalgam in the Anantnag district of Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir, militants affiliated with The Resistance Front (TRF) opened fire on a group of tourists, killing at least 28 people and injuring more than 20 others.
kashmiri: 22 اپریل 2025 ہِندوستان کہ زیر انتظام جموں و کشمیر کس اننت ناگ ضلعس منٛز پہلگام نزدیٖک گاسہٕ مٲدانس منٛز کٔر دی ریزسٹنس فرنٹس (ٹی آر ایف) سۭتۍ وابستہٕ دہشت گردن سِیاحن ہنٛدس أکس گروپس پؠٹھ گولہٕ باری، یتھ منٛز کم از کم 28 نفر ہلاک تہٕ 20 کھۄتہٕ زیٛادٕ زخمی گٔیہ۔
parentEnglish: On 22 April 2025 at the Baisaran meadow near Pahalgam in the Anantnag district of Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir, militants affiliated with The Resistance Front (TRF) opened fire on a group of tourists, killing at least 28 people and injuring more than 20 others. The attack, one of the deadliest in the region since the 2019 Pulwama bombing, targeted civilians and was reportedly aimed at resisting alleged demographic changes in the Kashmir Valley.
parentKashmiri: 22 اپریل 2025 ہِندوستان کہ زیر انتظام جموں و کشمیر کس اننت ناگ ضلعس منٛز پہلگام نزدیٖک گاسہٕ مٲدانس منٛز کٔر دی ریزسٹنس فرنٹس (ٹی آر ایف) سۭتۍ وابستہٕ دہشت گردن سِیاحن ہنٛدس أکس گروپس پؠٹھ گولہٕ باری، یتھ منٛز کم از کم 28 نفر ہلاک تہٕ 20 کھۄتہٕ زیٛادٕ زخمی گٔیہ۔ 2019 کس پُلووم حملہٕ پتہٕ خطس منٛز ساروٕے کھۄتہٕ خطرناک حملن منٛز آو عام شہری نشانہٕ بناونہٕ تہٕ وننہٕ چھ یوان ز امیٛک مقصد اوس وادی کشمیرس منٛز مبینہ آبٲدی منٛز تبدیلین ہنٛد مقابلہٕ کرن۔

english: At least 28 people, including tourists and officials, were killed and several others were injured in the attack.
kashmiri: حملس منٛز گٔیہ سیاحن تہٕ اہلکارن ہیتھ کم از کم 28 نفر ہلاک تہٕ واریاہ زخمی۔
parentEnglish: At least 28 people, including tourists and officials, were killed and several others were injured in the attack. Indian authorities declared the incident as a terrorist attack, blaming militants opposed to Indian rule.[1] The Resistance Front (TRF), an offshoot of the militant group Lashkar-e-Taiba, claimed responsibility for the attack.
parentKashmiri: حملس منٛز گٔیہ سیاحن تہٕ اہلکارن ہیتھ کم از کم 28 نفر ہلاک تہٕ واریاہ زخمی۔ ہِندوستٲنؠ حکامو دِت یہ واقعہٕ دہشت گردانہ حملہ قرار، یتھ منٛز ہندوستٲنی حکومتس خٕلاف دہشت گردانہ کاروٲیی ہنٛد اِلزام اوس لگاونہٕ آمت۔[1] دی ریزسٹنس فرنٹنن (ٹی آر ایف) ، دہشت گردانہ گروپ لشکر طیبہ کس أکس شاخہ، دِژ حملٕچ ذمہٕ دٲری قبوٗل۔

english: Survivors reported that the attackers initially posed as policemen, asking for names before suddenly opening fire, targeting men while sparing most women.
kashmiri: بچنہٕ ینہٕ والؠو دِژ اِطلاع زِ حملہٕ آورو کٔر گۄڈنچہ لٹہِ پولیس اہلکار بننک پأٹھؠ پیش، اچانک گولہ چلاونہٕ برٛونٛہہ چِھک ناو پرژھمٔتؠ، زیادٕ تر زنانن ترٛٲوِتھ کۆرُکھ مردن پؠٹھ ٹارگیٹ۔
parentEnglish: Survivors reported that the attackers initially posed as policemen, asking for names before suddenly opening fire, targeting men while sparing most women. Witness accounts suggested the assailants singled out non-Muslims, asking victims to recite the kalma and checking for circumcision. Those who failed were shot.[1][2]

parentKashmiri: بچنہٕ ینہٕ والؠو دِژ اِطلاع زِ حملہٕ آورو کٔر گۄڈنچہ لٹہِ پولیس اہلکار بننک پأٹھؠ پیش، اچانک گولہ چلاونہٕ برٛونٛہہ چِھک ناو پرژھمٔتؠ، زیادٕ تر زنانن ترٛٲوِتھ کۆرُکھ مردن پؠٹھ ٹارگیٹ۔ گواہن ہنٛدین بیانن منٛز چھ وننہٕ آمت ز حملہ آورو کٔر غٲر مسلمان الگ، تہٕ دتن متاثرین کلمہٕ پرنہٕ تہٕ خُتنہٕ وُچھنہٕ خٲطرٕ ؤننہٕ۔ ناکام گژھن والؠن ٲس گولہٕ لگاونہٕ آمت۔[1][2]

english: Witnesses stated that most of the victims were male, with one assailant allegedly telling a woman that she was being spared so she could "narrate the horrors" to the Indian Prime Minister, Narendra Modi.
kashmiri: گواہو ووٚن زِ زیٛادٕ تر شِکار ٲسۍ مرد، أکِس حملہ آورن ووٚن مبینہ طور أکس زنانہٕ ز سۄ چھےٚ بچاونہٕ یوان تاکہ سۄ ہؠکہ ہنٛدستٲنہ وزیر اعظم نریندر مودی "خوفناک واقعہ بیان کٔرتھ"۔
parentEnglish: Witnesses stated that most of the victims were male, with one assailant allegedly telling a woman that she was being spared so she could "narrate the horrors" to the Indian Prime Minister, Narendra Modi. Several victims were shot at close range, and video footage from the scene showed bloodied individuals lying on the ground and others pleading for help.[1] The attackers asked for names and demanded that the victims recite the kalma. They checked for circumcisions to identify and spare Muslims, ensuring they were targeting non-Muslims.[2][3]

english: A joint search and cordon operation involving local police and the Indian Army was launched in the area.

parentEnglish: A joint search and cordon operation involving local police and the Indian Army was launched in the area. Helicopters were deployed to locate the attackers, and a temporary lockdown was imposed in parts of Pahalgam.[1][2]

english: Amitbhai Anilchandra Shah[1][2] (born 22 October 1964) is an Indian politician who is currently serving as the 32nd Minister of Home Affairs since May 2019 and the 1st Minister of Co-operation since July 2021.
kashmiri: اَمِت بھائی انیل چندر شاہ (پیدٲیش 22 اکتوبر 1964) چھ اکھ ہندوستٲنؠ سِیاسَتھ دان یس وٕنکیٚنس مئی 2019 پیٹھہٕ 32 ہم وزیرِ داخلہ تہٕ جولائی 2021 پیٹھہٕ تعاونک گوڈنک وزیٖر پٲٹھۍ کٲم چھ کران۔[1][2] سہ چھ گاندھی نگر خٲطرٕ رکن پارلیمان تہٕ۔
parentEnglish: Amitbhai Anilchandra Shah[1][2] (born 22 October 1964) is an Indian politician who is currently serving as the 32nd Minister of Home Affairs since May 2019 and the 1st Minister of Co-operation since July 2021. He is also the member of parliament (MP) for Gandhinagar. He served as the 10th president of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) from 2014 to 2020.

english: One Direction, often shortened to 1D, were an English-Irish pop boy band formed in London in 2010.
kashmiri: وَن ڈائریکشن، یُس اکثر 1D ، مۄختصر طور پٲٹھؠ یوان کرنہٕ، اوس اکھ انگریزی-آئرش پاپ بوے بینڈ یوس 2010 ہس منٛز لندن منٛز آو بناونہٕ۔
parentEnglish: One Direction, often shortened to 1D, were an English-Irish pop boy band formed in London in 2010. The group consisted of Niall Horan, Zayn Malik (until his departure in 2015), Liam Payne, Harry Styles, and Louis Tomlinson. They became one of the best-selling boy bands of all time and were regarded as one of the most popular and successful boy bands in the world before going on an indefinite hiatus in 2016.
parentKashmiri: وَن ڈائریکشن، یُس اکثر 1D ، مۄختصر طور پٲٹھؠ یوان کرنہٕ، اوس اکھ انگریزی-آئرش پاپ بوے بینڈ یوس 2010 ہس منٛز لندن منٛز آو بناونہٕ۔ اتھ گروپس منٛز ٲسۍ نیال ہوران ،زین ملِک (2015 ہس منٛز تہنٛز روانگی تام) لیام پاین ،ہیری سٹائلز تہٕ لویس ٹاملنسن شٲمل۔ تم بنییہ ہر وقتک ساروی کھوتہٕ زیادٕ فروخت گژھن والن بوائے بینڈن منٛز اکھ تہٕ 2016 ہس منٛز غٲر معینہ مدت تام وقفہٕ برونٹھ ٲس تم دنیاہس منٛز ساروی کھوتہٕ زیادٕ مقبول تہٕ کامیاب بوائے بینڈک پانٹھ سمجھنہٕ یوان۔

english: The first World Book Day was celebrated on 23 April in 1995, and continues to be recognized on that day.

parentEnglish: The first World Book Day was celebrated on 23 April in 1995, and continues to be recognized on that day. A related event in the United Kingdom and Ireland is observed in March.[1] On the occasion of World Book and Copyright Day, UNESCO along with the advisory committee from the major sectors of the book industry, select the World Book Capital for one year. Each designated World Book Capital City carries out a program of activities to celebrate and promote books and reading.[2] In 2024, Strasbourg was designated as the World Book Capital.[3]

english: Baboons are primates comprising the genus Papio, one of the 23 genera of Old World monkeys, in the family Cercopithecidae.
kashmiri: بَبوٗن چھِ پرائمیٹس یمن منٛز پاپیو زیٛوٗدُت شٲمل چھ، یس پرأنؠ دنیا کؠن پنٛزؠن ہنٛز 23 نسلن منٛز اکھ چھ، یس سرکوپیٹیسیڈی خاندانس منٛز چھ۔
parentEnglish: Baboons are primates comprising the genus Papio, one of the 23 genera of Old World monkeys, in the family Cercopithecidae. There are six species of baboon: the hamadryas baboon, the Guinea baboon, the olive baboon, the yellow baboon, the Kinda baboon and the chacma baboon. Each species is native to one of six areas of Africa and the hamadryas baboon is also native to part of the Arabian Peninsula.[1] Baboons are among the largest non-hominoid primates and have existed for at least two million years.

english: Krishna Cottage is a 2004 Indian Hindi-language supernatural horror film directed by Santram Varma and produced by the mother-daughter duo of Shobha Kapoor and Ekta Kapoor, better known for producing Indian television soap operas.
kashmiri: کرشنا کاٹیج چھےٚ 2004 ہٕچ ہِنٛدُستٲنؠ ہندی زَبان ہنٛز بھوٗتیا فِلِم یتھ سنترام ورماہن ہدایت کٲری کٔرمٕژ ٲس تہٕ شوبھا کپوٗر تہٕ ایکتا کپوٗر سٕنٛز ماجہ کورِ دسہ تیار کٔرمٕژ ٲس، یوٚسہٕ ہنٛدستٲنہ ٹیلی وِجَن سوپ اوپیرا تیار کرنہٕ خٲطرٕ مشہوٗر چھ۔
parentEnglish: Krishna Cottage is a 2004 Indian Hindi-language supernatural horror film directed by Santram Varma and produced by the mother-daughter duo of Shobha Kapoor and Ekta Kapoor, better known for producing Indian television soap operas. The film stars Sohail Khan, Isha Koppikar, Anita Hassanandani and Rati Agnihotri. In the film, the surviving copy of an unfinished book containing nine-and-a-half stories turns out to be cursed, and imperils the lives of a group of college friends.

english: Twenty-four genera and 138 species are recognized, making it the largest primate family.
kashmiri: پرٛٲنؠ دُنیٲے پٔنٛزؠ (old world monkeys) چھِ نَر وانٛدَر یِم Cercopithecidae پرٛٲژ منٛز چھِ۔
parentEnglish: Twenty-four genera and 138 species are recognized, making it the largest primate family. Old World monkey genera include baboons (genus Papio), red colobus (genus Piliocolobus), and macaques (genus Macaca). Common names for other Old World monkeys include the talapoin, guenon, colobus, douc (douc langur, genus Pygathrix), vervet, gelada, mangabey (a group of genera), langur, mandrill, drill, surili (Presbytis), patas, and proboscis monkey.
parentKashmiri: پرٛٲنؠ دُنیٲے پٔنٛزؠ (old world monkeys) چھِ نَر وانٛدَر یِم Cercopithecidae پرٛٲژ منٛز چھِ۔ ژووُہ نسلن تہٕ 138 زٲژ چھ تسلیٖم کرنہٕ آمژٕ، یمہٕ سۭتۍ یہٕ چھ ساروی کھوتہٕ بۆڑ پرائمیٹ خاندان بنان چھ ِ۔ پرٛٲنؠ دُنیٲے پٔنٛزؠ نسلن منٛز چھ بَبوٗن (جینز پاپیو) ریڈ کولوبس (جینز پیلیوکولوبس) تہٕ مکاکا (جینز ماکاز) شٲمل۔

english: The common sunflower is harvested for its edible oily seeds, which are often eaten as a snack food.
kashmiri: گُلِ اَکھتاب ، گُلِ آفتاب یا اَکھتاب پوش (common sunflower) (ہیلانتھس اینیوس) چھ ڈیزی خاندانک ایسٹرسی ہنٛد بٔڑس سالانہٕ ممنوعہ قٕسمٕچ اکھ زٲژ۔
parentEnglish: The common sunflower is harvested for its edible oily seeds, which are often eaten as a snack food. They are also used in the production of cooking oil, as food for livestock, as bird food, and as a plantings in domestic gardens for aesthetics. Wild plants are known for their multiple flower heads, whereas the domestic sunflower often possesses a single large flower head atop an unbranched stem.

english: Vatican City,[f] officially the Vatican City State (Italian: Stato della Città del Vaticano;[g] Latin: Status Civitatis Vaticanae),[h][i] is a landlocked country,[1][2] city-state, microstate, and enclave surrounded by, and historically a part of, Rome in Italy.[3][4] It became independent from Italy in 1929 with the Lateran Treaty, and is a distinct territory under "full ownership, exclusive dominion, and sovereign authority and jurisdiction" of the Holy See, which is itself a sovereign entity under international law, maintaining the city-state's temporal power, governance, diplomatic, and spiritual independence.
kashmiri: ویٹِکَن سِٹی سرکٲری طورس پیٹھ ویٹیکن شہرٕچ ریاست (اطالوی: Stato della Città del Vaticano) (لاطینی: Stato Della Cittá del Vaticano) چھ اکھ لینڈ لاک ملک، شہرٕچ ریاست، مائکرو سٹیٹ تہٕ انکلیو چھ ارد گرد، تہٕ تٲریخی طورس پیٹھ چھ اِٹلی ہِنٛد رومک اکھ حصہٕ۔[1][2][3][4] یہٕ بنیو 1929 منٛز لیٹرن معاہدہ سۭتۍ اِٹلی نش آزاد، تہٕ چھ ہولی سی۔
parentEnglish: Vatican City,[f] officially the Vatican City State (Italian: Stato della Città del Vaticano;[g] Latin: Status Civitatis Vaticanae),[h][i] is a landlocked country,[1][2] city-state, microstate, and enclave surrounded by, and historically a part of, Rome in Italy.[3][4] It became independent from Italy in 1929 with the Lateran Treaty, and is a distinct territory under "full ownership, exclusive dominion, and sovereign authority and jurisdiction" of the Holy See, which is itself a sovereign entity under international law, maintaining the city-state's temporal power, governance, diplomatic, and spiritual independence. The Vatican is also a metonym for the pope, the Holy See, and the Roman Curia.[j][5]

english: On 6 May 2025, India stated that its forces have launched "Operation Sindoor" hitting "terrorist infrastructure" in Pakistan.
kashmiri: 6 مئی 2025 منٛز ہندوستانن وون ز امکہ فوجن چھ پاکستانس منٛز "دہشت گردانہ بنیادی ڈھانچس" پیٹھ حملہٕ کرتھ "آپریشن سِندوٗر" شروٗع کوٚرمت۔
parentEnglish: On 6 May 2025, India stated that its forces have launched "Operation Sindoor" hitting "terrorist infrastructure" in Pakistan. Indian forces struck nine sites in Pakistan with missiles.[1] According to reports, intense shelling and loud explosions took place in border areas of Pakistani-administered Kashmir. Pakistan vowed to respond to the "cowardly attack".[2] The Indian Air Force deployed the Rafale jets armed with SCALP missiles and AASM Hammer bombs in the 23 minute-long Operation Sindoor early in the morning of 7 May 2025.[3][4][5]
parentKashmiri: 6 مئی 2025 منٛز ہندوستانن وون ز امکہ فوجن چھ پاکستانس منٛز "دہشت گردانہ بنیادی ڈھانچس" پیٹھ حملہٕ کرتھ "آپریشن سِندوٗر" شروٗع کوٚرمت۔ ہِندوستٲنؠ فوجن لگٲوؠ پٲکِستانس منٛز نَو میزائل تہٕ کۆرُکھ حملہٕ۔[1] رپورٹن مطٲبق گٔیہ پاکستٲنؠ زیر اِنتظام کشمیرٕک سرحدی علاقن منٛز زبردست گولہٕ بٲری تہٕ زورٕ سان دھماکہٕ۔ پٲکِستانن کوٚر "بُزدلانہ حملک" جواب دینک عزم۔[1] ہنٛدستٲنہ ہوٲئی فوجن کٔر 7 میی 2025 چہ صبحس بجہ 23 منٹن ہٕنٛدس آپریشن سِندوٗر منٛز ایس سی اے ایل پی میزائلن تہٕ اے اے ایس ایم ہیمر بم سۭتۍ لیس رافیل جیٹ طیارٕ تعینات۔[1][2][3]

english: The nine locations which were struck includes Bahawalpur, Muridke, Tehra Kalan, Sialkot, Bhimber, Kotli and Muzaffarabad.
kashmiri: یم نَو مقام یمن پؠٹھ حملہٕ آو کرنہٕ تمن منٛز چھ بہاوالپور موریڈکے، تہہرا کلان، سِیال کوٹ، بمبر کوٹلی تہٕ مظفر آباد شٲمل۔
parentEnglish: The nine locations which were struck includes Bahawalpur, Muridke, Tehra Kalan, Sialkot, Bhimber, Kotli and Muzaffarabad. This included terror camps, nerve centres and headquarters of Jaish-e-Mohammed, Lashkar-e-Taiba and Hizbul Mujahideen.[1][2] Reports also suggest that a Pakistani JF-17 was shot down while trying to intrude into Indian airspace. The aircraft crashed in Pulwama's Pampore.[3]
parentKashmiri: یم نَو مقام یمن پؠٹھ حملہٕ آو کرنہٕ تمن منٛز چھ بہاوالپور موریڈکے، تہہرا کلان، سِیال کوٹ، بمبر کوٹلی تہٕ مظفر آباد شٲمل۔ اتھ منٛز ٲسۍ دہشت گردانہ کیمپ، اعصاب مرکز تہٕ جیش محمد لشکر طیبہ تہٕ حزب المجاہدین ہیڈکوارٹر شٲمل۔[1][2] رپورٹہٕ چھ یہ تہِ ونان زِ اکھ پاکستٲنؠ جے ایف 17 آو ہنٛدستٲنؠ ہوٲئی عَلاقس منٛز دراندازی کرنٕچ کوٗششہ دوران شاٹ ڈوُن کرنہٕ۔ ہوٲئی جہاز گوٚو پُلووم کس پامپور منٛز ؤسؠ أکِس سکوٗلس پؠٹھ۔[1]

english: Lame has lived in Italy since he was a year old, and he is fluent in Italian.
kashmiri: لیم چھ اِٹَلی منٛز تمہ وقتہٕ پیٚٹھٕ روزان ییٚلہ سہ اکھ ؤری اوس، تہٕ سہ چھ اطالوی زبٲنۍ منٛز روانی سان بولان۔
parentEnglish: Lame has lived in Italy since he was a year old, and he is fluent in Italian. He was solely a Senegalese citizen living in Milan with his manager until August 2022, when he became an Italian citizen in Chivasso, after the Italian Undersecretary of the Ministry of the Interior Carlo Sibilia announced that he would be granted citizenship.[9][35][36] Lame said he "always felt Italian"[37] and has previously stated that he "did not need a piece of paper" to define himself as such.[8]
parentKashmiri: لیم چھ اِٹَلی منٛز تمہ وقتہٕ پیٚٹھٕ روزان ییٚلہ سہ اکھ ؤری اوس، تہٕ سہ چھ اطالوی زبٲنۍ منٛز روانی سان بولان۔ لامین وون ز سوٛ اوس "ہمیشہ اطالوی محسوس کران" تہٕ برٛونٛٹھ چھ وونمت کہ أمس چھ نہٕ پنن پان بیان کرنہٕ خاطرٕ "کاغذک ٹکڑٕ ہنٛز ضرورت"۔[37][8]

english: Mian Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif[a] (born 23 September 1951) is a Pakistani politician and businessman who has served as the 20th prime minister of Pakistan since March 2024, having previously been in the role between April 2022 to August 2023.
kashmiri: میاں مُحمد شہباز شٔریٖف (پیدٲیش 23 ستمبر 1951) چھ اکھ پٲکستانؠ سِیاسَتھ دان تہٕ کارٕبٲر ییٚمہ مارچ 2024 پیٹھہٕ بطور 20 ہم وزیر اعظم پاکستان کٲم چھ کٔرمٕژ، امہ برٛونٛہہ ٲس اپریل 2022 پیٹھہٕ اگست 2023 تام امہ کردارس منٛز۔
parentEnglish: Mian Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif[a] (born 23 September 1951) is a Pakistani politician and businessman who has served as the 20th prime minister of Pakistan since March 2024, having previously been in the role between April 2022 to August 2023. He has also served as the president of the Pakistan Muslim League (N) (PML-N) and chief minister of Punjab three times, making him the longest-serving person in the role.
parentKashmiri: میاں مُحمد شہباز شٔریٖف (پیدٲیش 23 ستمبر 1951) چھ اکھ پٲکستانؠ سِیاسَتھ دان تہٕ کارٕبٲر ییٚمہ مارچ 2024 پیٹھہٕ بطور 20 ہم وزیر اعظم پاکستان کٲم چھ کٔرمٕژ، امہ برٛونٛہہ ٲس اپریل 2022 پیٹھہٕ اگست 2023 تام امہ کردارس منٛز۔ تٔمہ چھ ترٛیٚیہ لٹہ پاکستان مسلم لیگ (ن) (پی ایم ایل-این) ہک صدر تہٕ پنجابٗک وزیر اعلی تہٕ روزمت، ییٚمہ سۭتہ سہ امہ کردارس منٛز ساروٕے کھۄتہٕ زیٛادٕ کالس کٲم کرن وول شخص بنیٛوو۔

parentEnglish: Mian Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif[a] (born 23 September 1951) is a Pakistani politician and businessman who has served as the 20th prime minister of Pakistan since March 2024, having previously been in the role between April 2022 to August 2023. He has also served as the president of the Pakistan Muslim League (N) (PML-N) and chief minister of Punjab three times, making him the longest-serving person in the role.

parentEnglish: Ajit Kumar Doval KC PPM PM (born 20 January 1945) is an Indian bureaucrat and former spymaster, who is currently serving as the National Security Advisor since 2014. parentEnglish: Flores (Spanish for “Flowers”) is a middle-class barrio or district in the center part of Buenos Aires city, Argentina. Flores was considered a rural area of the Province of Buenos Aires until 1888 when it was integrated into the city. Flores is the birthplace of Pope Francis.

english: Ottawa[a] is the capital city of Canada.
kashmiri: اوٹاوا چُھ کینیڈاہُک راز دٲنؠ ۔
parentEnglish: Ottawa[a] is the capital city of Canada. It is located in the southern portion of the province of Ontario, at the meeting of the Ottawa River and the Rideau River. Ottawa borders Gatineau, Quebec, and forms the core of the Ottawa–Gatineau census metropolitan area (CMA) and the National Capital Region (NCR).[1] As of 2021,[update] Ottawa had a city population of 1,017,449 and a metropolitan population of 1,488,307, making it the fourth-largest city and fourth-largest metropolitan area in Canada.[2][3]
parentKashmiri: اوٹاوا چُھ کینیڈاہُک راز دٲنؠ ۔ یہٕ چھ اونٹاریو کس جنوبی حصس منٛز اوٹاوا دریا تہٕ دریائے رائیڈو کس ملاپس منٛز واقع۔ اوٹاوا چھ گیٹنیو، کیوبیک سۭتۍ متصل، تہٕ اوٹاوا-گیٹنیو مردم شماری میٹروپولیٹن علاقہ (CMA) تہٕ قومی دارالحکومت علاقہٕ (NCR) ہنٛد مرکز چھ بنان۔[1] 2021 ہس تام، ٲس اوٹاوا چہ شہرٕچ آبٲدی 1,017,449 تہٕ میٹروپولیٹن آبادی 1,488,307، یم سٕتۍ یہٕ کینیڈا ہک ژورم ساروی کھۄتہٕ بۆڑ شہر تہٕ ژوٗرِم ساروی کھۄتہٕ بۆڑ میٹروپولیٹ علاقہٕ چھ بنان۔[1][2]

english: Zanskar, Zahar (locally) or Zangskar, is the southwestern region of Kargil district in the Indian union territory of Ladakh.
kashmiri: زَنٛسکار، زہر (مقٲمی طور یا زَنٛگسکار) چھ ہِنٛدستٲنؠ مرکزی زیر اِنتظام عَلاقہٕ لداخ منٛز کرگِل ضلعک جنوب مغربی علاقہٕ۔
parentEnglish: Zanskar, Zahar (locally) or Zangskar, is the southwestern region of Kargil district in the Indian union territory of Ladakh. The administrative centre of Zanskar is Padum. Zanskar, together with the rest of Ladakh, was briefly a part of the kingdom of Western Tibet called Ngari Khorsum.

english: Dras (also spelt Drass, ISO transliteration: Drās), also known locally in Shina as Himababs, Hembabs, or Humas, is a town and hill station in Kargil district of the union territory of Ladakh in India.
kashmiri: درٛاس چھ، یتھ مقٲمی طور پٲٹھۍ شینہ ہس منٛز ہیٚماباب، ہیمباب، یا ہما کس ناوٕ سۭتۍ تہٕ چھ زاننہٕ یوان، چھ ہنٛدستان کس مرکز کس زیر انتظام علاقہٕ لداخ کس ضلعہٕ کرگلک اکھ قصبہٕ تہٕ پہٲڑی مُقام۔
parentEnglish: Dras (also spelt Drass, ISO transliteration: Drās), also known locally in Shina as Himababs, Hembabs, or Humas, is a town and hill station in Kargil district of the union territory of Ladakh in India. It is on the NH 1 between Zoji La pass and Kargil town. A tourist hub for its high-altitude trekking routes and tourist sites, it is often called "The Gateway to Ladakh".[1] The government's official spelling of the town's name is "Drass".[2]

english: Jagmohan Malhotra (25 September 1927 – 3 May 2021),[1] known by the mononym Jagmohan, was an Indian civil servant and politician.
kashmiri: جگموہن ملہوترا (25 ستمبر 1927-3 مئی 2021) یس جگموہن ناوٕ سۭتۍ زاننہٕ چھ یوان اوس اکھ ہِندوستٲنؠ سِوَل سروینٛٹ تہٕ سِیاسَتھ دان۔[1] انڈین نیشنل کانگریس سۭتہ کٲم کرنہٕ پتہٕ گوٚو سہ 1995 تھس منٛز بھارتیہ جنتا پارٹی منٛز شٲمل۔
parentEnglish: Jagmohan Malhotra (25 September 1927 – 3 May 2021),[1] known by the mononym Jagmohan, was an Indian civil servant and politician. After working with the Indian National Congress, he joined the Bharatiya Janata Party in 1995. He served as Lieutenant Governor of Delhi and Goa, as the 5th Governor of Jammu and Kashmir, and for three terms as Member of Parliament for New Delhi.
parentKashmiri: جگموہن ملہوترا (25 ستمبر 1927-3 مئی 2021) یس جگموہن ناوٕ سۭتۍ زاننہٕ چھ یوان اوس اکھ ہِندوستٲنؠ سِوَل سروینٛٹ تہٕ سِیاسَتھ دان۔[1] انڈین نیشنل کانگریس سۭتہ کٲم کرنہٕ پتہٕ گوٚو سہ 1995 تھس منٛز بھارتیہ جنتا پارٹی منٛز شٲمل۔ تٔمہِ كٕر دِلہِ تہٕ گوا كِس لیفٹیننٹ گورنر سٕندِ حشیتہٕ ، جموں و کشمیرٗك 5 ہِم گورنر تہٕ ترٛؠن مُقابلن تام نَیہِ دِلہِ خٲطرٕ بطورِ ممبر پارلیمنٹ خٕدمات سرانجام دِژمٕژ۔ کابینہس منٛز کٔر تٔمۍ شہری ترقی تہٕ سیاحت مرکزی وزیر پٲٹھۍ کٲم۔[1]

parentEnglish: Nicholas Perry (Ukrainian: Ніколас Перрі; born May 19, 1992), better known as Nikocado Avocado, is a Ukrainian-born American internet celebrity and YouTuber known for his mukbang videos. As of September 2024[update], he has accumulated more than 9.9 million subscribers and approximately 2.67 billion total views across six YouTube channels. His online persona is known for his comedic and theatrical performances, gaining excess weight on camera, and generating over 10 billion views on TikTok.
parentKashmiri: نِکولس پیری (یوکرائنی: николас πерия، پیدائش مئی 19، 1992) یس نِکوکاڈو اَووکاڈو کہ ناوٕ سۭتۍ مشہوٗر چُھ، چھِ اکھ یوکرائنی نژاد امریکی انٹرنیٹ مشہوٗر شخصیت تہٕ یوٗٹیٛوٗبر یس پننہٕ مُکبَنٛگ ویٖڈیوز خأطرٕ مشہوٗر۔ ستمبر ہس تام چھ أمۍ شیٚن یوٹیوب چینلن پؠٹھ 9.9 ملین کھۄتہٕ زیٛادٕ سبسکرائبر تہٕ لگ بگ 26.67 ارب کُل ویو جمع کٔرمٕتۍ۔ أمہ سٕنٛز آن لاین شخصیت چھ پنٛنہ مزاحیہ تہٕ تھیٹرٕکی اداکٲری، کیمراہس پیٚٹھ زیٛادٕ وَزَن حٲصل کرنہٕ تہٕ ٹِک ٹاک پیٚٹھ 10 ارب کھۄتہٕ زیٛادٕ ویوٗز بناونہٕ خٲطرٕ زاننہٕ یوان۔

english: In September 2024, he said in a video that he had lost over 250 pounds (114 kg) over the course of two years.
kashmiri: ستمبر 2024 منٛز ووٚن تٔمۍ أکس ویٖڈیو منٛز ز أمۍ اوس دۄن ؤرین دوران 250 پاؤنڈ (114 کلوگرام) کھۄتہٕ زیٛادٕ وَزَن کم کوٚرمت۔
parentEnglish: In September 2024, he said in a video that he had lost over 250 pounds (114 kg) over the course of two years. He said he had concealed this weight loss by uploading prerecorded content. The video, entitled "Two Steps Ahead", garnered over 26 million views within 48 hours.[1] The video remains one of Perry's most successful uploads, garnering more than 50 million views as of February 2025.[2]
parentKashmiri: ستمبر 2024 منٛز ووٚن تٔمۍ أکس ویٖڈیو منٛز ز أمۍ اوس دۄن ؤرین دوران 250 پاؤنڈ (114 کلوگرام) کھۄتہٕ زیٛادٕ وَزَن کم کوٚرمت۔ تٔمۍ ووٚن زِ أمۍ اوس یہ وَزَن کم کرن برٛونٛہہ پؠٹھ ریکارڈ کرنہٕ آمُت مُواد اپ لوڈ کٔرتھ چُھپومت۔ ویٖڈیو، ییٚمیک عنوان "زٕ قدم برٛۄنٛہہ" اوس، 48 گھنٹن منٛز کٔرۍ 26 ملین کھۄتہٕ زیٛادٕ ویوٗز حٲصل۔[1] یہ ویٖڈیو چھ پیری سٕنٛدۍ ساروٕے کھۄتہٕ کامیاب اپلوڈن منٛز اکھ، ییٚمۍ فروری 2025 ہس تام 50 ملین کھۄتہٕ زیٛادٕ ویوٗز حٲصل کٔرۍ۔[1]

english: Jagatpur Theh is a village in Shaheed Bhagat Singh Nagar district of Punjab State, India.
kashmiri: جگت پور تھیہ چھُ ریاست پنجاب ہندوستان کِس شہید بھگت سنگھ نگر ضلع اکھ گام۔
parentEnglish: Jagatpur Theh is a village in Shaheed Bhagat Singh Nagar district of Punjab State, India. It is located 15 kilometres (9.3 mi) away from Banga, 10 kilometres (6.2 mi) from Phagwara, 26 kilometres (16 mi) from district headquarter Shaheed Bhagat Singh Nagar and 119 kilometres (74 mi) from state capital Chandigarh. The village is administrated by Sarpanch an elected representative of the village.[1]
parentKashmiri: جگت پور تھیہ چھُ ریاست پنجاب ہندوستان کِس شہید بھگت سنگھ نگر ضلع اکھ گام۔ یہ چھُ بانگا پؠٹھٕ 15 کلومیٹر (9.3 میل) ، پھگواڑہ پؠٹھٕ 10 کلومیٹر (6.2 میل) ، ضلعہٕ ہیڈکوارٹر شہید بھگت سنگھ نگر پؠٹھٕ 26 کلومیٹر (16 میل) تہٕ ریاستی رازدٲنہ چندی گڑھ پؠٹھٕ 119 کلومیٹر (74 میل) دور واقعہٕ۔ گامُک انتظام چھُ گامک منتخب نمٲیندٕ سرپنچ کران۔[1]

english: A Hamd is usually written in Arabic, Persian, Turkish, Bengali, Punjabi, or Urdu and recited all over the Muslim world, from Indonesia to Morocco.
kashmiri: اکھ حَمُد چھ عام طور عربی، فارسی، ترکی، بنٛگٲلہ پنجابی یا اردوس منٛز لیکھنہٕ یوان تہٕ انڈونیشیا پؠٹھ مراکش تام چھ پوٗرٕ مسلم دُنیاہس منٛز پرنہٕ یوان۔
parentEnglish: A Hamd is usually written in Arabic, Persian, Turkish, Bengali, Punjabi, or Urdu and recited all over the Muslim world, from Indonesia to Morocco. A Qawwali performance usually includes at least one Hamd, which is traditionally at the beginning of the performance.
parentKashmiri: اکھ حَمُد چھ عام طور عربی، فارسی، ترکی، بنٛگٲلہ پنجابی یا اردوس منٛز لیکھنہٕ یوان تہٕ انڈونیشیا پؠٹھ مراکش تام چھ پوٗرٕ مسلم دُنیاہس منٛز پرنہٕ یوان۔ قَوٲلی کارکردگی منٛز چھ عام طور کم از کم اکھ حمد شٲمل آسان، یس رؠوایتی طور پٲٹھۍ کارکردگی ہنٛدس شروٗعاتس منٛز آسان چھ۔

english: The West Bank is located on the western bank of the Jordan River and is the larger of the two Palestinian territories (the other being the Gaza Strip) that make up the State of Palestine.
kashmiri: مَغرَبی بۆٹھ (west bank) چھ دریائے اردن کس مغربی بٔٹِھس پؠٹھ واقعہٕ تہٕ یہٕ چھ دۆن فلسطینی علاقہٕ منٛز بۆڑ (دیم غزہ پٔٹ چھ یس ریاست فلسطین بناوان چھ) ۔
parentEnglish: The West Bank is located on the western bank of the Jordan River and is the larger of the two Palestinian territories (the other being the Gaza Strip) that make up the State of Palestine. A landlocked territory near the coast of the Mediterranean Sea in the Levant region of West Asia,[1] it is bordered by Jordan and the Dead Sea to the east and by Israel (via the Green Line) to the south, west, and north.[2] Since 1967, the territory has been under Israeli occupation, which has been regarded illegal under the law of the international community.[3]
parentKashmiri: مَغرَبی بۆٹھ (west bank) چھ دریائے اردن کس مغربی بٔٹِھس پؠٹھ واقعہٕ تہٕ یہٕ چھ دۆن فلسطینی علاقہٕ منٛز بۆڑ (دیم غزہ پٔٹ چھ یس ریاست فلسطین بناوان چھ) ۔ مَغرَبی ایشیاء کس لیویٹ علاقس منٛز رومی سۆدُر کس ساحلس قریب اکھ زمیٖن بند علاقہٕ، امیٛک سرحد چھ مشرق منٛز اردن تہٕ مۄردٕ سۆدُر تہٕ جنوب، مغرب تہٕ شمالس منٛز اِسرٲیل (گرین لائن کہ ذریع) سۭتۍ متصل۔[1] 1967 پیٹھہٕ چھ یہٕ علاقہٕ اِسرائیلی قبضس منٛز، یس بین الاقوامی برادری ہنٛد قانوٗنس تحت غأر قونوٗنی چھ سمجھنہٕ یوان۔[1]

english: Khichdi or khichri (Urdu: کھچڑی, romanized: khicṛī, Hindi: खिचड़ी, romanized: khicṛī, pronounced [ˈkʰɪtʃɽiː], Bengali: খিচুড়ি, romanized: Khicuṛi, Odia: ଖେଚୁଡି) is a dish in South Asian cuisine made of rice and lentils (dal) with numerous variations.
kashmiri: کچڑی چھ جنوبی ایشیٲیی کھؠن منٛز اکھ کھؠن یس توٚملہٕ تہٕ دالو سۭتۍ چھ بنان (یتھ منٛز واریاہ ویرایٹی چِھ)۔
parentEnglish: Khichdi or khichri (Urdu: کھچڑی, romanized: khicṛī, Hindi: खिचड़ी, romanized: khicṛī, pronounced [ˈkʰɪtʃɽiː], Bengali: খিচুড়ি, romanized: Khicuṛi, Odia: ଖେଚୁଡି) is a dish in South Asian cuisine made of rice and lentils (dal) with numerous variations. Variations include bajra and mung dal khichri. In Indian culture, in several regions, especially in the northern areas, it is considered one of the first solid foods that babies eat.[1][2][3]
parentKashmiri: کچڑی چھ جنوبی ایشیٲیی کھؠن منٛز اکھ کھؠن یس توٚملہٕ تہٕ دالو سۭتۍ چھ بنان (یتھ منٛز واریاہ ویرایٹی چِھ)۔ ویرایٹین منٛز چھ باجٕر تہٕ مۄنٛگہٕ دال کھؠژٕر شٲمل۔ ہندوستٲنی ثقافتس منٛز، کنہہ علاقن منٛز، خاص طور پٲٹھۍ شمٲلی علاقن منٛز، یہٕ چھ گۄڑنک ٹھوس کھؠن منٛز اکھ سمجھنہٕ یوان یس بچہٕ کھؠوان چھ۔[1][2][3]

parentEnglish: The potato (/pəˈteɪtoʊ/) is a starchy tuberous vegetable native to the Americas that is consumed as a staple food in many parts of the world. Potatoes are underground tubers of the plant Solanum tuberosum, a perennial in the nightshade family Solanaceae.

english: The Jordan River or River Jordan (Arabic: نَهْر الْأُرْدُنّ, Nahr al-ʾUrdunn; Hebrew: נְהַר הַיַּרְדֵּן, Nəhar hayYardēn), also known as Nahr Al-Sharieat (Arabic: نهر الشريعة), is a 251-kilometre-long (156 mi) endorheic river in the Levant that flows roughly north to south through the Sea of Galilee and drains to the Dead Sea.
kashmiri: اردن دٔرؠ یاو یا جورڈن دٔرؠ یاو (عربی: نهر الأردنّن، نہر الأردونّن عبرانی: Nəhəhār هيبرددن، Nəhar hayYardēnʼ یتھ نہر الشرییات (عربی: نہر الشریعۃ) تہٕ چھ ونان چھ لیویٹ اکھ 251 کلومیٹر طویل (156 میل) اندورہیک دریا یس گَلیٖل دٔرؠ یاو کہ ذریعہٕ چھ تقریبا شمال پیٹھہٕ جنوب کن بہان تہٕ مۆردٕ سَمَندَر کن چھ وَسان۔
parentEnglish: The Jordan River or River Jordan (Arabic: نَهْر الْأُرْدُنّ, Nahr al-ʾUrdunn; Hebrew: נְהַר הַיַּרְדֵּן, Nəhar hayYardēn), also known as Nahr Al-Sharieat (Arabic: نهر الشريعة), is a 251-kilometre-long (156 mi) endorheic river in the Levant that flows roughly north to south through the Sea of Galilee and drains to the Dead Sea. The river passes by or through Jordan, Syria, Israel, and the Palestinian territories.

english: A salt lake or saline lake is a landlocked body of water that has a concentration of salts (typically sodium chloride) and other dissolved minerals significantly higher than most lakes (often defined as at least three grams of salt per liter).[1] In some cases, salt lakes have a higher concentration of salt than sea water; such lakes can also be termed hypersaline lake, and may also be pink lakes on account of their color.

parentEnglish: A salt lake or saline lake is a landlocked body of water that has a concentration of salts (typically sodium chloride) and other dissolved minerals significantly higher than most lakes (often defined as at least three grams of salt per liter).[1] In some cases, salt lakes have a higher concentration of salt than sea water; such lakes can also be termed hypersaline lake, and may also be pink lakes on account of their color. english: Robert Douglas Thomas Pattinson (born 13 May 1986) is an English actor.
kashmiri: روبٲرٛٹ ڈگلس تھامس پیٚٹِسَن (پیدائش 13 مئی 1986) چھ اکھ انگریز اداکار۔
parentEnglish: Robert Douglas Thomas Pattinson (born 13 May 1986) is an English actor. Known for starring in both major studio productions and independent films, he has been ranked among the world's highest-paid actors, and his works have grossed over $4.7 billion worldwide. In 2010, Time included Pattinson in its list of the 100 most influential people in the world, and he was also featured in the Forbes Celebrity 100.
parentKashmiri: روبٲرٛٹ ڈگلس تھامس پیٚٹِسَن (پیدائش 13 مئی 1986) چھ اکھ انگریز اداکار۔ بڑؠن سٹوڈیو پروڈکشنن تہٕ آزاد فلمن دۄشوٕنی منٛز اداکٲری خٲطرٕ مشہوٗر، سہ چھ دنیاہک ساروی کھوتہٕ زیادٕ پونٛسہٕ زینن والؠن اداکارن منٛز شمار کرنہٕ آمت، تہٕ أمۍ سٕنٛد کامہ چھ پوٗرٕ دنیاہس منٛز 4.7 بلین ڈالر کھۄتہٕ زیادٕ کمایمٕتہ۔ 2010 ہَس منٛز کوٚر ٹایمَن پیٹنسن دُنیاہ کؠن 100 ساروِی کھۄتہٕ زِیٛادٕ بااثر لوٗکَن ہِنٛدِس فہرستَس منٛز شٲمِل، تہٕ سُہ آو فوربس سیلیبریٹی 100 ہَس منٛز تہِ شٲمِل۔

english: Divya Bharti[a] ( Hindi pronunciation: [dɪʋjaː bʱaːrtiː]; 25 February 1974 – 5 April 1993) was an Indian actress who predominantly worked in Hindi and Telugu movies.
kashmiri: دِویا بھارتی ( ہندی تلفظ: [dɪwjaː bʃaːrtiː] 25 فروری 1974-5 اپریل 1993 ٲس اکھ ہندوستٲنی اداکارہ ییٚمہ زیادٕ تر ہِندی تہٕ تیلگوٗ فلمن منٛز کٲم کٔر۔
parentEnglish: Divya Bharti[a] ( Hindi pronunciation: [dɪʋjaː bʱaːrtiː]; 25 February 1974 – 5 April 1993) was an Indian actress who predominantly worked in Hindi and Telugu movies. Known for her acting versatility, vivacity and beauty, she was among the highest-paid Indian actresses of her time. She received a Filmfare Award and a Nandi Award for her performances.[1][2]

english: Jajangmyeon (Korean: 자장면) or jjajangmyeon (짜장면[1]) is a Korean Chinese noodle dish topped with a thick sauce made of chunjang, diced pork, and vegetables.[2] It is a variation of the Chinese dish zhajiangmian; it developed in the late 19th century, during the Joseon period, when Chinese migrant workers from Shandong arrived in Incheon.
kashmiri: جَجَنٛگمیٛون (کورین:자장면) اکھ کورین چیٖنی نوٗڈل کھؠن یتھ پیٹھ چُنٛجنٛگ سوس، سورٕ ماز تہٕ سَبزی سۭتۍ بنان چھ۔[1][2] یہ چھ چینی کھؠن ژاجیانٛگمیانچ اکھ قٕسٕم یس 19 مہ صدی کس ٲخرس منٛز، جوسن دورس دوران تیار گوٚمت، ییلہٕ شَندونٛگ پؠٹھ چینی تارکین وطن کارکن اِنچیٛون وٲتؠ۔
parentEnglish: Jajangmyeon (Korean: 자장면) or jjajangmyeon (짜장면[1]) is a Korean Chinese noodle dish topped with a thick sauce made of chunjang, diced pork, and vegetables.[2] It is a variation of the Chinese dish zhajiangmian; it developed in the late 19th century, during the Joseon period, when Chinese migrant workers from Shandong arrived in Incheon. The Korean variant of the dish uses a darker and sweeter sauce than the Chinese version. Variants of the dish use seafood, or other meats.[3][4]

parentKashmiri: جَجَنٛگمیٛون (کورین:자장면) اکھ کورین چیٖنی نوٗڈل کھؠن یتھ پیٹھ چُنٛجنٛگ سوس، سورٕ ماز تہٕ سَبزی سۭتۍ بنان چھ۔[1][2] یہ چھ چینی کھؠن ژاجیانٛگمیانچ اکھ قٕسٕم یس 19 مہ صدی کس ٲخرس منٛز، جوسن دورس دوران تیار گوٚمت، ییلہٕ شَندونٛگ پؠٹھ چینی تارکین وطن کارکن اِنچیٛون وٲتؠ۔ کورین کھؠن چھ چینی ؤرجن کھوتہٕ زیادٕ مۄٹ تہٕ مۄدُر سوس اِستعمال کران۔ ڈشٕک مختلف قسم چھ سَمَندٔرؠ کھؠن یا دیگر ماز اِستعمال کران۔[1][2]

parentEnglish: Pork is the culinary name for the meat of the pig (Sus domesticus). It is the most commonly consumed meat worldwide,[1] with evidence of pig husbandry dating back to 8000-9000 BCE.[2][3]

parentEnglish: Tuvalu (/tuːˈvɑːluː/ ⓘ too-VAH-loo)[1] is an island country in the Polynesian subregion of Oceania in the Pacific Ocean, about midway between Hawaii and Australia. parentEnglish: Kulgam district is an administrative district of Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir in the disputed Kashmir region.[1][2] It is in the Kashmir division and is located at a distance of 18 kilometres (11 mi) towards south-west of Anantnag. parentKashmiri: کۄلگوم ضِلہٕ چھ ہنٛدستان کہ زیر انتظام جموں و کشمیر اکھ انتظامی ضلعہٕ یس مشترقہٕ کشمیر کس علاقس منٛز واقع چھ۔[1][2] یہ چھ کٔشیٖر ہُنٛد حِصہٕ منٛز تہٕ چھ اننت ناگ کس جنوب مغربس کن 18 کلومیٹر (11 میٖل) کس فاصلس پؠٹھ واقعہٕ۔ ضلعس منٛز چھ بلاک تحصیل تہٕ کۄلگوم قصبہٕ شٲمل۔

english: Satya Pal Malik (born 24 July 1946) is an Indian politician.
kashmiri: ستیہ پال ملِک (پیدٲیش 24 جولائی 1946) چھ اکھ ہندوستٲنؠ سِیاسَتھ دان۔
parentEnglish: Satya Pal Malik (born 24 July 1946) is an Indian politician. Malik served as the 10th and last Governor of the erstwhile state of Jammu and Kashmir, from August 2018 to October 2019, and it was during his tenure that revocation of the special status of Jammu and Kashmir was taken on 5 August 2019. Later, he moved to Goa, becoming the 18th governor, and also served as the 21st Governor of Meghalaya until October 2022.[1][2]
parentKashmiri: ستیہ پال ملِک (پیدٲیش 24 جولائی 1946) چھ اکھ ہندوستٲنؠ سِیاسَتھ دان۔ ملکن کٔر اگست 2018 پؠٹھٕ اکتوبر 2019 تام سابقہ ریاست جموں و کشمیر 10 ہم تہٕ ٲخری گورنر پٲٹھۍ کٲم، تہٕ أمۍ سٕنٛد دورس منٛز آیہ 5 اگست 2019 جموں و کشمیرٕچ خصوٗصی حیثیت ختم کرنہٕ۔ پتہٕ گوٚو سہ گوا، 18 ہم گورنر بنیوو، تہٕ اکتوبر 2022 ہس تام کٔرٕن میگھالیہ ہک 21 ہم گورنر تہ کٲم۔[1][2]

english: The Kun Peak is a part of Nun Kun mountain massif in Ladakh, India.
kashmiri: کن پہاڑ چھ لداخ ہندوستانس منٛز نن کن پہاڑن ہنٛد اکھ حصہٕ۔
parentEnglish: The Kun Peak is a part of Nun Kun mountain massif in Ladakh, India. It is the second highest summit of the massif with elevation of 23,219 ft (7,077 metres) in the western Himalayan Range, located near the Suru valley, on the road connecting Kargil and Zanskar.[1] It is located about 61 km south of Kargil and 141 km west of Leh.
parentKashmiri: کن پہاڑ چھ لداخ ہندوستانس منٛز نن کن پہاڑن ہنٛد اکھ حصہٕ۔ یہ چھ بٔڑس پیمانک دویم ساروی کھوتہٕ تھوٛد چوٹی یتھ مغربی ہمالیٲیی حدس منٛز 23,219 بلندی چھ، یس کرگل تہٕ زنسکارس جوڑن واجنہ سڑکہ پؠٹھ سُروُ وادی نزدیٖک واقع چھ۔[1] یہ چھ کرگل پؠٹھہٕ 61 کلومیٹر جنوبس منٛز تہٕ لیہہ پؠٹھہٕ 141 کلومیٹر مغربس منٛز واقعہٕ۔

english: The district is bounded by the Indian-administered union territory of Jammu and Kashmir to the west, the Pakistani-administered administrative territory of Gilgit–Baltistan to the north, Ladakh's Leh district to the east, and the Indian state of Himachal Pradesh to the south.
kashmiri: کرگِل ضلعہٕ چھ ہنٛدستان کہ زیر انتظام لداخ اکھ ضلعہٕ یس تنازٕ کشمیر علاقس منٛز چھ، یمیک انتظام لداخ کہ مرکزی زیر انتظام علاقہٕ کس طورس پیٚٹھ چھ کرنہٕ یوان۔[1] امیُک ناو چھ کرگِل شہر کس ناوس پؠٹھ تھاونہٕ آمت ییٚتہ ضلعہٕک صدر مقام چھ۔
parentEnglish: The district is bounded by the Indian-administered union territory of Jammu and Kashmir to the west, the Pakistani-administered administrative territory of Gilgit–Baltistan to the north, Ladakh's Leh district to the east, and the Indian state of Himachal Pradesh to the south. Encompassing the historical regions known as Purig, the district lies to the northeast of the Great Himalayas and encompasses part of the Zanskar Range. Its population inhabits the river valleys of Suru, Wakha Rong (not to be confused with the Rong Valley in Leh district), and Sod Valley.

english: Mohammad Rizwan (Urdu: محمد رضوان, pronounced [mʊɦəmməd rɪzwɑːn]; born 1 June 1992) is a Pakistani international cricket player.

parentEnglish: Mohammad Rizwan (Urdu: محمد رضوان, pronounced [mʊɦəmməd rɪzwɑːn]; born 1 June 1992) is a Pakistani international cricket player. He is a right-handed batter and wicket-keeper who is the current captain of the Pakistan team in limited overs cricket. He also captains Pakistan Super League (PSL) franchise Multan Sultans[1][2][3] and the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa team in domestic cricket.[4] He has previously been the vice-captain of the Pakistan team in Test cricket[5] and T20Is.[6]

english: Peshawar[a] is the capital and largest city of the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
kashmiri: پِشاوَر چھ پٲکِستان کس صوبہ خیبر پختونخوا ہک رازدٲنؠ تہٕ ساروی کھۄتہٕ بۆڑ شہر۔
parentEnglish: Peshawar[a] is the capital and largest city of the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It is the sixth most populous city of Pakistan, with a district population of over 4.7 million in the 2023 census.[1][2] It is situated in the north-west of the country, lying in the Valley of Peshawar. Peshawar is primarily populated by Pashtuns, who comprise the second-largest ethnic group in the country.[3][4]
parentKashmiri: پِشاوَر چھ پٲکِستان کس صوبہ خیبر پختونخوا ہک رازدٲنؠ تہٕ ساروی کھۄتہٕ بۆڑ شہر۔ یہ چھِ پاکستانُک شیٚیم ساروی کھوتہٕ زیادٕ آبٲدی وول شہر، یمیچ ضلعہٕ آبادی چھےٚ 2023 چہ مردم شمأری منٛز 47 لَچھ کھۄتہٕ زیادٕ۔[1][2] یہ چھ مٗلکہٕ کس شمال مغربس منٛز واقع، یس وأدی پِشاوَر منٛز واقع چھ۔ پشاور چھ بنیٲدی طور پٲٹھۍ پشتون آباد، یم ملکس منٛز دٔیم ساروی کھوتہٕ بٔڑ نسلی گروپس پیٹھ مشتمل چھ۔[3][4]

english: Liaqat Jafri (born 18 February 1971) is an Indian poet, scholar and researcher of Urdu.
kashmiri: لِیاقت جعفری (پیدٲیش 18 فروری 1971) چھ اکھ ہندوستٲنی شٲیِر، سٕکالر تہٕ اُردوُک محقق۔
parentEnglish: Liaqat Jafri (born 18 February 1971) is an Indian poet, scholar and researcher of Urdu. He has authored books and serves as editor of Alla Taleem magazine, published by Department of Higher Education, Government of Jammu and Kashmir. He represented Jammu and Kashmir in International Festivals and Mushairas held in UAE, South Asia and elsewhere.[1] His poems have gone viral including his popular poem about Narendra Modi.[2][3] He writes songs for Bollywood movies.[4]
parentKashmiri: لِیاقت جعفری (پیدٲیش 18 فروری 1971) چھ اکھ ہندوستٲنی شٲیِر، سٕکالر تہٕ اُردوُک محقق۔ أمہ چھ کتابہٕ تصنیف کٔرمٕژ تہٕ چھ علٰی تٲلیم میگزینک ایڈیٹر پٲٹھۍ کٲم کران، یس محکمہ اعلی تعلیم، حکومت جموں و کشمیر کہ طرفہٕ شایع چھ کرنہٕ آمت۔ تٔمۍ کٔر یو اے ایی، جنوبی ایشیا تہٕ باقین جاین منعقد گژھن وٲلۍ بین الاقوٲمی تہوارن تہٕ مشائرن منٛز جموں و کشمیرٕچ نمٲئندگی۔[1] تہنٛزٕ نظٲمہ چھےٚ وائرل گٔمٕژ یتھ منٛز نریندر مودی متعلق تہنٛز مشہوٗر نظم تہٕ شٲمل چھےٚ۔[1][2] سہ چھ بالی ووڈ فلمن خٲطرٕ بٲتھ لؠکھان۔[1]

parentKashmiri: ابھیشیک شرما (پیدٲیش 30 مئی 1983) یس پیشورانہٕ طور کُرٛشنا اَبھیشیک ناوٕ سۭتۍ زاننہٕ چھ یوان چھ اکھ ہندوستٲنؠ اداکار، مزاح نگار تہٕ ٹیلی وِجَن میزبان۔ سہ چھ ہنٛدستٲنہ ٹیلی وِجنس پؠٹھ کامیڈی سرکس کامیڈی نائٹس بچاو دی کپل شرما شو، تہٕ دی گریٹ انڈین کپل شو ہوؠن کامیڈی شوزن منٛز پننہ مزاحیہ کامہِ باپتھ زاننہٕ یوان۔

english: Hemant Kumar "Harsh" Limbachiya (born 30 January 1987) is an Indian screenwriter, producer, and television host.
kashmiri: ہیمنٛت کُمار "ہَرٕش" لِمباچیا (پیدٲیش 30 جنوری 1987) چھِ اکھ ہِندوستٲنؠ سکرین رائٹر، پروڈیوسر تہٕ ٹیلی وِجَن میزبان۔
parentEnglish: Hemant Kumar "Harsh" Limbachiya (born 30 January 1987) is an Indian screenwriter, producer, and television host. He has written for the shows Comedy Circus Ke Tansen, Comedy Nights Bachao, and Comedy Nights Live.[1] He also wrote dialogues for the film PM Narendra Modi and lyrics for the title-track of the film Malang.[2][3] He has created, produced, and hosted television shows like Khatra Khatra Khatra and Hum Tum Aur Quarantine, along with his wife Bharti Singh.[4][5][6]

english: PM Narendra Modi is a 2019 Hindi-language biographical drama film directed by Omung Kumar, and written by Anirudh Chawla and Vivek Oberoi.
kashmiri: پی ایم نَرینٛدَر مودی چھےٚ 2019 ہٕچ اکھ ہندی زبٲنہ ہٕنٛز زِندگی ہِنٛز دٔلیٖل ہٕنٛز ڈرامہ فلم یتھ اومَنٛگ کُمار ہدایت کٲری کٔرمٕژ چھ، تہٕ یہ چھ انیرُدھ چاولا تہٕ وِویک اوبرائے لیکھمٕژ۔
parentEnglish: PM Narendra Modi is a 2019 Hindi-language biographical drama film directed by Omung Kumar, and written by Anirudh Chawla and Vivek Oberoi. The film is jointly produced by Suresh Oberoi, Sandip Singh, Anand Pandit, Acharya Manish under the banner of Legend Studios. The film's plot is loosely based on the life of Narendra Modi, the 14th Prime Minister of India.
parentKashmiri: پی ایم نَرینٛدَر مودی چھےٚ 2019 ہٕچ اکھ ہندی زبٲنہ ہٕنٛز زِندگی ہِنٛز دٔلیٖل ہٕنٛز ڈرامہ فلم یتھ اومَنٛگ کُمار ہدایت کٲری کٔرمٕژ چھ، تہٕ یہ چھ انیرُدھ چاولا تہٕ وِویک اوبرائے لیکھمٕژ۔ یہ فلم چھےٚ لیجنڈ سٹوڈیوز کس بینرس تحت سُریش اوبرائے سندیٖپ سِنٛگھ آننٛد پنڈت اچاریہ منیشن مشترکہ طور پروڈیوس کٔرمٕژ۔ فلمہ ہنٛد پلاٹ چھ ہندوستان کس 14 ہم وزیر اعظم نَرینٛدَر مودی سنٛز زندگی پؠٹھ مبنی۔

english: Swiggy Limited is an Indian online food ordering and delivery company.
kashmiri: سویگی لمیٹڈ چھِ اکھ ہندوستٲنؠ آن لاین کھؠن آرڈر تہٕ ڈلیوری کمپنی۔
parentEnglish: Swiggy Limited is an Indian online food ordering and delivery company. Founded in 2014, Swiggy is headquartered in Bengaluru and operates in more than 580 Indian cities, as of July 2023.[update][1] Besides food delivery, the platform also provides quick commerce services under the name Swiggy Instamart.
parentKashmiri: سویگی لمیٹڈ چھِ اکھ ہندوستٲنؠ آن لاین کھؠن آرڈر تہٕ ڈلیوری کمپنی۔ 2014 ہس منٛز قٲیم کرنہٕ آمت، سوگی ہنٛد صدر دفتر چھ بنگلورو منٛز تہٕ چھ جولائی 2023 ہس تام 580 کھۄتہٕ زیادٕ ہندوستٲنہ شہرن منٛز کٲم کرانکھیٚن ہنز ڈلیوری علاوٕ چھ یہ پلیٹ فارم سوگی انسٹامارٹ ناوٕ سۭتۍ فوری تجٲرتی خدمات تہ فراہم کران۔[1]

english: Gosal is a village in Shaheed Bhagat Singh Nagar district of Punjab State, India.
kashmiri: گوسلو چھُ ریاست پنجاب ہندوستان کِس شہید بھگت سنگھ نگر ضلع منٛز اکھ گام۔
parentEnglish: Gosal is a village in Shaheed Bhagat Singh Nagar district of Punjab State, India. It is located 3.5 kilometres (2.2 mi) away from postal head office Banga, 15 kilometres (9.3 mi) from Nawanshahr, 13 kilometres (8.1 mi) from district headquarter Shaheed Bhagat Singh Nagar and 108 kilometres (67 mi) from state capital Chandigarh. The village is administrated by Sarpanch an elected representative of the village.[1]

english: Luvsannamsrain Oyun-Erdene (Mongolian: Лувсаннамсрайн Оюун-Эрдэнэ; born 29 June 1980) is a Mongolian politician who served as the 32nd prime minister of Mongolia from 2021 to 2025.
kashmiri: لُوسنامسرین اویُن ایرڈین (منگولی: லுவсனனாமсраян оян-ердене) (پیدائش 29 جون 1980) چھ اکھ منگول سِیاسَتھ دان یس 2021 پیٹھ 2025 تام منگولیاہُک 32 ہم وزیٖرِ اعظم اوس۔
parentEnglish: Luvsannamsrain Oyun-Erdene (Mongolian: Лувсаннамсрайн Оюун-Эрдэнэ; born 29 June 1980) is a Mongolian politician who served as the 32nd prime minister of Mongolia from 2021 to 2025. He was elected to the State Great Khural (Parliament) three times[1] from 2016 to 2025.[2] After losing a vote of no confidence amid the 2025 Mongolian protests, Luvsannamsrain resigned on 3 June and will serve as a caretaker until a replacement is appointed.
parentKashmiri: لُوسنامسرین اویُن ایرڈین (منگولی: லுவсனனாமсраян оян-ердене) (پیدائش 29 جون 1980) چھ اکھ منگول سِیاسَتھ دان یس 2021 پیٹھ 2025 تام منگولیاہُک 32 ہم وزیٖرِ اعظم اوس۔ سہ آو 2016 پؠٹھٕ 2025 تام ترٛیٚیہ لٹہ سٹیٹ گریٹ خرال (پارلیمان) خٲطرٕ منتخب کرنہٕ۔[1][2]

He was elected to the State Great Khural (Parliament) three times[1] from 2016 to 2025.[2] After losing a vote of no confidence amid the 2025 Mongolian protests, Luvsannamsrain resigned on 3 June and will serve as a caretaker until a replacement is appointed.
parentKashmiri: لُوسنامسرین اویُن ایرڈین (منگولی: லுவсனனாமсраян оян-ердене) (پیدائش 29 جون 1980) چھ اکھ منگول سِیاسَتھ دان یس 2021 پیٹھ 2025 تام منگولیاہُک 32 ہم وزیٖرِ اعظم اوس۔ سہ آو 2016 پؠٹھٕ 2025 تام ترٛیٚیہ لٹہ سٹیٹ گریٹ خرال (پارلیمان) خٲطرٕ منتخب کرنہٕ۔[1][2]
