english: The Kashmiris in Punjab, also referred to as Punjabi Kashmiris, are a group of people in the Punjab region who either have partial or full Kashmiri ancestry who have historically migrated from the Kashmir Valley and settled in Punjab.
kashmiri: پنٛجابس منٛز چھ کٲشِرؠ یمن پنجابی کٲشِرؠ تہٕ ونان چھ، پَنٛجاب خطس منٛز چھ لوٗکن ہنٛد اکھ گروپ یمن ہنٛد یا تہٕ جزوی یا مکمل کٲشِرؠ نسب چھ یم تٲریخی طور وادی کشمیر پؠٹھ ہجرت کرتھ پنجابس منٛز آباد چھ گٔمٕتۍ۔
parentEnglish: The Kashmiris in Punjab, also referred to as Punjabi Kashmiris, are a group of people in the Punjab region who either have partial or full Kashmiri ancestry who have historically migrated from the Kashmir Valley and settled in Punjab. Most people of this category identify as Punjabis with Kashmiri descent, either some or full. Kashmiri migration from the Kashmir Valley to Punjab continued during Sikh and Dogra rule.[1]

english: Thai,[lower-alpha 1] or Central Thai[b] (historically Siamese;[c][lower-alpha 2] Thai: ภาษาไทย), is a Tai language of the Kra–Dai language family spoken by the Central Thai, Mon, Lao Wiang, Phuan people in Central Thailand and the vast majority of Thai Chinese enclaves throughout the country.

parentEnglish: Thai,[lower-alpha 1] or Central Thai[b] (historically Siamese;[c][lower-alpha 2] Thai: ภาษาไทย), is a Tai language of the Kra–Dai language family spoken by the Central Thai, Mon, Lao Wiang, Phuan people in Central Thailand and the vast majority of Thai Chinese enclaves throughout the country. english: Graz ( Austrian German: [ɡraːts] ⓘ) is the capital of the Austrian federal state of Styria and the second-largest city in Austria, after Vienna.
kashmiri: گرٛاژھ ( چھِ آسٹریا کہ وفاقی ریاست شَٹَیامارٛک ہک رازدأنؠ تہٕ ویانا پتہٕ چھ آسٹریا ہک دویم ساروی کھوتہٕ بھڑ شہر۔
parentEnglish: Graz ( Austrian German: [ɡraːts] ⓘ) is the capital of the Austrian federal state of Styria and the second-largest city in Austria, after Vienna. As of 1 January 2025, Graz had a population of 306,068 (343,461 including secondary residence).[1] In 2023, the population of the Graz larger urban zone (LUZ) stood at 660,238.[2] Graz is known as a city of higher education, with four colleges and four universities. Combined, the city is home to more than 60,000 students.[3] Its historic centre (Altstadt) is one of the best-preserved city centres in Central Europe.[4]
parentKashmiri: گرٛاژھ ( چھِ آسٹریا کہ وفاقی ریاست شَٹَیامارٛک ہک رازدأنؠ تہٕ ویانا پتہٕ چھ آسٹریا ہک دویم ساروی کھوتہٕ بھڑ شہر۔ 1 جنوری 2025 ہس تام، گرازچ آبادی أس 306,068 (343,461 بشمول ثانوی رہائش گاہ) ۔[1] 2023 منٛز، گراز بھڑ شہری زونچ آبادی أس 660,238۔[2] گرٛاژھ چھ اعلٰی تعٲلیٖم کس شہر کس طورس پیٚٹھ زاننہٕ یوان، یتھ منٛز ژور کالج تہٕ ژور یونیورسٹیایہِ چھَ۔ ونہٕ کینس چھ برطانیہس منٛز پندہ منظور شدہ پروگرام، یتھ منٛز 60، 000 کھوتہٕ زیادٕ طلباء چھ شأمل۔[3] امک تٲریخی مرکز چھ وسطی یورپک بہترین محفوظ شہر مرکزو منٛز اکھ۔[4]

english: Since 27 May 2025, hundreds of Palestinians have been killed and wounded by Israeli gunfire as they approached a newly established aid distribution site in Rafah in the Gaza Strip, operated by the United States-backed Gaza Humanitarian Foundation (GHF).
kashmiri: 27 مئی 2025 پیٹھہٕ چھ ہتہٕ بٔد فلسطینی لوٗکھ اِسرائیلی گولہ باری سۭتۍ ہلاک تہٕ زخمی گومت ییلہٕ تم غزہ پٔٹ منٛز رَفَح منٛز اکہ نوٕ قائم امداد تقسیم کس جایہٕ قریب وٲتہ، یس امریکہ کہ حمایت یافتہ غزہ ہیومنٹیرین فاؤنڈیشن (جی ایچ ایف) کہ ذریع چلاونہٕ چھِ یوان۔
parentEnglish: Since 27 May 2025, hundreds of Palestinians have been killed and wounded by Israeli gunfire as they approached a newly established aid distribution site in Rafah in the Gaza Strip, operated by the United States-backed Gaza Humanitarian Foundation (GHF). 10 Palestinians were killed and 62 were wounded in the 27 May incident,[1] while another 32 were killed and over 250 were injured on 1 June.[2][3] The incidents began taking place on the first day of the GHF's operations, following an 11-week Israeli blockade since early March 2025 that had severely restricted humanitarian aid to Gaza, exacerbating the Gaza humanitarian crisis.[4][5][6]
parentKashmiri: 27 مئی 2025 پیٹھہٕ چھ ہتہٕ بٔد فلسطینی لوٗکھ اِسرائیلی گولہ باری سۭتۍ ہلاک تہٕ زخمی گومت ییلہٕ تم غزہ پٔٹ منٛز رَفَح منٛز اکہ نوٕ قائم امداد تقسیم کس جایہٕ قریب وٲتہ، یس امریکہ کہ حمایت یافتہ غزہ ہیومنٹیرین فاؤنڈیشن (جی ایچ ایف) کہ ذریع چلاونہٕ چھِ یوان۔ 27 میی کس واقعس منٛز گیۍ 10 فلسطینی ہلاک تہٕ 62 زخمی، ییلہٕ زن 1 جون دۄہ مزیٖد 32 افراد ہلاک تہٕ 250 کھوتہٕ زیادٕ زخمی گیۍ۔[1][2][3] یہ واقعہٕ گٔیہ مارچ 2025 کس شروعات پیٚٹھٕ 11 ہفتن ہٕنٛز اسرائیلی ناکہ بندی پتہٕ جی ایچ ایف چہ کاروٲیی ہٕنٛد گۄڈنکس دۄہ شروع، ییٚمۍ غزہس منٛز انسٲنی امداد سخٕت رکٲوۍ، ییٚمہ سۭتۍ غزہ چہ انسانی امدادک بحران بڑیٛو۔[1][2][3]

english: Urdu literature (Urdu: ادبیاتِ اُردُو, “Adbiyāt-i Urdū”) comprises the literary works, written in the Urdu language.
kashmiri: اُردوٗ اَدَب (اردو: ادبیات اردو، "ادبیات اردو" چھ اردو زبٲنۍ منٛز لیکھنہٕ آمتیٚن ادبی کامین پیٚٹھ مُشتمل۔
parentEnglish: Urdu literature (Urdu: ادبیاتِ اُردُو, “Adbiyāt-i Urdū”) comprises the literary works, written in the Urdu language. While it tends to be dominated by poetry, especially the verse forms of the ghazal (غزل) and nazm (نظم), it has expanded into other styles of writing, including the short story, or afsana (افسانہ). Urdu literature is popular mostly in Pakistan, where Urdu is the national language, and in India, where it is an Eighth Schedule language. [citation needed]
parentKashmiri: اُردوٗ اَدَب (اردو: ادبیات اردو، "ادبیات اردو" چھ اردو زبٲنۍ منٛز لیکھنہٕ آمتیٚن ادبی کامین پیٚٹھ مُشتمل۔ ییلہٕ زن اتھ پیٹھ چھ شاعری۔ ہنٛد غلبہ آسان، خاص طورس پیٹھ غزال آیتہٕ ہنٛز شکلہٕ (غزل تہٕ نظم) اتھ چھ تحریرک باقی طرزن منٛز توسیع آمژ کرنہٕ، بشمول مختصر کہانی، یا افسانا (افسانہ) ۔ اُردوٗ اَدَب چھ زیادٕ تر پاکستانس منٛز مشہوٗر، ییٚتہ اردو قومی زبان چھ، تہٕ ہِندوستانس منٛز، ییٚتہ یہ ٲٹھمس فہرستٕچ زَبان چھ۔

english: Melissa Anne Hortman (née Haluptzok; May 27, 1970 – June 14, 2025) was an American lawyer and Democratic–Farmer–Labor politician from Hennepin County, Minnesota.
kashmiri: میلیسا این ہارٹمین (نیے ہالوپٹوک 27 مئی 1970-14 جون 2025) ٲس اکھ امریکی ؤکیل تہٕ ہینپین کاؤنٹی، مینیسوٹا ہٕچ ڈیموکریٹک-زمیندار-لیبر سِیاسَتھ دان۔
parentEnglish: Melissa Anne Hortman (née Haluptzok; May 27, 1970 – June 14, 2025) was an American lawyer and Democratic–Farmer–Labor politician from Hennepin County, Minnesota. She represented northern parts of the Twin Cities metropolitan area in the Minnesota House of Representatives from 2005 until her assassination in 2025, serving as the state house minority leader from 2017 to 2019 and as the 61st speaker of the Minnesota House of Representatives from 2019 to 2025. During her tenure, she advocated for transportation, environmental rights, abortion rights, police reform, and gun control policies, and was the chief author of the state's solar energy standard.
parentKashmiri: میلیسا این ہارٹمین (نیے ہالوپٹوک 27 مئی 1970-14 جون 2025) ٲس اکھ امریکی ؤکیل تہٕ ہینپین کاؤنٹی، مینیسوٹا ہٕچ ڈیموکریٹک-زمیندار-لیبر سِیاسَتھ دان۔ تیم کٕر 2005 پیٹھہٕ 2025 ہس منٛز پننس قتلس تام مینیسوٹا ہاؤس آف ریپریزنٹیٹوز منز جڑواں شہر میٹروپولیٹن علاقہٕ کین شمٲلی حصن ہِنٛز نمائندگی، 2017 پیٹھہٕ 2019 تام ریاستی ایوان اقلیتی رہنما تہٕ 2019 پیٹھہٕ 2025 تام مینیسوٹ ہاؤس آف ریپریجنٹیٹوز کس 61 مہ سپیکر کس طورس پؠٹھ خدمات انجام۔ پننِس دورس دوران کٔر ٹرانسپورٹیشن، ماحولیٲتی حقوق، اسقاط حملٕک حقوق، پُلیٖس اِصلاح، تہٕ بندوٗق کنٹرول پالیسی ہنٛز وکالت، تہٕ ٲس ریاستک تاپہٕ توانائی معیار چ اہم مصنف۔

english: Iran University of Science and Technology (IUST) (Persian: دانشگاه علم و صنعت ایران, Dâneshgâh-e 'elm va San'at-e Irân) is a research institution and university of engineering and science in Iran.
kashmiri: ایٖران یونیورسٹی آف ساینَس اینڈ ٹیکنالوجی (IUST) (فارسی: دانشگاہ علم و صنعت ایران، Dâneshgâh-e 'elm va San' at-e Irán) چھ ایٖرانس منٛز اکھ تحقیٖقی ادارٕ تہٕ اِنٛجیٖنَرِنٛگ تہٕ سائنسٕچ یونیورسٹی۔
parentEnglish: Iran University of Science and Technology (IUST) (Persian: دانشگاه علم و صنعت ایران, Dâneshgâh-e 'elm va San'at-e Irân) is a research institution and university of engineering and science in Iran. The university is home to 15 faculties offering undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in a wide range of engineering-based subjects as well as maths, physics, and department of foreign languages. In 1995 IUST awarded Iran’s first PhDs in materials, metallurgical and traffic engineering.

parentEnglish: Violeta Barrios Torres de Chamorro ( Spanish pronunciation: [bjoˈleta tʃaˈmoro]; 18 October 1929 – 14 June 2025) was a Nicaraguan politician who served as the 55th president of Nicaragua from 1990 to 1997. english: Jawed Karim (born October 28, 1979) is an American software engineer and Internet entrepreneur.
kashmiri: جاوید کریٖم (پیدٲیش 28 اکتوبر 1979) چھِ اکھ امریکی سافٹ ویئر انجینئر تہٕ انٹرنیٹ کاروباری شخص۔
parentEnglish: Jawed Karim (born October 28, 1979) is an American software engineer and Internet entrepreneur. He is one of the co-founders of YouTube and the first person to upload a video to the site. The site's inaugural video, "Me at the zoo", uploaded on April 24, 2005, has been viewed over 360 million times as of May 2025.[1] During Karim's time working at PayPal, where he met fellow YouTube co-founders Steve Chen and Chad Hurley, he designed many of its core components, including its real-time anti-fraud system.
parentKashmiri: جاوید کریٖم (پیدٲیش 28 اکتوبر 1979) چھِ اکھ امریکی سافٹ ویئر انجینئر تہٕ انٹرنیٹ کاروباری شخص۔ سہ چھ یوٗٹیٛوٗب شریک بانؠن منٛز اکھ تہٕ سائٹہ پؠٹھ ویٖڈیو اَپ لوڈ کرن وول گۄڑنیک نفر۔ سائٹک افتتاحی ویڈیو، "می ایٹ دَ زوٗ"، یُس 24 اپریل 2005 منٛز اَپ لوڈ اوس آمت کرنہٕ، مئی 2025 تام چھ 360 ملین کھوتہٕ زیادٕ لٹہِ ؤچھنہٕ آمت۔[1] کریٖم سٕند پے پال منٛز کٲم کرنہٕ وز، یتہ تیم یوٹیوبٕک سٲتھی بانیں سٕٹیٖو چِن تہٕ چیڈ ہرلی سٕتۍ مُلاقات کٕر، تیم کٕر امکہ واریاہ بنیٲدی اجزاء ڈیزائن، یمن منٛز امیٛوٗک ریئل ٹائم اینٹی فراڈ سسٹم تہٕ شٲمل اوس۔

english: Jammu and Kashmir attracts tourists for its diverse landscape, cultures and weather as well as for adventure activities in the Himalayas such as skiing, mountaineering, hiking, trekking and camping.
kashmiri: جموں و کشمیر چھ سیاحن پننہِ متنوع زمینک تزئین، ثقافتہٕ تہٕ موسمہٕ سۭتۍ سۭتۍ ہمالیہ منٛز مہم جو سرگرمین یتھ کٔنۍ زن سکینگ، کوہ پیمائی، پیدل سفر، ٹریکنگ تہٕ کیمپنگ خٲطرٕ پانس کن متوجہ کران۔
parentEnglish: Jammu and Kashmir attracts tourists for its diverse landscape, cultures and weather as well as for adventure activities in the Himalayas such as skiing, mountaineering, hiking, trekking and camping. Some major tourist attractions in Jammu and Kashmir are Srinagar, with its renowned Dal Lake and Mughal Gardens, Gulmarg, Pahalgam, Bhaderwah, Devigol Bunjwah, Patnitop, Sonamarg and Jammu. Every year, thousands of Hindu pilgrims visit holy shrines of Vaishno Devi and Amarnath which has had a significant impact on the state's economy.[1]
parentKashmiri: جموں و کشمیر چھ سیاحن پننہِ متنوع زمینک تزئین، ثقافتہٕ تہٕ موسمہٕ سۭتۍ سۭتۍ ہمالیہ منٛز مہم جو سرگرمین یتھ کٔنۍ زن سکینگ، کوہ پیمائی، پیدل سفر، ٹریکنگ تہٕ کیمپنگ خٲطرٕ پانس کن متوجہ کران۔ جموں و کشمیرٕک کینٛہہ اہم سِیاحتی مُقام چھ سِریٖنَگَر، یتھ منٛز مشہوٗر ڈل تہٕ مغل باغات، گُلمَرگ پہلگام، بھدٕرواہ، دؠوگۆل بُنٛزواہ، پٹنی ٹاپ، سۄنہٕ مرٕگ، تہٕ جۆم چِھ۔ پرٛؠتھ ؤریہ چھ ساسہٕ بٔدۍ ہیٚنٛد یاتری ویشنو دیوی تہٕ امرناتھ کیٚن مُقدس جاین یوان یمن ہنٛد ریاست چہ معیشت پؠٹھ نمایاں اثر چُھ۔[1]

parentEnglish: Jammu and Kashmir attracts tourists for its diverse landscape, cultures and weather as well as for adventure activities in the Himalayas such as skiing, mountaineering, hiking, trekking and camping. Some major tourist attractions in Jammu and Kashmir are Srinagar, with its renowned Dal Lake and Mughal Gardens, Gulmarg, Pahalgam, Bhaderwah, Devigol Bunjwah, Patnitop, Sonamarg and Jammu. Every year, thousands of Hindu pilgrims visit holy shrines of Vaishno Devi and Amarnath which has had a significant impact on the state's economy.[1]

english: The state flag of Jammu and Kashmir was a symbol used in the former Indian state of Jammu and Kashmir, between 1952 and 2019, under the special status accorded to the region by Article 370 of the Constitution of India.
kashmiri: جموں و کشمیر ریاستی جھنڈٕ اوس اکھ علامت یس 1952 تہٕ 2019 ہس درمیان، ہندوستان کس ٲیینٕکہ پرَٛکٕرٲن ۳۷۰ کہ ذریعہ خطس دنہٕ آمتس خصوٗصی حیثیتس تحت، گۄڈٕ ہندوستٲنی ریاست جموں و کشمیرس منٛز اِستعمال کرنہٕ آو۔
parentEnglish: The state flag of Jammu and Kashmir was a symbol used in the former Indian state of Jammu and Kashmir, between 1952 and 2019, under the special status accorded to the region by Article 370 of the Constitution of India. It was a red-and-white flag with a representation of a plough and three constituent regions of the state. After the abolition of Article 370 in August 2019, this flag lost its official status.[1]
parentKashmiri: جموں و کشمیر ریاستی جھنڈٕ اوس اکھ علامت یس 1952 تہٕ 2019 ہس درمیان، ہندوستان کس ٲیینٕکہ پرَٛکٕرٲن ۳۷۰ کہ ذریعہ خطس دنہٕ آمتس خصوٗصی حیثیتس تحت، گۄڈٕ ہندوستٲنی ریاست جموں و کشمیرس منٛز اِستعمال کرنہٕ آو۔ یہ اوس اکھ وۄزٕل تہٕ سفید جھنڈٕ یتھ منٛز اکھ البٲنؠ تہٕ ریاستٕکۍ ترٛیٚن حصن ہٕنٛز نُمایندگی ٲس۔ اگست 2019 منٛز آرٹیکل 370 ختم کرنہٕ پتہٕ، گوٚمت امہ جھنڈٕ سنٛد سرکٲری حیثیت۔[1]

parentEnglish: Zahid Mahmood (Sindhi: زاهد محمود ڀٽي; born 20 March 1988) is a Pakistani cricketer who plays for Southern Punjab. He made his international debut for the Pakistan cricket team in February 2021.[1] He made his Test debut against England in December 2022.[2]

english: Reptiles, as commonly defined, are a group of tetrapods with an ectothermic metabolism and amniotic development.
kashmiri: سَریسۄرَپھ ہا رینٛگن وٲلۍ جانور (Reptiles) ، یتھ کٔنۍ عام طور پٲٹھۍ بیان چھ یوان کرنہٕ، چھ ٹیٹراپوڈس اکھ گرٛوپ یتھ منٛز اکٹوتھرمیک میٹابولزم تہٕ امنیٹک نشوونما چھ آسان۔
parentEnglish: Reptiles, as commonly defined, are a group of tetrapods with an ectothermic metabolism and amniotic development. Living traditional reptiles comprise four orders: Testudines, Crocodilia, Squamata, and Rhynchocephalia. About 12,000 living species of reptiles are listed in the Reptile Database.[1] The study of the traditional reptile orders, customarily in combination with the study of modern amphibians, is called herpetology.
parentKashmiri: سَریسۄرَپھ ہا رینٛگن وٲلۍ جانور (Reptiles) ، یتھ کٔنۍ عام طور پٲٹھۍ بیان چھ یوان کرنہٕ، چھ ٹیٹراپوڈس اکھ گرٛوپ یتھ منٛز اکٹوتھرمیک میٹابولزم تہٕ امنیٹک نشوونما چھ آسان۔ زندٕ روٲیتی سَریسۄرَپھ جانورن منٛز چھ ژۄن وۄٹٕچؠ پیٹھ مشتمل: ٹیسٹوڈینز، کروکوڈیلیا سکاماتا تہٕ رائنکوسیفلیا۔ رینگنہٕ والن جانورن ہنز تقریبا 12,000 زٲژ چھ سَریسۄرَپھ ڈیٹا بیسس منٛز درٕج۔[1]

parentEnglish: On June 6, 2025, protests erupted in Los Angeles after Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents raided several city locations to arrest individuals allegedly involved in illegal immigration to the United States. parentEnglish: Sajid Kamran Khan (born 23 November 1970)[1] is an Indian film director, television presenter, comedian and an actor who works in the Hindi film industry. english: Iran says its nuclear program is only for peaceful purposes and has refused to stop enriching uranium completely.
kashmiri: ایران چھِ ونان ز امیُک پَرمانوٗ پروگرام چھِ صرف پرامن مقصدن خٲطرٕ تہٕ چھ یورینیم افزودگی پوٗرٕ پٲٹھۍ رُکاونہٕ نش اِنکار کوٚرمُت۔
parentEnglish: Iran says its nuclear program is only for peaceful purposes and has refused to stop enriching uranium completely. Iran's Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has declared that nuclear weapons are against Islam, and the country insists it has not worked on developing nuclear weapons since 2009.[1][2]
parentKashmiri: ایران چھِ ونان ز امیُک پَرمانوٗ پروگرام چھِ صرف پرامن مقصدن خٲطرٕ تہٕ چھ یورینیم افزودگی پوٗرٕ پٲٹھۍ رُکاونہٕ نش اِنکار کوٚرمُت۔ ایرانٕک سپریم لیڈر آیت اللہ علی خامنہ ایی چھ اعلان کوٚرمت ز پَرمانوٗ ہتھیار چھ اسلام خلاف، تہٕ مُلک چِھ اصرار کران ز تِمو چُھنہٕ 2009 پیٹھہٕ پَرمانوٗ ہتھیار تیار کرنس پؠٹھ کٲم کٔرمٕژ۔[1][2]

english: Ratlam is a city in the northwestern part of the Malwa region in Madhya Pradesh state of India.
kashmiri: رتلام چھُ ہندوستان چہ ریاست مدھیہ پردیش کِس مالوا خطہٕ کِس شمال مغربی حصس منٛز اکھ شہر۔
parentEnglish: Ratlam is a city in the northwestern part of the Malwa region in Madhya Pradesh state of India. The city of Ratlam lies 480 metres (1,570 ft) above sea level. It is the administrative headquarters of Ratlam district, which was created in 1947 after the independence of India.[1] It is located 294 kilometres west of the state capital Bhopal.

It is the administrative headquarters of Ratlam district, which was created in 1947 after the independence of India.[1] It is located 294 kilometres west of the state capital Bhopal.

english: Aga Syed Ruhullah Mehdi was born into a prominent religious and political family in Budgam, Jammu and Kashmir.
kashmiri: آغا سید روح اللہ مہدی زاو جموں و کشمیر کس بڈگامس منٛز أکس مشہوٗر مذہبی تہٕ سیٲسی خانٛدانس منٛز۔
parentEnglish: Aga Syed Ruhullah Mehdi was born into a prominent religious and political family in Budgam, Jammu and Kashmir. His family, the Aga Family, has deep roots in the Shia Muslim community of the region, with a legacy of religious scholarship and leadership. His father, Aga Syed Mehdi, was a respected cleric and politician who played a significant role in the development of region's religious and political landscape.
parentKashmiri: آغا سید روح اللہ مہدی زاو جموں و کشمیر کس بڈگامس منٛز أکس مشہوٗر مذہبی تہٕ سیٲسی خانٛدانس منٛز۔ أمہ سنٛد خانٛدان، آغا خانٛدان چھ خطہٕ چہ شیعہ مسلمان برادری منٛز سخٕت جڑو، یتھ منٛز مذہبی علم تہٕ قیادتک وراثت چھِ۔ تمہ سند مول، آغا سید مہدی اوس اکھ قٲبل احترام علما تہٕ سِیاسَتھ دان یمو علاقٕک مذہبی تہٕ سیٲسی منظر نامہٕ چہ ترقی منٛز اہم کردار ادا کوٚر۔

parentEnglish: Ruhullah Mehdi grew up in the environment of religious influence and political activism. He received his early education from Tyndale Biscoe School. After the untimely demise of his father in 2000, Ruhullah Mehdi stepped into politics.[2][3][4]

english: Aga Ruhullah, shot into prominence after 2019 for his outspoken and fiery speeches, against the abrogation of Article 370.
kashmiri: آغا روح اللہ، آیہ 2019 پتہٕ آرٹیکل 370 ختم کرنس خِلاف پننہِ واضح تہٕ نارٕ دار تقریرو سٕتہِ مشہوٗر گۆو۔
parentEnglish: Aga Ruhullah, shot into prominence after 2019 for his outspoken and fiery speeches, against the abrogation of Article 370. In the Year 2006, he was Chosen by the US embassy for International Visitors Leadership Program in USA as youngest Indian Legislator. In 2010, he was awarded by Network 18, CNN-IBN as the Youngest Indian Leader.[1]
parentKashmiri: آغا روح اللہ، آیہ 2019 پتہٕ آرٹیکل 370 ختم کرنس خِلاف پننہِ واضح تہٕ نارٕ دار تقریرو سٕتہِ مشہوٗر گۆو۔ 2006 تھس منٛز آو سہ امریکی سفارت خانہٕ طرفہٕ امریکہس منٛز بین الاقوٲمی وزیٹر لیڈرشپ پروگرام باپتھ ساروٕے کھۄتہٕ کم وٲنٛسہ ہنٛدستٲنہ قانون ساز سنٛد پٲٹھۍ منتخب کرنہٕ۔ 2010 ہس منٛز آو تٔمس نیٹ ورک 18، سی این این-آئی بی این کہ طرفہٕ ساروٕے کھۄتہٕ کم وٲنٛسہ ہنٛدستٲنؠ رہنما سنٛد اعزاز دنہٕ۔[1]

english: Aga Syed Mehdi (19 February 1959 – 3 November 2000) was a prominent Shia cleric and politician from the Kashmir region.
kashmiri: آغا سید مہدی (19 فروری 1959-3 نومبر 2000) اوس اکھ ممتاز شیعہ عٲلم تہٕ کشمیر علاقک سِیاسَتھ دان۔
parentEnglish: Aga Syed Mehdi (19 February 1959 – 3 November 2000) was a prominent Shia cleric and politician from the Kashmir region. He belonged to the influential Aga family, known for their religious leadership within the Shia Muslim community. Aga Syed Mehdi played an important role in local politics and religious matters in Jammu and Kashmir, particularly advocating for the rights and interests of the Shia population.
parentKashmiri: آغا سید مہدی (19 فروری 1959-3 نومبر 2000) اوس اکھ ممتاز شیعہ عٲلم تہٕ کشمیر علاقک سِیاسَتھ دان۔ سہ اوس بااثر آغا خانٛدانس سۭتۍ تعلق تھاوان، یس شیعہ مسلمان برادری منٛز پننہِ مذہبی قیادت خٲطرٕ زاننہٕ چھ یوان۔ آغا سید مہدی ین کوٚر جموں و کشمیرس منٛز مقٲمی سِیاسَتھ تہٕ مذہبی معاملن منٛز اہم کردار ادا، خاص طور پٲٹھۍ کٔرٕن شیعہ آبٲدی ہٕنٛدؠن حقوٗقن تہٕ مفاداتن ہنٛز وکالت۔سہ آو جمع دۄہ 3 نومبر 2000 دۄہ دھماکہٕ منٛز ہلاک کرنہٕ۔[1][2][3]

kashmiri: آغا سید مہدی ین کوٚر جموں و کشمیرس منٛز مقٲمی سِیاسَتھ تہٕ مذہبی معاملن منٛز اہم کردار ادا، خاص طور پٲٹھۍ کٔرٕن شیعہ آبٲدی ہٕنٛدؠن حقوٗقن تہٕ مفاداتن ہنٛز وکالت۔سہ آو جمع دۄہ 3 نومبر 2000 دۄہ دھماکہٕ منٛز ہلاک کرنہٕ۔[1][2][3]
parentEnglish: Aga Syed Mehdi (19 February 1959 – 3 November 2000) was a prominent Shia cleric and politician from the Kashmir region. He belonged to the influential Aga family, known for their religious leadership within the Shia Muslim community. Aga Syed Mehdi played an important role in local politics and religious matters in Jammu and Kashmir, particularly advocating for the rights and interests of the Shia population.
parentKashmiri: آغا سید مہدی (19 فروری 1959-3 نومبر 2000) اوس اکھ ممتاز شیعہ عٲلم تہٕ کشمیر علاقک سِیاسَتھ دان۔ سہ اوس بااثر آغا خانٛدانس سۭتۍ تعلق تھاوان، یس شیعہ مسلمان برادری منٛز پننہِ مذہبی قیادت خٲطرٕ زاننہٕ چھ یوان۔ آغا سید مہدی ین کوٚر جموں و کشمیرس منٛز مقٲمی سِیاسَتھ تہٕ مذہبی معاملن منٛز اہم کردار ادا، خاص طور پٲٹھۍ کٔرٕن شیعہ آبٲدی ہٕنٛدؠن حقوٗقن تہٕ مفاداتن ہنٛز وکالت۔سہ آو جمع دۄہ 3 نومبر 2000 دۄہ دھماکہٕ منٛز ہلاک کرنہٕ۔[1][2][3]

english: On 22 June 2025, at least one attacker opened fire and detonated an explosive device inside the Greek Orthodox Mar Elias Church as people were praying in Damascus, Syria, killing at least 25 people and injuring 63 others.
kashmiri: 22 جوٗن 2025 کوٚر کم از کم اکس حملہٕ آورن گولہٕ چلاونہٕ تہٕ کوٚرکھ یونانی آرتھوڈوکس مار ایٚلیاس چرچس اندر دھماکہ خیز آلات دھماکہٕ ییٚلہ لوٗک شام کس دمشق منٛز نؠماز ٲس ادا کران، کم از کم 25 افراد ہلاک تہٕ باقی 63 زخمی۔
parentEnglish: On 22 June 2025, at least one attacker opened fire and detonated an explosive device inside the Greek Orthodox Mar Elias Church as people were praying in Damascus, Syria, killing at least 25 people and injuring 63 others. The Syrian Ministry of Interior said the Islamic State was responsible for the suicide attack, while a group calling itself Saraya Ansar al-Sunnah claimed responsibility for the attack.
parentKashmiri: 22 جوٗن 2025 کوٚر کم از کم اکس حملہٕ آورن گولہٕ چلاونہٕ تہٕ کوٚرکھ یونانی آرتھوڈوکس مار ایٚلیاس چرچس اندر دھماکہ خیز آلات دھماکہٕ ییٚلہ لوٗک شام کس دمشق منٛز نؠماز ٲس ادا کران، کم از کم 25 افراد ہلاک تہٕ باقی 63 زخمی۔ شام چِہ وزارت داخلہ ووٚن ز امہ خۄد کش حملٕچ ذمہٕ دٲری ٲس اِسلامک سٹیٹ، ییٚلہ زن پانس سرایا انصر السُننہ ونان أکس گروپن حملٕچ ذمہ دٲری قبوٗل کٔر۔

english: Masoud Pezeshkian[a] (born 29 September 1954) is an Iranian politician who is the ninth and current president of Iran since 2024.

parentEnglish: Masoud Pezeshkian[a] (born 29 September 1954) is an Iranian politician who is the ninth and current president of Iran since 2024. A member of the reformist faction, he is the oldest person to serve in this position, taking office at the age of 69.

english: Literacy for most Baloch-speakers is not in Balochi, but in Urdu in Pakistan and Persian in Afghanistan and Iran.
kashmiri: زیادٕ تر بلوچ بولن والین ہنٛز خواندگی چِھ نہٕ بلوچی منٛز، بلکہ پاکستانس منٛز اردو تہٕ فارسی افغانستان تہٕ ایرانس منٛز۔
parentEnglish: Literacy for most Baloch-speakers is not in Balochi, but in Urdu in Pakistan and Persian in Afghanistan and Iran. Even now very few Baloch read Balochi, in any of the countries, even though the alphabet in which it is printed is essentially identical to Persian and Urdu.

english: Imperial College London, also known as Imperial, is a public research university in London, England.
kashmiri: اِمپیٖریَل کالیج لندَن، یتھ اِمپیٖریَل تہٕ ونان چھ، چھ لندن، انگلینڈس منٛز اکھ پبلک ریسرچ یونیورسٹی۔
parentEnglish: Imperial College London, also known as Imperial, is a public research university in London, England. Its history began with Prince Albert, husband of Queen Victoria, who envisioned a cultural district in South Kensington that included museums, colleges, and the Royal Albert Hall.[1][2] In 1907, these colleges – the Royal College of Science, the Royal School of Mines, and the City and Guilds of London Institute – merged to form the Imperial College of Science and Technology.[3]
parentKashmiri: اِمپیٖریَل کالیج لندَن، یتھ اِمپیٖریَل تہٕ ونان چھ، چھ لندن، انگلینڈس منٛز اکھ پبلک ریسرچ یونیورسٹی۔ ایمچ تٲریخ چھے ملکہ وکٹوریہ سند خاندار شہزادہ البرٹ سٕتۍ شروع گٲمٕژ، یم جنوبی کینسنگٹن کس اکس ثقافتی ضلعک تصور کوٚر یتھ منز عجائب گھر، کالج تہٕ رائل البرٹ ہال شٲمل چھ۔[1][2]

english: LGBTQ is an initialism for lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, and queer or questioning.
kashmiri: LGBTQ چھ ہم جنس پرست، ہم جنس پرستن، دو جنسی لانٛژھ تہٕ کُیِر یا سوالاتن منٛز گِرِتھ خٲطرٕ اکھ اِبتدا۔
parentEnglish: LGBTQ is an initialism for lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, and queer or questioning. Many variants of the initialism are used, including LGBTQIA, which incorporates intersex and asexual, aromantic, or agender.[1][a] LGBTQ and related initialisms are umbrella terms, originating in the United States, broadly referring to all sexual orientations, romantic orientations, gender identities, and sex characteristics that are not heterosexual, heteroromantic, cisgender, or endosex, respectively.[2][3][4][5]
parentKashmiri: LGBTQ چھ ہم جنس پرست، ہم جنس پرستن، دو جنسی لانٛژھ تہٕ کُیِر یا سوالاتن منٛز گِرِتھ خٲطرٕ اکھ اِبتدا۔ اِبتدٲے ہِنٛد واریاہ قسمہٕ چِھ استعمال گژھان، بشمول LGBTQIA، یتھ منز انٹرسیکس تہٕ غأر جِنسی اَرومینٹِک، یا عمر رسیدٕ چھ شٲمل۔[1]

english: Din Mohammad[a] (1921 – 3 July 2025) was a Pakistani wrestler who became the first Pakistani to win a gold medal at an international competition when he won the flyweight event at the 1954 Asian Games.
kashmiri: دیٖن مُحمد (1921-3 جولائی 2025) اوس اکھ پاکستٲنہ پہلوان یس 1954 کہ ایشیٲیی کھیلن منٛز فلائی ویٹ ایونٹ زیننہٕ وز بین الاقوٲمی مقابلہٕس منٛز سۄنُک میڑل زینن وول گۄڑنیک پاکستٲنؠ بنیوو۔
parentEnglish: Din Mohammad[a] (1921 – 3 July 2025) was a Pakistani wrestler who became the first Pakistani to win a gold medal at an international competition when he won the flyweight event at the 1954 Asian Games. He was also a bronze medalist at the 1954 British Empire and Commonwealth Games.

english: Sayed Haider Raza LH (22 February 1922 – 23 July 2016) was an Indian painter who lived and worked in France for most of his career.[1] Born on 22 February 1922 in Kakkaiya (District Mandla), Central Provinces, British India (present-day Madhya Pradesh), Raza moved to France in 1950, marrying the French artist Janine Mongillat in 1959.

parentEnglish: Sayed Haider Raza LH (22 February 1922 – 23 July 2016) was an Indian painter who lived and worked in France for most of his career.[1] Born on 22 February 1922 in Kakkaiya (District Mandla), Central Provinces, British India (present-day Madhya Pradesh), Raza moved to France in 1950, marrying the French artist Janine Mongillat in 1959. Following her death from cancer in 2002, Raza returned to India in 2010, where he would live until his death on 28 July 2016.[2][3][4]

english: Mullah Hibatullah Akhundzada[b] (born 19 October 1967), also spelled Haibatullah Akhunzada,[c] is an Afghan cleric who is the supreme leader of Afghanistan under the Taliban government.
kashmiri: مُلا ہِبتُ اللہ اَخُند زادہ (پیدٲیش 19 اکتوبر 1967) ، یس ہیبِتُ اللہ اَخُنزادہ تہٕ چِھ لؠکھنہٕ یِوان، چھ اکھ افغان عٲلم یُس طالبانن حکوٗمتس تحت افغانستانک اعلٰی رہنما چِھ۔
parentEnglish: Mullah Hibatullah Akhundzada[b] (born 19 October 1967), also spelled Haibatullah Akhunzada,[c] is an Afghan cleric who is the supreme leader of Afghanistan under the Taliban government. He has led the Taliban since 2016, and came to power with its victory over U.S.-backed forces in the 2001–2021 war. A highly reclusive figure, he has almost no digital footprint except for an unverified photograph and several audio recordings of speeches.
parentKashmiri: مُلا ہِبتُ اللہ اَخُند زادہ (پیدٲیش 19 اکتوبر 1967) ، یس ہیبِتُ اللہ اَخُنزادہ تہٕ چِھ لؠکھنہٕ یِوان، چھ اکھ افغان عٲلم یُس طالبانن حکوٗمتس تحت افغانستانک اعلٰی رہنما چِھ۔ تٔمۍ کٔر 2016 پؠٹھہٕ طالبانٕچ قیادت، تہٕ 2001-2021 جنگ منٛز U.S.-backed فوجس پؠٹھ فتح حٲصل کٔرتھ آو اقتدارس منٛز۔ اکھ انتہٲئی الگ تھلگ شخصیت، أمس چھ نہٕ تقریبا کانٛہہ ڈیجیٹل نقشہٕ سوائے اکہ غٲر مصدقِہ فوٹو تہٕ تقریرو ہنٛدۍ واریاہ آڈیو ریکارڈنٛگ۔

parentEnglish: Few families can still be found in parts of Iraq but most families of Hussaini Brahmins are now settled in Pune,[1] Delhi,[2] Chandigarh, Punjab, Himachal Pradesh and Jammu region in India. english: Sanjay Balraj Dutt (born 29 July 1959)[1] is an Indian actor, playback singer and film producer who works in Hindi cinema in addition to a few Telugu, Kannada, Tamil, Punjabi films.[2][3] He acted in over 160 films.
kashmiri: سنجے بَلراج دَت (پیدٲیش 29 جولائی 1959) چھِ اکھ ہندوستٲنی اداکار، پلے بیک گلوکار تہٕ فلم پروڈیوسر یس کینٛہہ تیلگو کنڑ تامل پنجابی فلمن علاوٕ چھ ہِندی سیٚنماہس منٛز کٲم کران۔[1][2][3] أمہ کٔر 160 کھۄتہٕ زیادٕ فلمن منٛز اداکٲری۔
parentEnglish: Sanjay Balraj Dutt (born 29 July 1959)[1] is an Indian actor, playback singer and film producer who works in Hindi cinema in addition to a few Telugu, Kannada, Tamil, Punjabi films.[2][3] He acted in over 160 films. Known for his versatile screen presence and portrayal of both heroic and anti-heroic characters, Dutt won several accolades including two Filmfare Awards, three Screen Awards and a Global Indian Film Award.[4] Over the four decades, he established himself as one of the successful actors in Indian cinema.[5]
parentKashmiri: سنجے بَلراج دَت (پیدٲیش 29 جولائی 1959) چھِ اکھ ہندوستٲنی اداکار، پلے بیک گلوکار تہٕ فلم پروڈیوسر یس کینٛہہ تیلگو کنڑ تامل پنجابی فلمن علاوٕ چھ ہِندی سیٚنماہس منٛز کٲم کران۔[1][2][3] أمہ کٔر 160 کھۄتہٕ زیادٕ فلمن منٛز اداکٲری۔ پننہ ورسٹائل سکرین موجودگی تہٕ دوشونی بہادر تہٕ مخالف ہیرو کردارٕ ہٕنٛدیٚن کردارن ہٕنٛز تصویر کشی خٲطرٕ مشہوٗر، دتن زیٖنۍ واریاہ تعٲریٖف یمن منٛز زٕ فلم فیئر ایوارڈز ترٛےٚ سکرین ایوارڈز تہٕ اکھ گلوبل انڈین فلم ایوارڈ شٲمل چِھ۔[1] ژورو دہلو دوران کوٚر تٔمۍ پنن پان ہندوستٲنؠ سنیما کیٚن کامیاب اداکارو منٛزٕ اکھ قٲیم۔[1]

english: Besant also became involved in politics in India, joining the Indian National Congress.[1] When World War I broke out in 1914, she helped launch the Home Rule League to campaign for democracy in India, and dominion status within the British Empire.
kashmiri: 1920 کس ٲخرس منٛز کوٚر بیسنٹن پننس سرپرست تہٕ گود نن وٲلس نیچو جڈڈو کرشنامورتی سۭتۍ امریکہک سفر، یُس زن تم بُدھ سنٛد نوٚو مسیحا تہٕ اَوتار آسنُک دعوٕ کران ٲس۔
parentEnglish: Besant also became involved in politics in India, joining the Indian National Congress.[1] When World War I broke out in 1914, she helped launch the Home Rule League to campaign for democracy in India, and dominion status within the British Empire. This led to her election as president of the Indian National Congress, in late 1917. In the late 1920s, Besant travelled to the United States with her protégé and adopted son Jiddu Krishnamurti, who she claimed was the new Messiah and incarnation of Buddha.

english: In the late 1920s, Besant travelled to the United States with her protégé and adopted son Jiddu Krishnamurti, who she claimed was the new Messiah and incarnation of Buddha.
kashmiri: جنگہٕ پتہٕ، تھٲو یہ ہندوستان چہ آزٲدی خٲطرٕ تہٕ تھیوسوفی ہٕنٛدیٚن وجوہاتن خٲطرٕ 1933 ہس منٛز پننس مرنس تام مہم جٲری۔
parentEnglish: Besant also became involved in politics in India, joining the Indian National Congress.[1] When World War I broke out in 1914, she helped launch the Home Rule League to campaign for democracy in India, and dominion status within the British Empire. This led to her election as president of the Indian National Congress, in late 1917. In the late 1920s, Besant travelled to the United States with her protégé and adopted son Jiddu Krishnamurti, who she claimed was the new Messiah and incarnation of Buddha.

english: The temple is listed among List of Monuments of National Importance in Jammu and Kashmir.
kashmiri: یہِ مندر چھِ جموں و کشمیرس منٛز قومی اہمیتٕکین یادگارن ہندس فہرستس منٛز شٲمل۔
parentEnglish: The temple is listed among List of Monuments of National Importance in Jammu and Kashmir. It has also been attributed by other including, Sun Temple or Jeevanath Temple or Shiv temple, but these names found no historical proof. Thus, the monument remained entitled as 'The Ancient Temple, Ladhoo[1]' in the documents of Archaeological Survey of India.
parentKashmiri: یہِ مندر چھِ جموں و کشمیرس منٛز قومی اہمیتٕکین یادگارن ہندس فہرستس منٛز شٲمل۔ یہ چھ باقیو سۭتۍ تہٕ منسوٗب کرنہٕ آمت، بشمول آفتاب مندر یا جیوناتھ مندر یا شِو مندر، مگر یمن ناون چھنہٕ کانٛہہ تٲریٖخی ثبوٗت ملیوٚومُت۔ یتھ پٲٹھۍ روٗد آثار قدیمہ سروے آف انڈیا کہ دستاویزن منٛز یادگار 'قدیٖم مَندَر، لدھوٗ' کہ ناوٕ سۭتۍ حقدار۔[1]

english: This temple is externally square and internally circular in shape.
kashmiri: یہ مندر چھ نیبرم طرفہٕ چکور تہٕ اندٕ اندٕ أندٕرؠ پٲٹھۍ گول شکلِہ منٛز۔
parentEnglish: This temple is externally square and internally circular in shape. The entrance which faces the southwest has an arch surmounted pediment. This archaeological monument is datable to circa 8th century A.D.[1] The monument and the pond including a small park is fenced and maintained by Archaeological Survey of India, circle srinagar, Jammu.[2]
parentKashmiri: یہ مندر چھ نیبرم طرفہٕ چکور تہٕ اندٕ اندٕ أندٕرؠ پٲٹھۍ گول شکلِہ منٛز۔ اژوُن طرفہٕ یس جنوب مغرب کُن چھِ اتھ پیٹھ چھِ اکھ محراب دار پیڈمنٛٹ۔ یہٕ آثار قدیمہک یادگار چھ تقریٖبن 8 مہٕ صدی عیسوی ہِنٛد۔[1] یادگار تہٕ تالاب یتھ منٛز اکھ لۄکٹ باغ جنٛگلہٕ دِتھ تہٕ شٲمل چُھ، چھِ آرکیالوجیکل سروے آف اِنڈیا، سرکل سری نگر، جموں کہ طرفہٕ دیکھ بھال کران۔[2]

english: Fauja Singh (died 14 July 2025) was a British Indian marathon runner.
kashmiri: فوجا سِنٛگھ (موٗد 14 جولائی 2025) اوس اکھ برطأنوی ہندوستٲنؠ میراتھن رنر۔
parentEnglish: Fauja Singh (died 14 July 2025) was a British Indian marathon runner. At the time of his birth in Punjab province in British India, birth certificates were not typically issued, so his age could not be verified by third parties. Later in life, he became a marathon runner, participating in marathons all over the world.
parentKashmiri: فوجا سِنٛگھ (موٗد 14 جولائی 2025) اوس اکھ برطأنوی ہندوستٲنؠ میراتھن رنر۔ برطانوی ہند کس صوبہ پنجاب منٛز تمہ سند زایہٕ وز اوس نہٕ عام طور برتھ سرٹفکیٹ جٲری یوان کرنہٕ، لہذا تمہ سٕنز وٲنٛسہ ہنز تصدیق ہیکہ نہٕ ترٛیٚیم فریقن کٔرتھ۔ پتہٕ زندگی منٛز، بنیو سہ اکھ میراتھن رنر، پورٕ دنیاہس منٛز میراتھنن منٛز کوٚرن حصہٕ۔
usageCondition: Preserve original license, attribution and applicable share-alike obligations.

english: He beat a number of world records in multiple age brackets, but none of his times were ratified as records.
kashmiri: تٔمۍ کٔر واریہن ؤرین ہٕنٛدس بریکٹن منٛز واریاہ عالمی ریکارڈ شکست، مگر أمۍ سٕنٛدۍ کانٛہہ تہٕ وقت آو نہٕ ریکارڈ پٲٹھۍ تصدیٖق کرنہٕ۔
parentEnglish: He beat a number of world records in multiple age brackets, but none of his times were ratified as records. His personal best time for the London Marathon (2003) was 6:02,[1] and his marathon best, claimed for the 90-plus age bracket, was 5:40 at the claimed age of 92, at the 2003 Toronto Waterfront Marathon.[2][3] He died in Punjab in 2025, in a hit and run incident.
parentKashmiri: تٔمۍ کٔر واریہن ؤرین ہٕنٛدس بریکٹن منٛز واریاہ عالمی ریکارڈ شکست، مگر أمۍ سٕنٛدۍ کانٛہہ تہٕ وقت آو نہٕ ریکارڈ پٲٹھۍ تصدیٖق کرنہٕ۔ لندن میراتھن خٲطرٕ اوس تہند ذٲتی بہترین وقت (2003) 6:02، تہٕ تہنٛز میراتھن بہترین، ییٚمیک دعوی 90 کھوتہٕ زیادٕ وٲنٛسہ خٲطرٕ اوس آمت کرنہٕ، اوس 2003 ٹورنٹو واٹر فرنٹ میراتھن منٛز 92 وہر وٲنٛسہ منٛز 5:40۔[1][2][3] سہ گُزریو 2025 ہس منٛز پنجابس منٛز أکس گاڈِ دٔسؠ ٹاس ینہٕ کِس واقعس منٛز۔

kashmiri: لندن میراتھن خٲطرٕ اوس تہند ذٲتی بہترین وقت (2003) 6:02، تہٕ تہنٛز میراتھن بہترین، ییٚمیک دعوی 90 کھوتہٕ زیادٕ وٲنٛسہ خٲطرٕ اوس آمت کرنہٕ، اوس 2003 ٹورنٹو واٹر فرنٹ میراتھن منٛز 92 وہر وٲنٛسہ منٛز 5:40۔[1][2][3] سہ گُزریو 2025 ہس منٛز پنجابس منٛز أکس گاڈِ دٔسؠ ٹاس ینہٕ کِس واقعس منٛز۔
parentEnglish: He beat a number of world records in multiple age brackets, but none of his times were ratified as records. His personal best time for the London Marathon (2003) was 6:02,[1] and his marathon best, claimed for the 90-plus age bracket, was 5:40 at the claimed age of 92, at the 2003 Toronto Waterfront Marathon.[2][3] He died in Punjab in 2025, in a hit and run incident.
parentKashmiri: تٔمۍ کٔر واریہن ؤرین ہٕنٛدس بریکٹن منٛز واریاہ عالمی ریکارڈ شکست، مگر أمۍ سٕنٛدۍ کانٛہہ تہٕ وقت آو نہٕ ریکارڈ پٲٹھۍ تصدیٖق کرنہٕ۔ لندن میراتھن خٲطرٕ اوس تہند ذٲتی بہترین وقت (2003) 6:02، تہٕ تہنٛز میراتھن بہترین، ییٚمیک دعوی 90 کھوتہٕ زیادٕ وٲنٛسہ خٲطرٕ اوس آمت کرنہٕ، اوس 2003 ٹورنٹو واٹر فرنٹ میراتھن منٛز 92 وہر وٲنٛسہ منٛز 5:40۔[1][2][3] سہ گُزریو 2025 ہس منٛز پنجابس منٛز أکس گاڈِ دٔسؠ ٹاس ینہٕ کِس واقعس منٛز۔

parentEnglish: Ladhoo[1] or Ladhu is a village in the Pulwama district of Jammu and Kashmir, India. It is situated on the Jhelum River and is one of the largest villages in the Pampore Constituency. It is 18 km (11 mi) from Srinagar and 4 km (2.5 mi) from NH44 via Lethpora.

english: A time zone is an area which observes a uniform standard time for legal, commercial and social purposes.
kashmiri: کال مَنڈَل،وقٕت مَنڈَل ،وقٕت زون یا ٹایم زون چھ اکھ یتھ علاقہٕ یس قونوٗنی تجٲرتی تہٕ سمٲجی مقصدن خأطرٕ یکساں معیاری وقت مشاہدٕ چُھ کران۔
parentEnglish: A time zone is an area which observes a uniform standard time for legal, commercial and social purposes. Time zones tend to follow the boundaries between countries and their subdivisions instead of strictly following longitude, because it is convenient for areas in frequent communication to keep the same time.
parentKashmiri: کال مَنڈَل،وقٕت مَنڈَل ،وقٕت زون یا ٹایم زون چھ اکھ یتھ علاقہٕ یس قونوٗنی تجٲرتی تہٕ سمٲجی مقصدن خأطرٕ یکساں معیاری وقت مشاہدٕ چُھ کران۔ کال مَنڈَل چِھ لانگچوڈ کہ سختی سٕتۍ پیروی کرنہٕ بجائے مٔلکن تہٕ تہند ذیلی تقسیم کہ درمیان حدوٗدن ہنٛز پیروی کران، کیازٕکہ اکثر مواصلاتس منٛز روزن وٲلؠ علاقن خٲطرٕہ چھ یہٕ آسان ز سٲی وقت ہِوی روٗزتھ۔

english: Al-Waleed bin Khalid bin Talal bin Abdulaziz Al Saud (Arabic: الوليد بن خالد بن طلال بن عبد العزيز آل سعود; April 1990 – 19 July 2025) was a member of the Saudi royal family and the son of Prince Khalid bin Talal Al Saud.
kashmiri: الوَلیٖد بِن خالِد بِن تالال بن عبد العزیز آل سعود (عربی: الولید بین خلد بن تلال بن عبد ال عزیز آل سعودی اپریل 1990-19 جولائی 2025) اوس سعودی شاہی خاندان رکن تہٕ شہزاد خالِد بِن تلال آل سعود سُنٛد نیچوٗ۔
parentEnglish: Al-Waleed bin Khalid bin Talal bin Abdulaziz Al Saud (Arabic: الوليد بن خالد بن طلال بن عبد العزيز آل سعود; April 1990 – 19 July 2025) was a member of the Saudi royal family and the son of Prince Khalid bin Talal Al Saud. He was known in the media as the "Sleeping Prince" because he had been in a coma since 2005 following a car accident while studying at the military academy, which caused a brain injury.[1][2]
parentKashmiri: الوَلیٖد بِن خالِد بِن تالال بن عبد العزیز آل سعود (عربی: الولید بین خلد بن تلال بن عبد ال عزیز آل سعودی اپریل 1990-19 جولائی 2025) اوس سعودی شاہی خاندان رکن تہٕ شہزاد خالِد بِن تلال آل سعود سُنٛد نیچوٗ۔ سُہ اوس میڈیاہس منٛز "sleeping Prince شَنٛگِتھ شہزاد" ناوٕ سٕتۍ زاننہٕ یوان تکیازِ سہ اوس 2005 پیٹھہٕ فوجی اکیڈمی منٛز زیر تعلیم کار ایکسیڈنٹ پتہٕ کوما منٛز، یمہٕ سۭتۍ کٲڈِس زخم اوس آمُت۔[1][2] سہُ گُزریو 19 جُلے 2025 ہس منٛز 35 وِہِرۍ وأنٛسہِ منٛز ۔
usageCondition: Preserve original license, attribution and applicable share-alike obligations.

english: Pishachas (Sanskrit: पिशाच, piśāca) are flesh-eating demons in Indian religions, appearing in Hindu and Buddhist mythologies.
kashmiri: پِشاچ (سنسکرت:पिशाच, piśāca ) چھُ ہندو مذہب منٛز ماز کھؠنہٕ وٲلؠ راکشس، یم ہؠنٛدؠ تہٕ بُدھ مَت افسانس منٛز چِھ لبنہٕ یوان۔
parentEnglish: Pishachas (Sanskrit: पिशाच, piśāca) are flesh-eating demons in Indian religions, appearing in Hindu and Buddhist mythologies. A pishacha is a malevolent being that has often been referred to as the very manifestation of evil.[1]

english: Tsinghua University's campus is in northwest Beijing, on the site of the former imperial gardens of the Qing dynasty.
kashmiri: چینٛگھوا یونیورسٹی ہنٛد کیمپس چھ شمال مغربی بیجنگ منٛز، چِنٛگ خاندان سابقہ شاہی باغاتن ہنٛدس جایٔہٕ پیٹھ۔
parentEnglish: Tsinghua University's campus is in northwest Beijing, on the site of the former imperial gardens of the Qing dynasty. The university has 21 schools and 59 departments, with faculties in science, engineering, humanities, law, medicine, history, philosophy, economics, management, education, and art.[1]

english: cristata (formerly Celosia cristata), known as cockscomb, is the cristate or crested variety of the species Celosia argentea.
kashmiri: ہندوستٲنی، برمی تہٕ چینی باغوانو چِھ روایتی طور یہ مندرن نزدیٖک لگٲمتؠ۔
parentEnglish: Celosia argentea var. cristata (formerly Celosia cristata), known as cockscomb, is the cristate or crested variety of the species Celosia argentea. parentEnglish: Jodha Akbar was an Indian historical drama television series that aired from June 18, 2013 to August 7, 2015 on Zee TV. english: On 19 July 2025, the tourist boat Wonder Sea capsized due to high winds during an abrupt thunderstorm in Hạ Long Bay, Vietnam, killing at least 37 people.
kashmiri: 19 جولائی 2025 ہس منٛز، ویتنام کس ہا لانگ بے منٛز اچانک طوفانس دوران تیز ہوہس کنہ سیاحتی ناو ونڈر سی الٹہٕ، یتھ منٛز کم از کم 37 افراد ہلاک گیۍ۔
parentEnglish: On 19 July 2025, the tourist boat Wonder Sea capsized due to high winds during an abrupt thunderstorm in Hạ Long Bay, Vietnam, killing at least 37 people. Ten people were rescued with non-fatal injuries, and two are still missing. The incident took place during a tour, and a rescue operation began after contact with the ship was lost.

english: The Eshima Ohashi Bridge (Japanese: 江島大橋, Hepburn: Eshima Ōhashi) is a rigid-frame bridge in Japan that connects Matsue, Shimane Prefecture, and Sakaiminato, Tottori Prefecture, over Nakaumi lake.
kashmiri: اِشیما اوہاشی کٔدٕل (جاپانی:江島大橋 , Hepburn: Eshima Óhashi′) چھِ جاپانُک اکھ سخت فریم کٔدٕل یس ماتسوا شیمانے پریفیکچر، تہٕ سکامیناٹو ٹوٹوری پریفیکچرس چِھ نکومی جھیلس پؠٹھ جوڑان۔
parentEnglish: The Eshima Ohashi Bridge (Japanese: 江島大橋, Hepburn: Eshima Ōhashi) is a rigid-frame bridge in Japan that connects Matsue, Shimane Prefecture, and Sakaiminato, Tottori Prefecture, over Nakaumi lake. It was built from 1997 to 2004, and it is the largest rigid-frame bridge in Japan and the third largest in the world.[1] Images of the bridge have been widely circulated on the internet, owing to its seemingly steep nature when photographed from a distance with a telephoto lens, but in actuality, it has a less pronounced, 6.1% gradient in the side of Shimane and a 5.1% gradient in the side of Tottori.[2]
parentKashmiri: اِشیما اوہاشی کٔدٕل (جاپانی:江島大橋 , Hepburn: Eshima Óhashi′) چھِ جاپانُک اکھ سخت فریم کٔدٕل یس ماتسوا شیمانے پریفیکچر، تہٕ سکامیناٹو ٹوٹوری پریفیکچرس چِھ نکومی جھیلس پؠٹھ جوڑان۔ یہٕ اوس 1997 پؠٹھ 2004 تام بناونہٕ آمُت، تہٕ یہٕ چھ جاپانُک ساروی کھۄتہٕ بۆڑ سخت فریم کٔدٕل تہٕ دُنیاہس منٛز تریم ساروی کھۄتہٕ بوڑ کٔدٕل۔[1]

parentEnglish: It is bordered to the east by Kenya, to the north by South Sudan, to the west by the Democratic Republic of the Congo, to the south-west by Rwanda, and to the south by Tanzania. Uganda is in the African Great Lakes region, lies within the Nile basin, and has a varied equatorial climate.

parentEnglish: Home to some of the most revered Hindu shrines, such as Vaishno Devi, Jammu is a major pilgrimage centre for Hindus. A majority of Jammu's population practices Hinduism,[1] while Islam and Sikhism enjoy a strong cultural heritage in the region.

english: Bucheon (Korean: 부천; Korean pronunciation: [pu.tɕʰʌn]) is a city in Gyeonggi Province, South Korea.

parentEnglish: Bucheon (Korean: 부천; Korean pronunciation: [pu.tɕʰʌn]) is a city in Gyeonggi Province, South Korea. Bucheon is located 25 kilometers (16 mi) away from Seoul, of which it is a satellite city.[1] It is located between Incheon and Seoul.

english: Commissioned in 1943,[1][2] the bridge was originally named the New Howrah Bridge, because it replaced a pontoon bridge at the same location linking the both sides of cities of Kolkata (Calcutta).
kashmiri: ہاوڑہ کٔدٕل چُھ مَغرَبی بَنٛگال ہندوستانس منٛز دریائے ہگلی پؠٹھ اکھ متوازن سٹیل کٔدٕل۔
parentEnglish: Commissioned in 1943,[1][2] the bridge was originally named the New Howrah Bridge, because it replaced a pontoon bridge at the same location linking the both sides of cities of Kolkata (Calcutta). Burrabazar is connected with Howrah rail terminal because of this bridge. On 14 June 1965, it was renamed Rabindra Setu after the Bengali poet Rabindranath Tagore, who was the first Indian and Asian Nobel laureate.[2] It is still popularly known as the Howrah Bridge.
parentKashmiri: ہاوڑہ کٔدٕل چُھ مَغرَبی بَنٛگال ہندوستانس منٛز دریائے ہگلی پؠٹھ اکھ متوازن سٹیل کٔدٕل۔ 1943 ہس منٛز شروع کرنہٕ آمت، اتھ کٔدلس اوس اصلی نیو ہاوڑا برج ناو دینہٕ آمت، کیازٕکہ ام کوٚر کولکتہ (کلکتہ) کؠن شہرن دۄشوٕنی طرفو جوڑن والؠن اکی جایہ پونٹوٗن کٔدلٕچ جاے۔[1][2] امہ برجہ کنہ چھ برابازار ہاوڑہ ریل ٹرمینلس سٕتہِ جُڑتھ۔ 14 جوٗن 1965 ٹھس منٛز آو اتھ بنٛگٲلہ شاٲر رَبِنٛدَر ناتھ ٹیگور سٕنٛد ناوس پیٚٹھ رَبنٛدِر سیتو ناو دنہٕ، یس گۄڈنیوک ہِندوستٲنؠ تہٕ ایشیٲیی نوبل انعام زینن وول اوس۔[1] یہ چھ وٕنہ تہ ہاوڑا بر٘ج ناوٕ سٕتی مشہوٗر۔
usageCondition: Preserve original license, attribution and applicable share-alike obligations.

english: Al-Bukhari organized the book mostly in the Hijaz at the Sacred Mosque of Mecca and the Prophet's Mosque of Medina and completed the work in Bukhara around 846 (232 AH).
kashmiri: البخاری ین کٕر یہ کتاب زیادٕ تر مکہ چہ مقدس مسجد تہٕ مسجد مکہ کس حجس منز ترتیب تہٕ کٕرٕن 846 (232 ھ) کہ آس پاس بخارس منز کٲم مکمل۔
parentEnglish: Al-Bukhari organized the book mostly in the Hijaz at the Sacred Mosque of Mecca and the Prophet's Mosque of Medina and completed the work in Bukhara around 846 (232 AH). The work was examined by his teachers Ahmad ibn Hanbal, Ali ibn al-Madini, Yahya ibn Ma'in and others.

english: Coronavirus diseases are caused by viruses in the coronavirus subfamily, a group of related RNA viruses that cause diseases in mammals and birds.
kashmiri: کورونا وائرس بؠمارِ چھےٚ کورونا وائرس ذیلی خاندانس منٛز وایرس کہ وجہ سٕتۍ گژھان، یُس مُتعلقہ آر این اے وائرس اکھ جماعت چھےٚ یس ز میملز تہٕ جاناوارن منٛز بؠمارؠن ہُنٛد سبب چھِ بنان۔
parentEnglish: Coronavirus diseases are caused by viruses in the coronavirus subfamily, a group of related RNA viruses that cause diseases in mammals and birds. In humans and birds, the group of viruses cause respiratory tract infections that can range from mild to lethal. Mild illnesses in humans include some cases of the common cold (which is also caused by other viruses, predominantly rhinoviruses),[1][2] while more lethal varieties can cause SARS, MERS and COVID-19.[3][4] As of 2021, 45 species are registered as coronaviruses,[5] whilst 11 diseases have been identified, as listed below.
parentKashmiri: کورونا وائرس بؠمارِ چھےٚ کورونا وائرس ذیلی خاندانس منٛز وایرس کہ وجہ سٕتۍ گژھان، یُس مُتعلقہ آر این اے وائرس اکھ جماعت چھےٚ یس ز میملز تہٕ جاناوارن منٛز بؠمارؠن ہُنٛد سبب چھِ بنان۔ انسانن تہٕ پرندن منٛز چھ وایرسن ہنٛد گروپ شاہ نالہِ منٛز انفیکشنُک سبب بنان یس ہلکہٕ پیٚٹھٕ مہلک ٲستھ۔ انسانن منٛز چھ ہلکہٕ بیمارن منٛز نزٕل ہنٛد کینٛہہ معاملہٕ شٲمل (یُس زن باقی وایرس سۭتۍ تہٕ چھ گژھان، زیادٕ تر رائنو وائرسٕس ییلہٕ زن زیادٕ مہلک قسمہٕ سارس مرز تہٕ کووِڈ-19 ہنٛد سبب چُھ بنتھ۔[1][2][3][4] 2021 ہس تام چھ 45 زٲژ کورونا وائرس کہ طورس پیٹھ رجسٹرڈ، ییلہ زن کہ 11 بیمارن ہِنٛز پہچان آی کرنہٕ، یتھ کٕن زن ذیلس منٛز چھ درٕج۔[1]

english: Trehgam hamlet shares a common yard with a Hindu temple and nearby there is a shrine of a great Sufi saint Syed Ibrahim Bukhari (RA).
kashmiri: تریگھم بستی چھ أکس ہیند مندرس سۭتۍ اکھ مشترکہٕ صحنک اشتراک کران تہٕ اتھ نزدیٖک چھ أکس عظیم صوفی سنت سید ابراہیم بخاری سنٛد مزار (را) ۔
parentEnglish: Trehgam hamlet shares a common yard with a Hindu temple and nearby there is a shrine of a great Sufi saint Syed Ibrahim Bukhari (RA). Symbolizing communal harmony and peaceful coexistence, the three religious entities—Shiv temple, Grand Mosque and the Shrine—are in a row and in front of them there's a famous pond which is the main source of water for almost half a dozen nearby villages.

english: Amar Akbar Anthony is a 1977 Indian Hindi-language masala film directed and produced by Manmohan Desai and written by Kader Khan.
kashmiri: اَمَر اَکبر ایٚنتھونی چھےٚ 1977 ہٕچ ہندی ہندی زبٲنہِ ہنٛز مسالہ فلم یتھ منموہن دیسائی ہدایت کٲری تہٕ پروڈیوس کٔر تہٕ قأدِر خان چِھ لیکھمٕژ۔
parentEnglish: Amar Akbar Anthony is a 1977 Indian Hindi-language masala film directed and produced by Manmohan Desai and written by Kader Khan. Released in India on 27 May 1977, the film stars an ensemble cast of Vinod Khanna, Rishi Kapoor, Amitabh Bachchan, Neetu Singh, Parveen Babi, Shabana Azmi, Nirupa Roy and Pran. The plot focuses on three brothers separated in childhood who are adopted by families of different faiths; Hinduism, Islam and Christianity.
parentKashmiri: اَمَر اَکبر ایٚنتھونی چھےٚ 1977 ہٕچ ہندی ہندی زبٲنہِ ہنٛز مسالہ فلم یتھ منموہن دیسائی ہدایت کٲری تہٕ پروڈیوس کٔر تہٕ قأدِر خان چِھ لیکھمٕژ۔ 27 مئی 1977 تھس منٛز ہِندوستان منٛز ریلیز گژھن واجیٚنہ فلمہِ منٛز چِھ وِنود کھنہ، رِشی کپوٗر، اَمِتابھ بَچَن، نیتو سنگھ، پروہٖن بابی، شابَنا آزمی، نِروپا رائے تہٕ پرٛان شٲمل۔پلاٹس منز چھ بچپنس منز الگ گژھن والین ترٛؠن باین پیٹھ توجہ مرکوز کرنہٕ آمٕژ یمن ہؠنٛدؠ دَرٕم، اِسلام تہٕ عیٖسٲیِیَتھ کین مختلف عقیدٕ کین خاندانن ہُنٛد ذٔریعہ اپناونہٕ آو۔ فلمہ کٔر ہندوستٲنی باکس آفس پؠٹھ ₹155 ملین (USD $دھرم ویر تہٕ ہم کسے کم نہیں سۭتۍ امہ ؤریچ ساروٕے کھۄتہٕ زیادٕ کمٲئی کرن واجیٚنۍ ہندوستٲنہ فلم بنییہ۔[1]
usageCondition: Preserve original license, attribution and applicable share-alike obligations.

english: Jabalpur holds the distinction of being the first dinosaur fossil discovery site in Asia in 1828 near Bara Simla Hill by British officer William Henry Sleeman, with later finds in the region including dinosaur eggshells and fossils from species like Titanosaurus and Rajasaurus.
kashmiri: جَبَل پوٗرس چھ برطانوی افسر وِلیَم ہیٚنری سلیمین 1828 ہس منٛز بارا شملہ پہاڑس نزدیٖک ایشیاء ہُک گۄڑنُیک ڈایناسور فوسل دٔریافت کرن وول مُقام آسنُک اعزاز حٲصل کوٚرمُت، یتھ منٛز پتہٕ اتھ علاقس منٛز ڈایناسورِک ٹھوٗلِک کنجہِ (eggshells) تہٕ ٹائٹینوسورس تہٕ راجاسورس ہویٚن زٲژُک فوسل شٲمل چُھ۔
parentEnglish: Jabalpur holds the distinction of being the first dinosaur fossil discovery site in Asia in 1828 near Bara Simla Hill by British officer William Henry Sleeman, with later finds in the region including dinosaur eggshells and fossils from species like Titanosaurus and Rajasaurus. It is also known as 'Sanskardhani' meaning 'The Cultural Capital' highlighting the city's rich cultural and historical heritage.

parentEnglish: The Valley of Kashmir (1895) is a book on Kashmir by the English writer Sir Walter Roper Lawrence. The author served in the Indian Civil Service[1] in British India during which he was appointed as a Settlement Commissioner of Kashmir.[2][3]

parentEnglish: Julia Garner (born February 1, 1994) is an American actress. english: The Line of Control (LoC) is a military control line between the Indian- and Pakistani-controlled parts of the former princely state of Jammu and Kashmir—a line which does not constitute a legally recognized international boundary, but serves as the de facto border.
kashmiri: اِختیارٕچ رِکھ یا لائن آف کنٹرول ( LOC) گۄڈٕ ریاست جموں و کشمیر کس ہِندوستان تہٕ پٲکِستان زیر انتظام حِصن درمیان اکھ فوجی کنٹرول لائن-اکھ لائن یُس نہٕ قانونی طورس پیٹھ تسلیٖم شدٕ بین الاقوامی سرحد بناوان چھ، بلکہ چھ در اصلیت سرحدٕک پٲٹھۍ کٲم کران۔
parentEnglish: The Line of Control (LoC) is a military control line between the Indian- and Pakistani-controlled parts of the former princely state of Jammu and Kashmir—a line which does not constitute a legally recognized international boundary, but serves as the de facto border. It was established as part of the Simla Agreement at the end of the Indo-Pakistani War of 1971. Both nations agreed to rename the ceasefire line as the "Line of Control" and pledged to respect it without prejudice to their respective positions.[1] Apart from minor details, the line is roughly the same as the original 1949 cease-fire line.
parentKashmiri: اِختیارٕچ رِکھ یا لائن آف کنٹرول ( LOC) گۄڈٕ ریاست جموں و کشمیر کس ہِندوستان تہٕ پٲکِستان زیر انتظام حِصن درمیان اکھ فوجی کنٹرول لائن-اکھ لائن یُس نہٕ قانونی طورس پیٹھ تسلیٖم شدٕ بین الاقوامی سرحد بناوان چھ، بلکہ چھ در اصلیت سرحدٕک پٲٹھۍ کٲم کران۔ یہ آو 1971 کس ہند-پاک جنٛگ کس ٲخرس پیٹھ شِملہ معاہدٕ کس حصہٕ کس طورس پیٚٹھ قٲیم کرنہٕ۔ دۄشوٕے ملکن کوٚر جنگ بندی لٲنہ "لائن آف کنٹرول" ناو دینس پؠٹھ اِتفاق تہٕ پننؠن پوزیشنن پؠٹھ تعصب کرنہٕ بغٲر کوٚرُکھ امیک احترام کرنُک وعدٕ۔[1]

english: Sita is the consort of Rama, the avatar of god Vishnu, and is regarded as an avatar of goddess Lakshmi.[1] She is the chief goddess of the Ramanandi Sampradaya and is the goddess of beauty and devotion.
kashmiri: (سنسکرت: سیتا : Sītāh) یتھ سِیا، جانکی تہٕ میتھلی تہٕ ونان چِھ، ہیٚنٛدۍ دیوی تہٕ ہیٚنٛدۍ رزمیہ راماین ہٕنٛز زنانہٕ مرکزی کردار۔
parentEnglish: Sita (Sanskrit: सीता; IAST: Sītā), also known as Siya, Jānaki and Maithili, is a Hindu goddess and the female protagonist of the Hindu epic Ramayana. Sita is the consort of Rama, the avatar of god Vishnu, and is regarded as an avatar of goddess Lakshmi.[1] She is the chief goddess of the Ramanandi Sampradaya and is the goddess of beauty and devotion. Sita's birthday is celebrated every year on the occasion of Sita Navami.[2]
parentKashmiri: سیہ۔ (سنسکرت: سیتا : Sītāh) یتھ سِیا، جانکی تہٕ میتھلی تہٕ ونان چِھ، ہیٚنٛدۍ دیوی تہٕ ہیٚنٛدۍ رزمیہ راماین ہٕنٛز زنانہٕ مرکزی کردار۔ سیتا چھ رام سٕنٛز خانٛداریٚنؠ، بھگوان وؠشنوٗ سنٛد اوتار تہٕ چھ دیوی لَکشمی ہنٛد اَوتار ماننہٕ یوان۔[1]

english: Krishna (/ˈkrɪʃnə/;[1] Sanskrit: कृष्ण, IAST: Kṛṣṇa Sanskrit: [ˈkr̩ʂɳɐ] ⓘ) is a major deity in Hinduism.
kashmiri: کِرٛشنا یا کِرٛشن (/ˈkrɪʃnə/ سنسکرت: कृष्ण :Kṛṣṇa) [1] سنسکرت: [ˈkr̩ʂɳɐ] چھ ہؠنٛدؠ دَرٕم اکھ اہم دیوتا۔
parentEnglish: Krishna (/ˈkrɪʃnə/;[1] Sanskrit: कृष्ण, IAST: Kṛṣṇa Sanskrit: [ˈkr̩ʂɳɐ] ⓘ) is a major deity in Hinduism. He is worshipped as the eighth avatar of Vishnu and also as the Supreme God in his own right.[2] He is the god of protection, compassion, tenderness, and love;[3][1] and is widely revered among Hindu divinities.[4] Krishna's birthday is celebrated every year by Hindus on Krishna Janmashtami according to the lunisolar Hindu calendar, which falls in late August or early September of the Gregorian calendar.[5][6][7]
parentKashmiri: کِرٛشنا یا کِرٛشن (/ˈkrɪʃnə/ سنسکرت: कृष्ण :Kṛṣṇa) [1] سنسکرت: [ˈkr̩ʂɳɐ] چھ ہؠنٛدؠ دَرٕم اکھ اہم دیوتا۔ أمس چھ وؠشنوٗ سنٛد ٲٹھم اوتار تہٕ پنٛنِس پانس منٛز اعلٰی دیوتا سٕنٛد پٲٹھۍ تہٕ پوٗزا یوان کرنہٕ۔[1] سہ چھ حفاظت، ہمدردی، نرمی تہٕ محبتک دیوتا تہٕ ہیند دیوتاہن منٛز چھ بھڑس پیمانس پیٹھ احترام یوان کرنہٕ۔[3][1][4] کِرٛشنا سنٛد زایہٕ دوہ چھ پریتھ وأری ہندوو ہنٛد طرفہٕ کرشنا جنم اشٹمی یس چاند شمسی ہندو کیلنڈر مطٲبق مناونہٕ یوان، یس گریگورین کیلنڈر کس اگست کس ٲخرس یا ستمبر کس شروعاتس منٛز چھ یوان۔[1][2][3]

english: The Khaju Bridge (Persian: پل خواجو, Pol-e Xāju) is one of the historical bridges on the Zayanderud, the largest river of the Iranian Plateau, in Isfahan, Iran.
kashmiri: خاجو کٔدٕل (فارسی: پل خواجو) چھ ایران کس اِصفَہان منٛز ایٖرٲنی وُڈٕر ساروی کھوتہٕ بھڑ دٔرؠ یاو، زایندروٗد پیٹھ تَوٲریٖخی کٔدلو منٛز اکھ۔
parentEnglish: The Khaju Bridge (Persian: پل خواجو, Pol-e Xāju) is one of the historical bridges on the Zayanderud, the largest river of the Iranian Plateau, in Isfahan, Iran. Serving as both a bridge and a weir, it links the Khaju quarter on the north bank with the Zoroastrian quarter across the Zayanderud. It is located at the end of Kamal Ismail Street in Isfahan.[1]
parentKashmiri: خاجو کٔدٕل (فارسی: پل خواجو) چھ ایران کس اِصفَہان منٛز ایٖرٲنی وُڈٕر ساروی کھوتہٕ بھڑ دٔرؠ یاو، زایندروٗد پیٹھ تَوٲریٖخی کٔدلو منٛز اکھ۔ کٔدٕل تہٕ ویٖر دۄشوٕنی ہٕنٛدۍ پٲٹھۍ کٲم کران، یہِ چھُ شُمٲلی بٔٹھِس پٮ۪ٹھ خاجو کوارٹرس زایندر روٗدَس اپارٕ زرتشتی محلس سۭتۍ رَلاوان۔ یہ چھ اِصفحان کس کمال اِسماعیل گلی کس ٲخرس پیٹھ واقع۔[1]

english: Santali is primarily written in Ol Chiki script, an indigenous alphabetic writing system developed in 1925 by Santal writer Raghunath Murmu.
kashmiri: سانتالی چھ بنیٲدی طور اول چیکی رسم الخط منٛز لیکھنہٕ آمت، اکھ مقٲمی حروف تہجی تحریرک نظام یس 1925 ہس منٛز سانتال مصنف رگھوناتھ مرمو تیار کوٚر۔
parentEnglish: Santali is primarily written in Ol Chiki script, an indigenous alphabetic writing system developed in 1925 by Santal writer Raghunath Murmu. Additionally, it is also written in various regional Indian writing systems such as Bengali-Assamese script, Odia script, Devanagari, and the Santali Latin alphabet.[1]
parentKashmiri: سانتالی چھ بنیٲدی طور اول چیکی رسم الخط منٛز لیکھنہٕ آمت، اکھ مقٲمی حروف تہجی تحریرک نظام یس 1925 ہس منٛز سانتال مصنف رگھوناتھ مرمو تیار کوٚر۔ امہ علاوٕ چھ یہ مختٔلف علاقٲیی ہندوستٲنہ تحریری نظامن یتھ کٔنۍ بنٛگٲلہ-آسامی رسم الخط، اوڈیا رسم الخط دیواناگری تہٕ سانتالی لاطینی حروف تہجی منٛز تہ لیکھنہٕ آمت۔[1]

english: The Santali Wikipedia (Santali: ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ ᱣᱤᱠᱤᱯᱤᱰᱤᱭᱟ) is the Santali language version of Wikipedia, run by the Wikimedia Foundation.
kashmiri: سانتالی وِکیٖپیٖڈیا چھ وِکیٖپیٖڈیا ہُک سانتالی زَبان ترجمہٕ، یس وکیمیڈیا فاؤنڈیشن چِھ چلاوان۔
parentEnglish: The Santali Wikipedia (Santali: ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ ᱣᱤᱠᱤᱯᱤᱰᱤᱭᱟ) is the Santali language version of Wikipedia, run by the Wikimedia Foundation. The site was launched on 2 August 2018.[1][2] The Santali language's own alphabet, Ol Chiki, has been used as the alphabet of this Wikipedia.[1][3] Santali is a language in the Munda subfamily of Austroasiatic languages, spoken by around 7.4 million people in South Asia (Bangladesh, India, Bhutan and Nepal).

english: In ancient Greek religion and mythology, Artemis (/ˈɑːrtɪmɪs/; Ancient Greek: Ἄρτεμις) is the goddess of the hunt, the wilderness, wild animals, transitions, nature, vegetation, childbirth, care of children, and chastity.[1][2] In later times, she was identified with Selene, the personification of the Moon.[3] She was often said to roam the forests and mountains, attended by her entourage of nymphs.

parentEnglish: Kashyapa (Sanskrit: कश्यप, IAST: Kaśyapa) is a revered Vedic sage of Hinduism.[1] He is one of the Saptarishis, the seven ancient sages of the Rigveda. english: Marilyn Jeanne Seely (July 6, 1940 – August 1, 2025) was an American singer, songwriter, record producer, and author.
kashmiri: مارلِن جینی سیٖلی (6 جولائی، 1940-1 اگست 2025) ٲس اکھ امریکی گلوکارہ، نغمہ نگار، ریکارڈ پروڈیوسر تہٕ مصنف۔
parentEnglish: Marilyn Jeanne Seely (July 6, 1940 – August 1, 2025) was an American singer, songwriter, record producer, and author. Primarily identified with country music, Seely found success with the Grammy Award-winning song "Don't Touch Me" (1966). Her soul-inspired vocal delivery[1] gave her the nickname of "Miss Country Soul".[2] Seely was a member of and performer on the Grand Ole Opry, having appeared more times on the program than any other performer (5,397 appearances dating back to May 1966 and including 57 years as member of the Grand Ole Opry).[3][4]
parentKashmiri: مارلِن جینی سیٖلی (6 جولائی، 1940-1 اگست 2025) ٲس اکھ امریکی گلوکارہ، نغمہ نگار، ریکارڈ پروڈیوسر تہٕ مصنف۔ بُنیٲدی طور پٲٹھۍ ٲس ملکی موسیقی سۭتۍ زاننہٕ یوان، سیٖلی یس گریمی ایوارڈ زینن وول گؠون "ڈونٹ ٹچ می" (1966) سۭتۍ ملیہٕ کامیٲبی۔ أمۍ سٕنٛدۍ روحٕ سۭتۍ متٲثر آوازٕ دسہ دیت تٔمس "مُلکٕچ روٗح (Miss country soul)" ناو۔[1][2]

english: Muhsin ibn Ali (Arabic: مُحْسِن ٱبْن عَلِيّ), also spelled Mohsin, was the youngest son of Fatima bint Muhammad and Ali ibn Abi Talib, and thus a maternal grandson of the Islamic prophet Muhammad.
kashmiri: مُحسِن ابن علی (عربی: مُحْسِن ٱبْن عَلِيّ) ٲس فاطمہ بن محمد تہٕ علی ابن ابی طالب سٕنٛدؠ ساروی کھوتہٕ لۄکٹ نیٚچوٗ، تہٕ اتھ پٲٹھۍ اوس اسلامی پیغمبر محمد سُنٛد کورِ ہُنٛد اولاد۔
parentEnglish: Muhsin ibn Ali (Arabic: مُحْسِن ٱبْن عَلِيّ), also spelled Mohsin, was the youngest son of Fatima bint Muhammad and Ali ibn Abi Talib, and thus a maternal grandson of the Islamic prophet Muhammad. He was a brother of Husayn and Hasan. Controversy surrounds the fate of Muhsin as some canonical Shia sources report that Muhsin died in miscarriage, following a raid on Fatima's house led by Umar, a companion of Muhammad.[1] Alternatively, Sunnis hold that Muhsin died in infancy of natural causes.[2][3][4]

english: Durga (Sanskrit: दुर्गा, IAST: Durgā) is one of the most important goddesses in Hinduism, regarded as a principle aspect of the supreme goddess.
kashmiri: دُرگا (سنسکرت:दुर्गा :Durgā ) چھِ ہؠنٛدؠ دَرٕم مٕچ ساروی کھوتہٕ اہم دیوی یتھ مَہا دیوی ہنٛد اکھ بنیٲدی پہلو چھ ماننہٕ یوان۔
parentEnglish: Durga (Sanskrit: दुर्गा, IAST: Durgā) is one of the most important goddesses in Hinduism, regarded as a principle aspect of the supreme goddess. Associated with protection, strength, motherhood, destruction, and wars, her mythology centers around combating evils and demonic forces that threaten peace, dharma and cosmic order, representing the power of good over evil.[5][6] Durga is seen as a motherly figure and often depicted as a warrior, riding a lion or tiger, with many arms each carrying a weapon and defeating demons.[7][5][8][3][9][10][11] She is widely worshipped by the followers of the goddess-centric sect, Shaktism, and has importance in other denominations like Shaivism and Vaishnavism.[6][12]
parentKashmiri: دُرگا (سنسکرت:दुर्गा :Durgā ) چھِ ہؠنٛدؠ دَرٕم مٕچ ساروی کھوتہٕ اہم دیوی یتھ مَہا دیوی ہنٛد اکھ بنیٲدی پہلو چھ ماننہٕ یوان۔ حفاظت، طاقت، ممتا، تبٲہی تہٕ جنگن سۭتۍ وابستہٕ، امکہٕ افسانہٕ چھ برائین تہٕ شیشونی قوتن ہنٛد مقابلہٕ کرنس أنٛدۍ پٔکۍ مرکوز یم امن، دھرم تہٕ سمسٲرؠ نظامس خطرٕ چِھ بناوان، یس برٲئی پیٹھ اچھٲئی ہنٛز طاقتچ نمائندگی چھ کران۔[5][6]

english: Associated with protection, strength, motherhood, destruction, and wars, her mythology centers around combating evils and demonic forces that threaten peace, dharma and cosmic order, representing the power of good over evil.[5][6] Durga is seen as a motherly figure and often depicted as a warrior, riding a lion or tiger, with many arms each carrying a weapon and defeating demons.[7][5][8][3][9][10][11] She is widely worshipped by the followers of the goddess-centric sect, Shaktism, and has importance in other denominations like Shaivism and Vaishnavism.[6][12]

parentEnglish: Durga (Sanskrit: दुर्गा, IAST: Durgā) is one of the most important goddesses in Hinduism, regarded as a principle aspect of the supreme goddess. Associated with protection, strength, motherhood, destruction, and wars, her mythology centers around combating evils and demonic forces that threaten peace, dharma and cosmic order, representing the power of good over evil.[5][6] Durga is seen as a motherly figure and often depicted as a warrior, riding a lion or tiger, with many arms each carrying a weapon and defeating demons.[7][5][8][3][9][10][11] She is widely worshipped by the followers of the goddess-centric sect, Shaktism, and has importance in other denominations like Shaivism and Vaishnavism.[6][12]

english: Vedic Sanskrit, also simply referred as the Vedic language, is the most ancient known precursor to Sanskrit, a language in the Indo-Aryan subgroup of the Indo-European language family.
kashmiri: ویدِک سنٛسکرٕت یتھ صرف ویدِک زَبان تہٕ ونان چھ، چھ سنسکرتُک ساروی کھوتہٕ پرٛون پیش خیمہ، یس ہند-یورپی زبان کس خاندانک ہند-آریان ذیلی گروپچ زَبان چَھ۔
parentEnglish: Vedic Sanskrit, also simply referred as the Vedic language, is the most ancient known precursor to Sanskrit, a language in the Indo-Aryan subgroup of the Indo-European language family. It is attested in the Vedas and related literature[1] compiled over the period of the mid-2nd to mid-1st millennium BCE.[1] It is orally preserved, predating the advent of writing by several centuries.[3][4]

english: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu is a union territory in India.[1][2] The territory was constituted through the merger of the former territories of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu.
kashmiri: دادرا تہٕ نگر حویلی تہٕ دمن تہٕ دیو چھ ہِندوستان اکھ مرکزی زیر انتظام علاقہٕ۔[1][2] یہ علاقہٕ آو دادرا تہٕ نگر حویلی تہٕ دمن تہٕ دیو کیٚن سابقہ علاقن ہٕنٛد رلنہ ذٔریعہٕ قٲیم کرنہٕ۔
parentEnglish: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu is a union territory in India.[1][2] The territory was constituted through the merger of the former territories of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu. Plans for the proposed merger were announced by the Government of India in July 2019; the necessary legislation was passed in the Parliament of India in December 2019 and came into effect on 26 January 2020.[3][4] The territory is made up of four separate geographical entities: Dadra, Nagar Haveli, Daman, and the island of Diu. All four areas were formerly part of Portuguese India, with a joint capital at Panjim, Goa.
parentKashmiri: دادرا تہٕ نگر حویلی تہٕ دمن تہٕ دیو چھ ہِندوستان اکھ مرکزی زیر انتظام علاقہٕ۔[1][2] یہ علاقہٕ آو دادرا تہٕ نگر حویلی تہٕ دمن تہٕ دیو کیٚن سابقہ علاقن ہٕنٛد رلنہ ذٔریعہٕ قٲیم کرنہٕ۔ اِکوَٹ کرنُک منصوبہٕ آو حکومت ہند طرفہٕ جولائی 2019 منٛز اعلان کرنہٕ۔ دسمبر 2019 منٛز آو ضروری قونوٗن سٲزی ہند پارلیمنٹس منٛز منظور کرنہٕ تہٕ 26 جنوری 2020 پؠٹھ آو لاگوٗ کرنہٕ۔[1][2]

english: A meteor, known colloquially as a shooting star, is a glowing streak of a small body (usually meteoroid) going through Earth's atmosphere, after being heated to incandescence by collisions with air molecules in the upper atmosphere,[1][2][3] creating a streak of light via its rapid motion and sometimes also by shedding glowing material in its wake.
kashmiri: اکھ وۄلکا، یتھ بول چالس منٛز پیٛوُن تارُکھ (shooting star) چِھ وننہٕ یوان، چِھ اکھ لۄکٹ جسمچ چمکدار جِسمُک (عام طور پٲنٹھ وۄلکا پؠنٛڈ) یُس زمینُک ماحولس منٛز چھ پکان، بالٲئی ماحولس منٛز ہواک مالیکیولزن سۭتۍ ٹکراونہٕ سۭتۍ تاپدیپتس تام گرم گژھنہٕ پتہٕ، گاش ہِنٛد اکھ سٕتارٕ چھ بنان۔
parentEnglish: A meteor, known colloquially as a shooting star, is a glowing streak of a small body (usually meteoroid) going through Earth's atmosphere, after being heated to incandescence by collisions with air molecules in the upper atmosphere,[1][2][3] creating a streak of light via its rapid motion and sometimes also by shedding glowing material in its wake. Although a meteor may seem to be a few thousand feet from the Earth,[4] meteors typically occur in the mesosphere at altitudes from 76–100 kilometres (47–62 miles).[5][6] The root word meteor comes from the Greek meteōros, meaning "high in the air".[2]

english: With a population of nearly 11.9 million, Ohio is the seventh-most populous and tenth-most densely populated state.
kashmiri: اوہایو چھ ریاستہائے متحدہ کِس مڈویسٹرن تہٕ گریٹ لیکس علاقس منٛز اکھ ریاست۔
parentEnglish: With a population of nearly 11.9 million, Ohio is the seventh-most populous and tenth-most densely populated state. Its capital and most populous city is Columbus, with other major metropolitan centers including Cleveland and Cincinnati, as well as Dayton, Akron, and Toledo. Ohio is nicknamed the "Buckeye State" after its Ohio buckeye trees, and Ohioans are also known as "Buckeyes".[2]

english: According to accounts from his life, Sai Baba preached the importance of "realisation of the self" and criticised "love towards perishable things".
kashmiri: پننہ زندگی ہندین بیانو مطٲبق کٕر سائی باباہن "پانس سمجھن" ہنز اہمیتٕچ تبلیغ تہٕ "خراب گژھن واجنیٚن چیزن سٕتہ محبتس" پیٹھ تنقید۔
parentEnglish: According to accounts from his life, Sai Baba preached the importance of "realisation of the self" and criticised "love towards perishable things". His teachings concentrated on a moral code of love, forgiveness, helping others, charity, contentment, inner peace, and devotion to God and Guru.

parentEnglish: Standard Albanian is the official language of Albania and Kosovo, and a co-official language in North Macedonia and Montenegro, where it is the primary language of significant Albanian minority communities. english: Kailasha or Kailasa (IAST: Kailāsa) is the celestial abode of the Hindu god Shiva.
kashmiri: کیلاش، کیلاسا یا کیلاشا چِھ ہؠنٛدؠ رؠوٲیتو مُطٲبِق دیوتا شِو سنٛد آسمانی ٹِھکانہٕ۔
parentEnglish: Kailasha or Kailasa (IAST: Kailāsa) is the celestial abode of the Hindu god Shiva. It is traditionally recognized as a mountain where Shiva resides along with his consort Parvati, and their children, Ganesha and Kartikeya.[1] Mount Kailash, located in the Transhimalaya, in the western part of the Tibetan Plateau, is considered as a geographic manifestation of Kailasha.
parentKashmiri: کیلاش، کیلاسا یا کیلاشا چِھ ہؠنٛدؠ رؠوٲیتو مُطٲبِق دیوتا شِو سنٛد آسمانی ٹِھکانہٕ۔ یہ چھ رؠوٲیتی طور أکس پہاڑٕ پٲٹھۍ مانٛنہٕ یوان ییٚتہ شِو پننہ خانٛدارِنہِ پاروَتی تہٕ تہنٛدؠن شرؠن گنیش تہٕ کارتِکیہ سۭتۍ روزان چُھ۔[1] تِبتی وُڈٕر کس مغربی حصس منٛز، اَپور ہِمالیہ منٛز واقع کیلاش پہاڑ چھ کیلاشاہک جغرافیائی اظہار ماننہٕ یوان۔

kashmiri: کرتکیہ کارتِکے (: KARTTIKEYA) یتھ سکند ،سبرامنیم، شانموکھ یا مُرُگ تہٕ چھ ونان، چھ ہیٚنٛدۍ جنگک دیوتا ۔
parentEnglish: Kartikeya (IAST: Kārttikeya), also known as Skanda, Subrahmanya, Shanmukha or Muruga, is the Hindu god of war. He is generally described as the son of the deities Shiva and Parvati and the brother of Ganesha.
parentKashmiri: کرتکیہ کارتِکے (: KARTTIKEYA) یتھ سکند ،سبرامنیم، شانموکھ یا مُرُگ تہٕ چھ ونان، چھ ہیٚنٛدۍ جنگک دیوتا ۔ سہ چھ عام طور شِو تہٕ پاروَتی دیوتاہن ہنٛد نیٚچوٗ تہٕ گنیش سنٛد بوے پٲٹھۍ بیان یوان کرنہٕ۔

english: Kartikeya has been an important deity in the Indian subcontinent since ancient times.
kashmiri: کارتیکیہ چھ قدیم زمانہٕ پیٹھہٕ برصغیر پاک و ہند منٛز اکھ اہم دیوتا۔
parentEnglish: Kartikeya has been an important deity in the Indian subcontinent since ancient times. Mentions of Skanda in the Sanskrit literature data back to fifth century BCE and the mythology relating to Kartikeya became widespread in North India around the second century BCE. Archaeological evidence from the first century CE and earlier shows an association of his iconography with Agni, the Hindu god of fire, indicating that Kartikeya was a significant deity in early Hinduism.
parentKashmiri: کارتیکیہ چھ قدیم زمانہٕ پیٹھہٕ برصغیر پاک و ہند منٛز اکھ اہم دیوتا۔ سنسکرت ادب منٛز سکند سنٛد ذکر چھ پانژمہٕ صدی قبل مسیحک تہٕ کارتِکے سۭتۍ متعلق افسانہٕ چھ دویمہٕ صدی قبل از مسیحس اند پکہ شمٲلی ہندوستانس منٛز بٔڑس پیمانس پؠٹھ پٔھہلتھ۔ گوڑنچ صدی عیسوی تہٕ امہ برٛونٛٹھُک آثار قدیمک ثوٚبوٗت چِھ تہنٛد شکلہِ نگاری ہنٛد تعلق نارک ہندوٗ دیوتا أگنی یَس سۭتۍ ظٲہر کران، یمہٕ سۭتۍ یہ ظٲہر چھ گژھان ز کارتیکیہ اوس اِبتدٲے ہؠنٛدؠ درمس منٛز اکھ اہم دیوتا۔

english: Anas Jamal Mahmoud Al-Sharif (Arabic: أنس جمال محمود الشريف; 3 December 1996 – 10 August 2025) was a Palestinian journalist and videographer for Al Jazeera Arabic, widely recognized for his frontline reporting from northern Gaza during the Gaza war.
kashmiri: انس جمال محمود الشریٖف ( 3 دسمبر 1996-10 اگست 2025) اوس الجزیرہ عربی ہند اکھ فلسطینی صحافی تہٕ ویٖڈیو گرافر، یوس غزہ جنگ دوران شُمٲلی غزہ پیٹھہٕ ٲس پنٕن فرنٛٹ لائن رپورٹنگ خٲطرٕہ مشہوٗر۔
parentEnglish: Anas Jamal Mahmoud Al-Sharif (Arabic: أنس جمال محمود الشريف; 3 December 1996 – 10 August 2025) was a Palestinian journalist and videographer for Al Jazeera Arabic, widely recognized for his frontline reporting from northern Gaza during the Gaza war. In 2024, Al-Sharif's Reuters team was awarded a Pulitzer Prize for Breaking News Photography for their "raw and urgent" photos documenting the Gaza war.

english: Alejandro Rosales Castillo (born November 26, 1998) is an American fugitive who was added to the FBI Ten Most Wanted Fugitives list on October 24, 2017.
kashmiri: الیجینڈرو روزالس کاسٹیلو (پیدٲیش 26 نومبر 1998) چھ اکھ امریکی فرأری یُس 24 اکتوبر 2017 ہس منز ایف بی آیہٕ کس ٹین موسٹ وانٹڈ فرار فہرستس منز شٲمل کرنہٕ آو۔
parentEnglish: Alejandro Rosales Castillo (born November 26, 1998) is an American fugitive who was added to the FBI Ten Most Wanted Fugitives list on October 24, 2017. He is wanted for the August 2016 murder of Truc Quan "Sandy" Ly Le in Charlotte, North Carolina.[1] Castillo was the 516th fugitive to be placed on the FBI's Ten Most Wanted Fugitives list. The FBI is offering a reward of up to $250,000 for information leading to his capture.[2]
parentKashmiri: الیجینڈرو روزالس کاسٹیلو (پیدٲیش 26 نومبر 1998) چھ اکھ امریکی فرأری یُس 24 اکتوبر 2017 ہس منز ایف بی آیہٕ کس ٹین موسٹ وانٹڈ فرار فہرستس منز شٲمل کرنہٕ آو۔ سہ چھ اگست 2016 ہس منٛز شارلٹ، شمٲلی کیرولائنا منٛز ٹرک کوان "سینڈی" لی لی سٕنٛد قتلس منٛز مُبطلہ۔[1] کاسٹیلو اوس 516 ہم مفرور یس ایف بی آیی کس ٹین موسٹ وانٹڈ مفرور فہرستس منٛز تھاونہٕ آو۔ ایف بی آیی چھ أمس رٹنہٕ باپتھ زانٛکٲری دنہٕ باپتھ 250,000 ڈالر یَنام پیش کران۔[1]

english: Balaji Telefilms is an Indian company that produces Indian soap operas in several Indian languages.
kashmiri: بالاجی ٹیلی فِلمٕز چھےٚ اکھ ہِندوستٲنؠ کمپنی یوٚس واریاہن ہِندوستٲنؠ زبانن منٛز ہندوستٲنؠ صوپ اوپیرا چھ تیار کران۔
parentEnglish: Balaji Telefilms is an Indian company that produces Indian soap operas in several Indian languages. It also produces reality TV, comedy, game shows, entertainment, and factual programming. Balaji Telefilms is promoted by Ekta Kapoor and Shobha Kapoor and is a public company listed at Bombay Stock Exchange and National Stock Exchange of India.
parentKashmiri: بالاجی ٹیلی فِلمٕز چھےٚ اکھ ہِندوستٲنؠ کمپنی یوٚس واریاہن ہِندوستٲنؠ زبانن منٛز ہندوستٲنؠ صوپ اوپیرا چھ تیار کران۔ یہ چھ ریئلٹی ٹی وی، کامیڈی، گیم شو، تفریح تہٕ فیکچوئل پروگرامنگ تہٕ تیار کران۔ بالاجی ٹیلی فلمز چھِ ایکتا کپور تہٕ شوبھا کپور سٕنٛد طرفہٕ فروغ دنہٕ آمٕژ تہٕ چھ اکھ عوٲمی کمپنی یۄس بمبئی سٹاک ایکسچینج تہٕ نیشنل سٹاک ایکسچینج آف انڈیا ہس منٛز درٕج چھےٚ۔

english: Ahura Mazda (/əˌhʊərə ˈmæzdə/;[1] Avestan: 𐬀𐬵𐬎𐬭𐬀⸱𐬨𐬀𐬰𐬛𐬁, romanized: Ahura Mazdā; Persian: اهورا مزدا, romanized: Ahurâ Mazdâ,[n 1] or ارمزد, Ormazd),[n 2] also known as Horomazes (Persian: هرمز),[n 3][2] is the principal God and god of the sky in Zoroastrianism.[3][4][5] He is the first and most frequently invoked spirit in the Yasna.

parentEnglish: Ahura Mazda (/əˌhʊərə ˈmæzdə/;[1] Avestan: 𐬀𐬵𐬎𐬭𐬀⸱𐬨𐬀𐬰𐬛𐬁, romanized: Ahura Mazdā; Persian: اهورا مزدا, romanized: Ahurâ Mazdâ,[n 1] or ارمزد, Ormazd),[n 2] also known as Horomazes (Persian: هرمز),[n 3][2] is the principal God and god of the sky in Zoroastrianism.[3][4][5] He is the first and most frequently invoked spirit in the Yasna. The literal meanings of the words Ahura and Mazda are "lord" and "wisdom", respectively.

english: Sati (/ˈsʌtiː/, Sanskrit: सती, IAST: Satī, lit.
kashmiri: سَتی (/ˈsʌtiː/، سنسکرت: सती، IAST: Satī، lit.
parentEnglish: Sati (/ˈsʌtiː/, Sanskrit: सती, IAST: Satī, lit. 'truthful' or 'virtuous'), also known as Dakshayani (Sanskrit: दाक्षायणी, IAST: Dākṣāyaṇī, lit. 'daughter of Daksha'), is the Hindu goddess of marital felicity and longevity, and is worshipped as an aspect of the mother goddess Shakti. Sati was the first wife of Shiva, the other being Parvati, who was Sati's reincarnation after her death.[1]
parentKashmiri: سَتی (/ˈsʌtiː/، سنسکرت: सती، IAST: Satī، lit. 'پَزَر' یا 'نیک')، یتھ دکشیانی تہٕ ونان چھِ (سنسکرت: दाक्षायणी، IAST: Dākṣāyaṇī، lit. 'دکشا سٕنٛز کوٗر')، چھے ازدواجی خُشی تہٕ زیچھِ وٲنسہِ ہٕنٛز ہندو دیوی، تہٕ اتھ چھِ ماجہِ دیوی شکتی ہنٛد اکہِ پہلو کِس طورس پیٹھ پوٗزا یوان کرنہٕ۔ سَتی ٲس شِو سٕنٛز گۄڈنچ خانٛدارِنؠ، دۆیم ٲس پاروَتی یوٚسہٕ أمہ سٕنٛد مرنہٕ پتہٕ سَتی ہنٛد دوبارٕ زَنم اوس۔[1]

english: Arnebia is a genus of flowering plants in the family Boraginaceae.
kashmiri: کٔہہ زَبان چُھ پوش دار کُلیٚن ہٕنٛز اکھ جینس یُس Boraginaceae خاندانس سۭتۍ تعلق تھاوان چھ۔
parentEnglish: Arnebia is a genus of flowering plants in the family Boraginaceae. There are about 36 species, most are located in the Mediterranean region and eastwards to the Himalayas and northern China, with one species extending into tropical Africa.[1]
parentKashmiri: کٔہہ زَبان چُھ پوش دار کُلیٚن ہٕنٛز اکھ جینس یُس Boraginaceae خاندانس سۭتۍ تعلق تھاوان چھ۔ اتھ منٛز چھ تقریباً 36 قبول شدہ زٲژ، یم بنیٲدی طور پٲٹھؠ رومی سَمَندَر کیٛن علاقن منٛز لبنہٕ یوان چھ، ہمالیہ تہٕ شمٲلی چینس تام مشرقس طرفہٕ پھٔلتھ، تہٕ اکھ زٲژ اشنکٹبندیی افریقہس تام واتان۔

english: The Arabic script is the writing system used for Arabic (Arabic alphabet) and several other languages of Asia and Africa.
kashmiri: عربی لِکھٲرؠ نِظام یا عربی رسم الخط چھ عربی حروف تہجی تہٕ ایشیا تہٕ افریقہ کیٛن کنہہ بیین زبانن خاطرٕ استعمال گژھن وول لِکھٲرؠ نِظام۔
parentEnglish: The Arabic script is the writing system used for Arabic (Arabic alphabet) and several other languages of Asia and Africa. It is the second-most widely used alphabetic writing system in the world (after the Latin script),[1] the second-most widely used writing system in the world by number of countries using it, and the third-most by number of users (after the Latin and Chinese scripts).[2]
parentKashmiri: عربی لِکھٲرؠ نِظام یا عربی رسم الخط چھ عربی حروف تہجی تہٕ ایشیا تہٕ افریقہ کیٛن کنہہ بیین زبانن خاطرٕ استعمال گژھن وول لِکھٲرؠ نِظام۔ یہٕ چھ دنیاہک دویم ساروی کھوتہٕ زیادٕ استعمال گژھن وول حروف تہجی تحریرک نظام (لاطینی رسم الخط پتہٕ) یہٕ چھ استعمال کرن وألن ملکن ہنٛز تعٲداد کہ لحاظہٕ دنیاہس منٛز دیمہٕ ساری کھوتہٕ زیادٕ استعمال گژان وأل تحریری نظام، تہٕ استعمال کرن وٕلن ہنٛز تعٔداد کہ لحاظٕ سۭتۍ چھ تریم ساری کھوتہٕ زیادٕ (لاطینی تہٕ چینی رسم الخطس بعد) ۔[1][2]

english: The film marked Sridevi and Bachchan's third collaboration after Inquilaab (1984) and Aakhree Raasta (1986).
kashmiri: خُدا گَواہ چِھ اکھ 1992 ہٕچ ہندوستٲنی مہاکاوی ڈرامہ فلم یتھ مکل ایس آنند تحریر تہٕ ہدایت کٲری کٔرمٕژ چِھ۔[1] اتھ فلمہ منٛز چھ امیتابھ بچن سری دیوی (دوٛن کردارن منٛز-ناگارجُن شلپا شیرودکر ڈیننی ڈینزونگپا تہٕ کِرن کُمار اہم کردارن منٛز۔
parentEnglish: The film marked Sridevi and Bachchan's third collaboration after Inquilaab (1984) and Aakhree Raasta (1986). Set against the backdrop of Afghanistan and India, the film follows Badshah Khan, an Afghan warrior who travels to India to avenge the murder of his beloved Benazir's father. After completing his mission, he is falsely accused of another murder and subsequently imprisoned in India.
parentKashmiri: خُدا گَواہ چِھ اکھ 1992 ہٕچ ہندوستٲنی مہاکاوی ڈرامہ فلم یتھ مکل ایس آنند تحریر تہٕ ہدایت کٲری کٔرمٕژ چِھ۔[1] اتھ فلمہ منٛز چھ امیتابھ بچن سری دیوی (دوٛن کردارن منٛز-ناگارجُن شلپا شیرودکر ڈیننی ڈینزونگپا تہٕ کِرن کُمار اہم کردارن منٛز۔ افغانستان تہٕ ہندوستان کس پس منظرس منٛز بناونہٕ آمٕژ یہ فلم چھےٚ بادشاہ خان سٕنٛز پیروی کران، اکھ افغان جنگجو یس پنٛنہ محبوب بے نظیر سٕنٛدس مٲلس قتلک بدلہ ننہٕ خٲطرٕ ہندوستانک سفر چھ کران۔ پنن مشن پوٗرٕ کرنہٕ پتہٕ آو أمس پؠٹھ بیٚیہ أکس قتلک غلط اِلزام لگاونہٕ تہٕ پتہٕ ہندوستانس منٛز قٲد کرنہٕ۔

parentEnglish: Dhamaal (transl. Fun) is a 2007 Indian Hindi-language comedy film directed by Indra Kumar and produced by Ashok Thakeria. The film stars Sanjay Dutt, Riteish Deshmukh, Arshad Warsi, Aashish Chaudhary and Javed Jaffrey in the lead roles, with Asrani, Sanjay Mishra, Murli Sharma, Vijay Raaz, Manoj Pahwa, Tiku Talsania and Prem Chopra in supporting roles.[1] Inspired by Stanley Kramer's It's a Mad, Mad, Mad, Mad World (1963), it is the first installment of the Dhamaal film series.
parentKashmiri: دھمال (ترجمہ۔ دھمٲلؠ کرُن یا مزٕ کرُن) چھِ 2007 ہٕچ ہندوستٲنی ہندی زبٲنۍ ہنٛز مزاحیہ فلم چھ یتھ اِنٛدِرا کُمار ہدایت کٲری کٔرمٕژ چھ تہٕ اشوک تھاکریاہن ٲس پروڈیوس کٔرمٕژ۔ فلمہ منٛز چھ سنجے دت، رِتیش دیشمُکھ، آرشد وارسی، آشیش چودھری تہٕ جاوید جعفری مرکزی کردارن منٛز، یتھ منٛز اسرانی سنجے مِشرا، مُرلی شرما، وِجے راز، منوج پاہوا ٹیکو تلسانیا تہٕ پرٛیم چوپڑا نٲئب کردارن منٛز چِھ۔[1] یہ چھ سٹینلے کرمر سٕنٛز ایٹس اے میڈ، میڈ، میڈ ورلڈ (1963) سۭتۍ متٲثر تہٕ یہ چھےٚ دھمال فلم سیریز گۄڑنچ قسط۔
